234.description: If I remember correctly, Grelin's camp is down the road to the southeast. No doubt he'll be eager to get his mail.

6085.name: Taming the Beast
6085.objective_text: Use the Taming Rod to tame an Ice Claw Bear. Practice your skills, then return the Taming Rod to Grif Wildheart in Kharanos.
6085.description:
Perhaps you'd like a creature that possesses little more than brute strength. The ice claw bear is an excellent companion for a fledgling hunter like yourself, and can be found east of Kharanos. Here is the taming rod; try this animal as a pet and see if ya like it!

When you return, I'll give ya the skills you will need to tame an animal of your choosing; this creature will face the challenges you face, and gain experience alongside you. I will also show you how to call it and dismiss it as ya like.

6086.name: Training the Beast
6086.objective_text: Speak with Belia Thundergranite in Ironforge.
6086.description:
<name>, ya now have the power to tame a pet, but you must also gain the skills ta train it.

Travel to Ironforge and find the Hall of Arms. There you must speak to one of our most revered animal trainers, Belia Thundergranite. She'll give ya the power to train your new pet, so get goin', <lad/lass>!

Belia is a friendly sort; you should have no problems gaining her approval. Good luck, <name>.
comments: Found her in The Military Ward at 70,85.

77620.name: Spell Research
77620.objective_text: Recover research notes from the Defias bandits and use them to learn a new spell, then return to Khelden Bremen in Northshire.
77620.description:
I will teach you what I can, <name>, but your own research will lead to astonishing power. Studying notes left by Azeroth's greatest archmages is an excellent place to start. The Abbey's archives used to contain a myriad of arcane research notes, but they were stolen by Defias agents.

Recover spell notes from the bandits to the east and use this primer to decipher them. Return to me once your research is successful.

77643.objective_text: Find the stolen spell notes inside the Burning Blade Coven, then use them to learn a new ability. Afterwards, return to Mai'ah in the Valley of Trails.
77643.description:
As a mage, researching the arcane will lead you to astonishing power. Studying notes left by Azeroth's greatest mages is an excellent place to start. I had recently discovered some myself, but they were stolen by those pesky Burning Blade Familiars.

Recover the spell notes from the coven to the north and use this primer to decipher them. Return when your research is successful.

77655.name: The Lost Rune
77655.objective_text: Find the lost rune carried by a  Frostmane troll in Coldridge Valley. Use it to learn a new ability, then report back to Thran Khorman in Anvilmar.
77655.description:
The warriors of the Alliance have much to teach you, <name>, but you must also seek out new techniques on your own.

There is a cave full of Frostmane trolls south of here. Another fledgling warrior ventured inside some time ago, but never returned. He was experimenting with engraving mystical runes onto his equipment to improve his combat prowess.

Find the rune among the trolls, one of them is likely carrying it, and learn this technique yourself. Return to me when you have done so.

77657.name: Relics of the Light
77657.objective_text: Recover the stolen libram carried by a Frostmane troll in Coldridge Valley. Follow its guidance to learn a new ability, then return to Bromos Grummner in Anvilmar.
77657.description:
Relics of the Light can be found across Azeroth. These relics - in particular, the Librams that have guided our order since its founding - can help you strengthen your connection to the Light.

We held one such libram in our archives, but it was stolen by the Frostmane trolls. The thief is likely still carrying it on them. Recover the libram, and follow its guidance to learn a new combat technique. Return to me when you have done this.

77658.name: Thrice Stolen
77658.objective_text: Recover the stolen rune from the cave of Frostmane trolls in Coldridge Valley. Use it to learn a new ability, then return to Solm Hargrin in Anvilmar.
77658.description:
I'm ashamed to admit it, <name>, but those Frostmane buggers got the drop on me. They stole a magical rune I... uh, 'borrowed' from the treasury. I figured it would give me a leg up, so to speak, but I couldn't crack how to make it work.

Go to their cave in the south, and see if you can snatch it back from their stash, would ya? When you find it, try to use the rune yourself. You seem like a bookish sort. No offense.

77660.name: Trek Through the Caves
77660.objective_text: Recover the stolen rune from the cave of Frostmane trolls in Coldridge Valley. Use the rune to learn a new ability, then report back to Thorgas Grimson in Anvilmar.
77660.description:
Hunters are a hardy lot, <name>, even among Dwarves. We set out across Azeroth to explore lands unknown, and hunt all sort of dangerous and exotic quarry. Many times on your journey, you will find yourself alone in hostile territory, surviving only by your wits.

The Frostmane trolls have stolen a rune of great power from us. They have likely stashed it away in their cave to the south. Recover the rune, and use it to learn a new combat technique. Return to me once you have done so.

77661.name: Meditation on the Light
77661.objective_text: Find a memory of the past inside of a chest at the trogg camp near Anvilmar. Then, kneel at the Altar of the Light within Anvilmar to meditate on the light, and use the memory to learn a new ability. Afterwards, speak to Branstock Khalder.
77661.description:
The Light has shown me your future, <name>, fighting the Troggs to the southwest. Within a chest, you will find a memory of the past. Once you acquire it, return here and kneel before the Altar of the Light. Meditate on its mysteries.

When you have focused your thoughts, you will be able to make sense of this memory and learn a new technique. Speak to me when you have done this.

77666.name: Stolen Power
77666.objective_text: Recover the rune from the group of Troggs, southwest of Anvilmar, and use it to learn a new ability. Then, return to Alamar Grimm in Anvilmar.
77666.description:
I've been experimenting with a new type of magic - a rune which can channel fel energy to fuel powerful spells. I would share this power with you, but it was stolen by one of those pesky troggs.

There is a camp of those Rockjaw vermin to the southwest. See if you can find my rune stashed among their possessions, likely in a chest of some kind. Once you find it, learn its magic and report back to me. I would like to see my experiment put to use.

77671.name: Spell Research
77671.objective_text: Kill Scarlet Initiates to find spell notes and use them to learn a new ability, then return to Isabella in Deathknell.
77671.description:
The arcanists of the Royal Apothecary Society commit their unlife to spell research in service to the Forsaken. Adventure may be your calling, but you can serve the Dark Lady by securing and researching spell notes you find in your travels.

Kill the Scarlet Crusade initiates camped near Deathknell, and seize their spell notes. Use this primer to decipher the notes and learn a new spell, then return to me.

80139.name: Gnogaine
80139.objective_text: Use the Empty Leaden Collection Phial on Irradiated Invaders or Irradiated Pillagers to collect radioactive fallout. Once it is full, take it back to Ozzie Togglevolt in Kharanos.
80139.description:
Since the accident, all Gnoarn thinks about or talks about is cleansing Gnomeregan of the trogg infestation and finding a cure for the sickness that plagues it, <name>.

Luckily, Razzle and I are close to some kind of cure - either that or the recipe for a really powerful rum. We won't know until we test! Naturally, in order to test our theory, we're going to need a few things; namely, fallout from the irradiated troggs in Gnomeregan. Fill up this phial with the green glow and bring it back!

94373.name: Call of Earth
94373.objective_text: Bring 2 Frostmane Bear Pendants to Teo Hammerstorm in Anvilmar.
94373.description:
Aye, the time's come, young shaman. Ye've grown stout and sturdy, like the stone beneath our boots. Takin' up the shaman's path shows ye've got the wisdom o' the mountain, even before ye've proven yerself.. Ye've the grit of stone to walk the earth's path. 

But to earn its favor, ye must face it proper. South o' here, the Frostmane trolls live in a cave.

Bring me two of their necklaces they wear--crafted from the Iceclaw bears. Then we'll speak more of yer future.

94374.name: Call of Earth
94374.objective_text:
Find the Spirit Stone and drink the Earth Sapta.

Provided item:
94374.description:
Aye, sapta's a brew forged with magic, bindin' our spirit to the elements. Only a few shaman know the recipe, and it's nae for the weak-willed. Drink it, and ye will see what others can't. Hold true--it's only to be drunk in a sacred place.

Head north to the Spirit Stone, tucked at the end of a hidden path up the mountain. Drink it there... see what the earth has to show ye.
comments:
Head up the snowy hill at 26.4/68.00.
It is on top of the hill.
Turn left at the small camp stone will be in the distance.

94375.name: Call of Earth
94375.objective_text: Bring the Rough Quartz to Teo Hammerstorm in Anvilmar.
94375.description:
Take this rough quartz from me and bring it to Teo Hammerstorm as proof o' our meeting. He will craft a totem for ye, and this pebble will be the heart o' it. As small as it may seem, ye will come to find that size does not matter, and that even the smallest o' things can outlast many others.

Be patient, <name>. Remain strong. And seek wisdom. This is what earth asks o' ye. In the end, ye shall become one with the earth--respect it as it shall respect ye.

94449.name: Call of Fire
94449.objective_text: Find Bruegs Kindleborn in Dun Morogh.
94449.description:
It's been long since ye were last tested, <name>. Ye've shown patience, aye -- but now it's time ye learned of chaos... of destruction. Fire's call is loud, and if ye're ready to pay its price, it'll speak to ye. 

Seek out Bruegs Kindleborn, far east in the mountains. He dwells in a cave above South Gate Outpost. He'll know if ye're truly ready.
comments: The trail to get to the quest turn in starts at 86.5/47.2.

94465.name: Call of Fire
94465.objective_text: Bring the Torch of the Dormant Flame to Braldir Ashmantle in Loch Modan.
94465.description:
Aye, ye've the strength to bear the totem o' fire, lad--but strength alone won't make ye ready.

Beyond the Valley o' Kings, in the crags of Loch Modan, lies a hidden path to one o' our sacred peaks. There, Braldir Ashmantle guards the Shrine o' the Dormant Flame. 

Take this torch to him--it shows yer intent. Return it burnin' by the shrine's brazier, and I'll see ye earn the totem proper.
comments: Trail starts at 31.4/58.2 follow the eyebrow cliff trail past the stone totems.

94468.name: Call of Fire
94468.objective_text: Bring the Torch of Eternal Flame to Bruegs Kindleborn in Dun Morogh.
94468.description:
Torch firmly in hand, you turn away from the brazier and look out over Loch Modan. You feel an excitement tugging at your spirit as the wind picks up and forces the flame to dance violently.

You start off down the path back to Dun Morogh in search of Bruegs Kindleborn.

94472.name: Earth Sapta
94472.objective_text: Speak to Teo Hammerstorm for another Earth Sapta.

94824.name: Confounding Flash
94824.objective_text: Speak to High Priestess Mims in Ironforge.
94824.description:
Time's come for you to head to Stormwind, <name>. High Priestess Mims in the Hall of Mysteries commands you to come speak with her. Gotta be somethin' really good or really bad for the High Priestess to want you there personally, but I'm guessin' you've only done well for yourself and it's a good thing that she wants to speak to ya.

But don't waste too much time 'round here. I'd head there as soon as you can.

95041.name: Data Hoarders
95041.objective_text: Collect 7 Gnomeregan Archival Data cards from around Gnomeregan, then deliver them to Jemma Quikswitch in Ironforge.
95041.description:
Before we fled Gnomeregan, I made a hard copy of my family's archives. Arcanotechnical field equations, Second War submarine hull designs, Grandma Quikswitch's chili recipe... our greatest accomplishments are in those files.

It wasn't until we reached Ironforge that I found a hole in my pack! Several punch cards are gone, and without them the data's too scrambled to recover.

The cards must be buried in the snow, somewhere outside Gnomeregan. Could you find them? I know it's a long shot...
comments:
This is a new quest I picked up as an Engineer from Ironforge. Ideally you do it with Operation Recombobulation which starts at the same level and takes place in the same area.

In this quest, look for little patches of Snowdrift on the ground and simply pick them up.

95212.name: Never Saddle on Quality
95212.objective_text: Collect 6 Pristine Leopard Pelts and deliver them to Amberstill Ranch.
95212.description:
We're getting ready to send a team of rams to reinforce the Alterac expedition, but we've run out of material to make their saddles.

Collect pelts from the largest, fiercest leopards to the east and bring them to me. It's biting cold up there and our forces deserve nothing but the finest pelts to keep them warm!
comments: The drop rate for this quest was the worst out of any Dun Morogh quest I did in the beta, but it was still quite trivial to complete. I personally found it best to complete this alongside Stolen Blasting Powder and Nip 'Em in the Bud, as all quests take place roughly in the same area.

95213.name: Stolen Blasting Powder
95213.objective_text: Bring the Empty Powder Keg to Quarrymaster Thesten at Gol'Bolar Quarry.
95213.description:
The keg is stamped:

BLASTING POWDER - DANGER - DO NOT HANDLE - DANGER - QUARRYMASTER AUTHORIZATION ONLY - DANGER

You get a sinking feeling that the troggs shouldn't have this. It would be best to report this to the quarry sooner rather than later.

95214.name: Stolen Blasting Powder
95214.objective_text: Recover 16 Stolen Blasting Powder from the troggs east of Gol'Bolar Quarry, then return to Quarrymaster Thesten.
95214.description: This keg held enough powder to turn King Magni's throne room into an open air courtyard. We've got to get it back from the troggs before they work out how to ignite it.
comments:
I got this quest after completing the Gol'Bolar Quarry quests and then looting Empty Powder Keg from the troggs in the quarry. I turned the keg in, and got this as a follow-up.

I personally found it best to complete with Nip 'Em in the Bud, as both quests have objectives very close to each other.

95217.name: The Quarry's Smith
95217.objective_text: Collect 12 Copper Bars and 4 Toughened Boar Hides and deliver them to Frast Dokner.
95217.description:
So you're looking to learn the blacksmith's trade? Maybe we can help each other.

The supply shipment's late, and I need materials for some repairs around the camp. If you get me what I need, I'll teach you some of my techniques. Sound fair?

96031.name: Camping 101: Leatherworking
96031.objective_text: Speak with Gretta Finespindle in Ironforge to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
96031.description:
You've become a leatherworker. Good for you, <class>. I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to make yourself a tent that will keep you cool on hot days, and dry on rainy days.

With a good tent over your head, you'll ensure that you get all the rest you need to stay sharp on your travels.

96044.name: Camping 101: Blacksmithing
96044.objective_text: Speak with Tognus Flintfire in Kharanos to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
96044.description:
So, you've become a Blacksmith. That's a great choice if you want to make sure your blades never dull.

I reckon I know someone that can help with that by teaching you how to craft a Sharpening Wheel. Bring one of these out at your camp and all the warriors and rogues in the area will be lining up to hone their weapons.

96046.name: Camping 101: Mining
96046.objective_text: Speak with Yarr Hammerstone in Kharanos to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
96046.description:
Mining isn't the most glamorous, but it's good honest work and a fine profession for you to explore.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Lodestone for your camp. Build one of these and everyone who wants to swing a sword will be eager to gather round your fire and soak up the extra "oomph" it can provide to increase their combat prowess.

96047.name: Camping 101: First Aid
96047.objective_text: Speak with Thamner Pol in Kharanos to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.

objectives.text: Raise your first aid skill to 20

96047.description:
So you've taken up First Aid? That's an honorable... and pragmatic pursuit as a <class>.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a First Aid Kit for your camp. Injuries are a reality in the world of adventuring and offering some much-needed healing at your camp could even save lives.

96050.name: Camping 101: Fishing
96050.objective_text: Speak with Paxton Ganter near Iceflow Lake in Dun Morogh to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
96050.description:
You might not think so, but your skill as a fisherman can actually come in handy at camp.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Fish Bowl for your camp. You can use this fixture to help provide a bit of joy to yourself and your fellow adventurers. A happy adventurer is a strong adventurer and I'm sure your combat capabilities will reflect that.

96055.name: Camping 101: Herbalism
96055.objective_text: Speak with Reyna Stonebranch in Ironforge to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
96055.description:
Looks to me like you've gained some skill in herbalism. Picking flowers isn't just for dilly-dallying, you know. It can be useful... and profitable.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft an Incense Candle for your camp. High spirits are a key component to keeping healers and spellcasters in the fight, and an Incense Candle can provide a boost that magic users will surely appreciate.

96056.name: Camping 101: Skinning
96056.objective_text: Speak with Balthus Stoneflayer in Ironforge to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
96056.description:
Being able to skillfully harvest the skins and hides of fallen beasts is one of the more valuable skills an adventurer can possess.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Camp Chair for your camp. Sometimes it's important to just take a load off, and you can use some of those hides you've gathered to make a comfy chair to sit in. A bit of relaxation can help ensure that you are at your peak condition and can strike where it counts the next time you find yourself in a dust-up.

96057.name: Camping 101: Tailoring
96057.objective_text: Speak with Uthrar Threx in Ironforge to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
96057.description:
Tailoring is a surprisingly potent tradeskill to invest in, and I'm sure it'll serve you well.

I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Faction Banner for your camp, provided you have the skill for it. Inspiration and morale are a key part of success on any battlefield, and an inspirational banner can go a long way to keeping you energized.

96058.name: Camping 101: Engineering
96058.objective_text: Speak with Bronk Guzzlegear in Kharanos to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
96058.description:
Engineers like yourself can cook up all sorts of bits, bots, and bombs for fun and profit.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Reagent Bot for your camp. This helpful automaton can help keep you well-supplied so that you and your allies never run out of the materials needed to fuel your spells.

96390.name: Nip 'Em in the Bud
96390.objective_text: Slay 10 Dark Iron Spies in Dun Morogh.
96390.description:
Dark Iron spies have infiltrated Dun Morogh. To what end I canna' not sure, but this is a problem we need to nip in the bud before it is allowed to grow.

Head eastward to Ironband's Compound and kill the Dark Iron spies that you find there.
comments: While doing this quest, make sure to loot the Dark Iron Map from the dwarves as well. The initial turn-in grants 1050 XP and it then leads to a Hall of Thanes quest with some powerful rewards.

96391.name: Underground Map
96391.objective_text: Deliver the Dark Iron Map to Earthseer Farsen in Dun Morogh.
96391.description:
<The map you are holding seems to show a complex series of underground tunnels and highways that all seem to converge on a point underneath Ironforge itself.

You can't be sure what the runes say as they are written in the ugly jagged rune language of the Dark Iron dwarves, but you can guess at the purpose of these tunnels. As you are reading the map, a gust of wind washes over you and you can faintly hear a dwarven voice carried on it. Earthseer Farsen needs to see this.>
comments: This quest is granted through a drop, not given by an NPC.
Dropped by Dark Iron Spy I got mine after about 10 kills

Dark Iron Map that drops from Dark Iron Spy in Dun Morogh starts this quest.
/way 77 60

96392.name: Farsen's Watch
96392.objective_text: Speak with Earthseer Farsen's and ask him to lend you his farsight to observe the Dark Iron threat.
96392.description:
Greetings to ye, friend. My name is Earthseer Farsen and I'm visiting Dun Morogh from Aerie Peak. As I was travelin', I couldn't help but notice that we have, well... a bit o' a Dark Iron Dwarf problem.

If ye have a moment, I can show ye what I mean. I've got a bit o' magic that should do the trick.
comments:
Talk to Farsen and click the dialogue option. To cancel the farsight effect, simply move or hit Esc and the quest is complete.

The area you were viewing is where the next part of this quest chain takes place. Around this general area you can also complete the quests Never Saddle on Quality and Stolen Blasting Powder fairly effectively, as well as pick the Dark Iron Map up for an extra 1050 XP.

96393.name: Old Ironforge Incursion
96393.objective_text: Enter the Hall of Thanes beneath Old Ironforge and claim the Head of Durgen Dirgehammer.
96393.description:
Gather some allies and head down into the caverns beneath Old Ironforge. Enter the Hall of Thanes there and push to the lower vaults. 

My Dark Iron is a bit rusty, but I can make out a name--one Durgen Dirgehammer. It's likely that he's the commander. Take his head and deliver it to King Magni Bronzebeard. 

Oh, and when you do, tell him his old friend Farsen sends his regards!
comments: To get this quest you have to loot a quest item, its not given by the NPC. The item Dark Iron Map drops from the dark iron mobs in the south east corner of Dun Morogh. Hand it in to Earthseer Farsen and he gives you this quest as a followup. I was already on a quest to kill these mobs by Farsen, it is not clear if that is requirement for the drop.
Is the weapon damage on the gun correct? That seems like a crazy high number.
The dark iron dwarves that drop the item are located at /way 77,0 60,1 in Dun Morogh.
This is not available for horde, the NPC you have to interact with is Alliance only.

96408.name: A Visitor to Dun Morogh
96408.objective_text: Investigate the campsite overlooking the Gol'Bolar Quarry.
96408.description:
Last night one of our mountaineers spotted a campfire on a hillside to the east. It looks to be pretty high up, overlooking  the Gol'Bolar Quarry.

It's probably nothing, but I'd like you to go check on that camp. If they are friendly, no harm done. If they aren't friendly... well, you know what to do.

96608.name: The Great Outdoors
96608.objective_text: Sit near Eric's Basic Campfire by typing /sit in the chat window and wait until you receive the Boosted Rest buff.

objectives.text: Use the /sit emote near the campfire

96608.description:
Greetings, <class>. I can see you've got the look of an adventurer about you. This is good. The world needs more of us restless souls, seeking fortune and glory.

You'll need to learn to thrive in the wilds to be successful in this line of work. Not sure how your outdoor skills are but I can probably teach you a thing or two, if you'd be apt to learn.

Have a seat near the fire and get comfortable. I'll walk you through it.
comments: Several players noted the "Boosted Rest" buff wasn't triggering despite sitting in the camp for a long time. This could be fixed by simply relogging and sitting down again. I, too, was only able to complete that objective following a quick relog.

96628.name: The Adventurer
96628.objective_text: Deliver the Supply Bundle to Eric Brighthammer near Kharanos.
96628.description:
Wait, <name>. I have another ask of you, before you brave that tunnel.

My mountaineers have reported an adventurer that's shown up just outside of Kharanos. Could you deliver these supplies to him?

96629.name: Camping 101: Cooking
96629.objective_text: Speak with Gremlock Pilsnor in Kharanos to learn to become a cook.

objectives.text: Learn cooking from Gremlock Pilsnor in Kharanos

96629.description:
So you want to learn more about camping, huh? Good for you, <class>. The first step any adventurer needs to take is to become a cook and learn how to make a campfire.

Cooking's not just about making tasty foods. It's also the foundation for your camp.

98319.name: Secure the Mountain
98319.objective_text: Find Mountaineer Cornelius in the Grizzled Den for Mountaineer Gretchen.
98319.description:
It's bad enough havin' a troll problem, but the mountains are filled tae the brim with wendigos! They normally keep to their own caves, but they seem tae be spreadin' like bunnies. Now they've filled the Grizzled Den north of here.

If we want Whitebeard's report, we're gonna need to find my partner Cornelius. The blockhead got a little too excited and charged in head first. Brave, but stupid.

Head into the cave and see where he is. And feel free to take out some the beasts while yer at it.
comments: Cornelius is in the Grizzled Den Cave. Specifically the star shaped room to the right after you enter, he's lying in the middle of the frozen pond surrounded by wendigos.
@ coordinates 43.0, 49.6 in the Grizzled Den Cave w/ the Wendigo's

98321.name: Flintfire's Shipment
98321.objective_text: Collect 8 Flintfire Shipments from the Grizzled Den for Tongus Flintfire in Kharanos.
98321.description:
Hoha! Good to see a <race> who's not afraid to get their hands dirty.

If yer lookin' fer work, I'm afraid I'm a little short on supplies at the moment. Our most reliable source of ore has been overrun by wendigo and now the cave has been abandoned. The miners had to drop everything when they fled!

Say, why don't ye poke yer head around the Grizzled Den to the west and see if you can find some of our missing shipments. It would save us a great deal o' trouble.

98322.name: Secure the Mountain
98322.objective_text: Check in on Mountaineer Gretchen west of Kharanos.
98322.description:
Spelunking dark caves is adventurer business. My job's just to make reports and send them over to Ironforge.

Trouble is, one of my reports hasn't... well, reported back. I asked a few mountaineers to learn more about the wendigo problem we have out here, but I haven't heard from them.

If you're already going to be out and about, what say you don't check in with Mountaineer Gretchen just west of town. I'm late enough as it is!

98323.name: Secure the Mountain
98323.objective_text: Deliver Mountaineer Gretchen's Report back to Senir Whitebeard in Kharanos.
98323.description:
Hopefully ye put down a fair number of the mongrels while you were in there. Shame about Cornelius, though.

From what you described, there's not much to report other than the cave is a lost cause. Whitebeard's not gonna like that answer, but I'm not darin' sendin' anybody else into that death trap.

Feel free tae pass along the message, <name>. I'm not leavin' this spot till the mountain's secure.

98326.name: Frosthowl
98326.objective_text: Slay Frosthowl and collect the Sack of Fish for Gretta Ganter in Brewnall Village
98326.description:
Do ye know how hard it is to fish on a frozen lake? My poor husband, Paxton, has been out in the middle of it for days and we barely have a single sack to show fer it.

Well, we DID have a sack to show fer it. Until the thrice-damned wendigo attacked me and made off with our haul. It'll take us weeks to fish all that back up! If that loudmouth Frosthowl didn't scare 'em all off, anyway.

Do us a favor and get it back, aye? Drooling brute is hiding somewhere deep in the Grizzled Den to the southeast.
comments: he's at the end of the cave directly west from kharanos. coords 42, 54

Depending on your level and class choice, you may want to group up for this one. Frosthowl has more health than the other yetis, he hits harder and he even Rejuvenates himself. I found myself going out of mana fighting him, and with no wand, I couldn't finish the kill at level 7.

This quest bugged when I looted Sack of Fish and wouldn't award any quest progress. A full relog will fix this. It seems to occur with people in a party where not everyone gets the item to drop on the first kill. Not sure if its intended to be this way or not so have submitted a bug report just in case.

98423.name: The Treaty of Understanding
98423.objective_text: Deliver the Treaty of Understanding to Magni Bronzebeard in Ironforge.
98423.description: Inside of the vault you find a tablet detailing the terms of a peace treaty between the Bronzebeard and Wildhammer dwarf clans. It appears to date back to time period just after of the War of the Three Hammers, and is very likely a notable piece of dwarven history. The king of Ironforge would no doubt be interested in this artifact.

98574.name: Hallowed Memorandum
98574.objective_text: Read the Hallowed Memorandum and speak to Branstock Khalder in Anvilmar.
98574.description: While you were helping me out, this memorandum was given to me to pass on to you. Take some time to read it when you have a chance. I'm thinkin' it came from the priest trainer Branstock. Take a gander at it and go find him inside Anvilmar when you've a chance.

98581.name: Archaic Rune
98581.objective_text: Read the Archaic Rune and speak to Teo Hammerstorm in Anvilmar.
98581.description: While you were helping me out, this rune was given to me to pass on to you. Take some time to read it when you have a chance. Based on the Wildhammer style to these inscriptions, I'm guessin' this came from the shaman trainer Teo Hammerstorm. Take a gander at it and go find him inside Anvilmar when you've a chance.

99158.name: Dawn in the Mountains
99158.objective_text: Bring the crate of candles to Father Gavin.
99158.description:
There's a priest out in the mountains that belongs to an organization called the Argent Dawn. They're a holy group that is dedicated to finding and destroying the unholy and unnatural.

Father Gavin though, he's mostly the type that seeks to help and heal everyone rather than grab a weapon. He's fixed up an old building to serve as a rest spot for travelers. I've got a shipment of holy candles that I need to get him. Could you bring them to him if your going that way?
comments:
As of now in the beta, this quest's description contains a typo.
Could you bring them to him if your going that way?
To me, this is just proof no LLMs were involved in the creation of this quest! ;-)

99159.name: Finding Warmth
99159.description:
My hearth is open to warm any soul, but I'd like to ask you to help me if you could.

I simply need more firewood. It is something I would normally do myself, but I have been preoccupied by other tasks.
comments: Large white trunks on the ground next to trees. Some nodes contained 2, so collecting all 14 is surprisingly fast.
I found it a bit tedious to run around and look for these boughs on the ground, and was questioning if the XP was worth the time investment, but the follow up quests were quick and worth doing.

Was a few others, saw 2-3 there when I did it, respawn time is terrible and spawns are sparse.
Would not think this is worth doing if there are any others there, since you have no other quest in the area either.

Edit: got 2x wood 3 times out of 11.

99160.name: Rime's Wrath
99160.description:
You may have noticed the elementals nearby. A shelf of rock and ice fell from the mountain peaks a few days ago and riled them up.

These frozen mountains are already treacherous for the average dwarf or human without the elements taking form. I am not one for fighting anymore--so any of the spirits you can kill would help make the road safer.

99161.name: Rime's Wrath
99161.objective_text: Kill Avala and retrieve its core.
99161.description:
I noticed that the first elemental that appeared after the rockslide was larger than its peers. And from what I can tell, it has been the source of occasionally weather changes and other minor slides.

I've been calling it 'Avala', if you could kill it and retrieve the core as proof, I will reward you.

99162.name: Treacherous Cold
99162.objective_text: Collect the rifles of fallen mountaineers.
99162.description:
Even mountaineers from Ironforge have to keep their wits about them when traversing through the peaks of Dun Morogh. Falling snow and ice often spells the end of some more novice members' lives.

After a slide, I usually try to find any sign of survivors or victims--while praying to the Light that there's nothing to be found. But with the elements acting up, I've held off wandering too far. If you could look for some lost mountaineers and bring me their rifles, I will return them to Ironforge.
comments:
These guns are next to fallen dwarven mountaineers.

Here's a map to all 3.

Coldbeard - follow the frozen river west of the quest giver. Dwarf is under the tree that has fallen across the river

Sunhammer - southeast of the quest giver. Dwarf lies next to a cart on the small path up to Vagash's cave

Stoneanvil - almost straight south of the quest giver in a valley. Dwarf lies next to a cart out in the open.

9.name: The Killing Fields
9.objective_text: Farmer Saldean wants you to kill 20 Harvest Watchers.
9.description:
Look at what has happened to this place!  These lands were once occupied by good farm folk.  But the damned thieves have driven them all off.  Not me, though!  But it seems some Harvest Watchers have taken over the fields.

If you're up for the work, I'd like you to go out and kill twenty of them.  Come back when you're done for your pay.  If you finish up with the ones in my field, clear them from the neighboring fields as well.
comments: The area immediately in front of Farmer Saldean seems to be quite a grinding hotspot for appropriate level characters -- I've often had to compete with several players for Harvest Watchers (pure hell on my Rogue, what with everyone playing ezmode ranged pet classes). Thankfully, there's several fields in addition to the one where Farmer Saldean is that you can find Harvest Watchers. If you're havi

14.description: Some Defias have eluded us.  My most trusted scout reports that these Defias have been looting and pillaging the countryside, all the way into Southern Westfall.  We believe they are hiding out in the Dagger Hills, plotting their next move.   Slay the wretches in the name of The People's Militia.

46.objective_text: Bring 8 Torn Murloc Fins to Guard Thomas at the east Elwynn bridge.
46.description:
The Stormwind Army has placed a bounty on murloc lurkers and foragers in Elwynn.  Slaughter them and bring me their torn murloc fins, and the Stormwind Army will reward you well.

The murlocs have built a village at Stone Cairn Lake north of here, and another to the south where the stream forks.
comments: The murlocs are located upstream the river and to the northeast. They are easily spotted by their island-style huts, and the fins don't take too long to drop but the murlocs are very difficult to face alone at level 10. Tough quest imho.
This quest rewards 250 Stormwind reputation as of patch 2.01

61.description:
My brother Morgan is waiting in Stormwind for my shipment of candles.  I don't have enough time to make the trip myself, but if you'd like to take him the shipment, he'll pay you well.

I've packed up the candles, and you can find Morgan in our shop, Pestle's Apothecary, in the Stormwind Trade District.

90.objective_text: Gather 10 Lean Wolf Flanks and Stormwind Seasoning Herbs and return to Chef Grual in Darkshire.
90.description: Seasoned Wolf Kabobs are a house favorite!  Sure, I can make you some.  But first I'll need the supplies.  Bring me 10 Lean Wolf Flanks as well as some Stormwind Seasoning Herbs.  There are so many wolves here in the forest, I am sure finding the Flanks will be no problem.  For the herbs, seek out Felicia Gump in her canal district flower shop in Stormwind.

This quest rewards 250 Stormwind reputation as of patch 2.01

167.name: Oh Brother. . .
167.objective_text: Bring Foreman Thistlenettle's Explorers' League Badge to Wilder Thistlenettle in Stormwind.
167.description:
We were deep in a vast mine in Westfall, hidden beneath a barn in Moonbrook. No clue where these stinkin' thieving types came from. Anyway, the mine tunnel collapsed on us. I got out but the others... well... the others haven't been heard from.

You look like you might have better luck in there. If you could look for my brother, I'd be thankful.  He always carried his Explorers' League Badge. If you can't find him, that badge would at least give me some peace of mind.
comments: This quest is done outside of Deadmines. There is a lighter colored area on the mini-map. This is where the undead are, the named elite "Foreman Thistlenettle" is the one that drops the badge.

176.name: Wanted: "Hogger"
176.objective_text: Slay the gnoll Hogger and bring his Huge Gnoll Claw to Marshal Dughan.
176.description:
Wanted: Hogger

A huge gnoll, Hogger, is prowling the woods in southwestern Elwynn.  He has overpowered all attempts at his capture.

The Stormwind Army has placed a generous bounty on the Gnoll.  To earn the reward, bounty hunters should bring proof of Hogger's demise to Marshal Dughan in Goldshire.

And he re-spawned near 27,85.

It's pretty tough to solo this at level 10ish. I recommend finding at least one more, AND clearing the roaming gnolls. Also, avoid the camps, they have a rather large radius of aggro :)

- SJ

This is the first "elite" quest in the human storyline. This is best in a group or you will most likely die from adds, extra monsters attacking you. 

Once Hogger is dead have everyone in your party loot his body and pick up his claw, it will be available to everyone that has the quest in your party.

214.objective_text: Scout Riell at the Sentinel Hill Tower wants you to bring her 10 Red Silk Bandanas.
214.description:
It's no secret that the trademark of the Defias Gang is their Red Bandanas.  But we've learned that the material from which these bandanas are made signifies the member's rank.

That being said, I want you to eliminate as many high ranking Defias members as you can.  The highest ranking members will undoubtedly be found in VanCleef's secret hideout.  When you're done bring me 10 Red Silk Bandanas as proof of their deaths and I will reward you.  Good luck, <name>.

249.objective_text:
Defeat Morganth.

Bring his Pendant of Shadow to Theocritus at the Tower of Azora in Elwynn Forest.
249.description:
After much observation, I have discovered Morganth's plans.

He searches for the Scythe of Elune...and he may have found it!  If he has, then the Redridge Mountains, and the kingdom of Stormwind, will soon feel his dark might.

I am not prepared to pit myself against Morganth, but I fear he must be dealt with now.  So you must enter the Tower of Ilgalar and face Morganth.

Defeat him, and bring me his Pendant of Shadow.  Do this, and the kingdom will owe you much.

P.S: Skin everything, perfect deviate scales worth good money.

All you need to do is lead him towards the FRONT instance entrance, you don't need to go through it, but you'll have to lead him there.  The monsters for me came back, so they might respawn for you too.

8236.name: The Azure Key
8236.objective_text: Return the Azure Key to Lord Jorach Ravenholdt.
8236.description:
It will take some time to decipher the fragments and remove the enchantment.  When I am complete, I'll deliver the bag to Lord Ravenholdt personally.

There is still the matter of the key, said to be held by a green drake known as Morphaz.  The drake has made its home deep in the Temple of Atal'Hakkar, the entrance to which lies in the Swamp of Sorrows.

Gather your friends and venture to his lair.  Lord Ravenholdt will await your return with the key.
comments:
Unfortunately you are probably going to replace any of these rewards fairly quickly. Most rogues choose the Ebon Mask as it looks cool, and takes the longest to replace. 

On my PvP rogue I took the boots for the equip (as we roam in 3-5 man rogue packs and damage isn't the be all and end all), but most people won't want that type of thing.

As a rogue fairly far into the endgame, I'd encourage all rogues to take the Whisperwalk Boots. The mask, while it looks cool, is quickly replaced. The cape can be replaced with the parachute cloak if you are hankering for that slow fall effect. But a good pair of +Stealth boots are hard to come by. Great for PvP, and even PvE when you need to sneak around places that you might not normally be abl

The ebon mask is a little harder to replace than most people think for a casual non-raiding rogue. The AP and crit on the ebon mask makes it beter than Eye of Rend and in reality it is almost as good as the old rank 10 head peice. 

The ebon mask will last you until you hit rank 10, or start doing ZG.

Believe it or not, once in a great while you will find a blue that is better than an epic. I'm not going to say that is the case here, but try to be a little more open minded that epics aren't always best. 

And whats with all this talk about "everyone should pick this one, the other two are worthless and will be replaced"? Anything you have at lvl 52 will be replaced. Maybe some people like the l

comments: The staff and gloves are appealing upgrades if you get this quest done in your early 50's, but will be upgraded pretty quickly at level 60. The trinket, on the other hand, will last you well through your 60's.

Agreed with Kadaan. While the staff and gloves might seem tempting, don't take them. They'll be soon replaced by better items. 

The trinket, on the other hand, can be used an indefinite number of times, and is a great way of restoring mana over a period of time. In raids, couple this with mana spring totem and / or Mana Tide totem, and you have yourself a great way of restoring mana to your party
This is the last part of a quest chain, the first part being either Mastering the Elements or Elemental Mastery (different start NPC, same end NPC), then Spirit Totem, then this.

The trinket is nice, but unfortunately it is in effect, a water totem, so you cannot have both the Water Spirit and a Mana Tide/Stream totem out at the same time. Unless you're spending most of your time in raids, you might be better off taking the gloves or staff.

objectives.text: Learn: Engrave Chest - Fury of Stormrage

77571.description:
The kaldorei are an ancient people, and our lost relics can be found across Azeroth. Through these relics, the spirits can teach you ways to strengthen your connection to the Dream.

The grellkin have stolen one such relic. Slay them and retrieve the relic, then follow its guidance to learn a new combat technique. Return to me when you have done this.

77573.objective_text: Retrieve the rune from the hidden idol, then use it to learn a new ability. Afterwards, return to Frahun Shadewhisper.
77573.description:
I have prepared a training exercise for you, <name>. There is an idol of an owl on the roof of this building. You should be able to see it from the south entrance. Inside the idol is a hidden compartment containing an engraved rune.

Make your way to the roof, find and memorize the rune hidden in the idol, and return to me.

77574.name: Meditation on Elune
77574.objective_text: Kneel at the moonwell to meditate on Elune, then use the memory to learn a new ability. Afterwards, return to Shanda in Shadowglen.
77574.description:
Joining the Alliance has strengthened our people, but we must not forget that we are Kaldorei. Our connection to Elune is at the core of our being.

Clear your mind, <name>, and focus on my voice. I will share with you an ancient memory of our kind. Go to the moonwell to the north and kneel in the sacred waters to meditate on Elune's mysteries. Once you have focused your thoughts, you will be able to make sense of this memory and learn a new technique. Return to me when you have done this.

77575.objective_text: Slay webwood spiders in Shadowthread Cave and recover the lost rune. Learn the rune, then report back to Alyissia in Shadowglen.
77575.description:
The warriors of the Alliance have much to teach you, but you must also seek out new techniques on your own.

There is a cave to the north infested by webwood spiders. Another fledgling warrior ventured into the cave some time ago, and never returned. He was experimenting with engraving mystical runes onto his equipment to improve his combat prowess.

Find the rune among the spiders and learn this technique yourself.

77616.description:
The warriors of the Alliance have much to teach you, but you must also seek out new techniques on your own.

Another young warrior recently ventured into the Echo Ridge Mine. She was experimenting with engraving mystical runes onto her equipment to improve her combat prowess.

I suspect she was overwhelmed when the kobolds captured the mine. Find the rune among the kobolds and learn this technique yourself.

77617.objective_text: Recover the libram and follow its guidance to learn a new ability, then return to Brother Sammuel in Northshire.
77617.description:
Relics of the Light can be found across Azeroth. These relics - in particular, the Librams that have guided our order since its founding - can help you strengthen your connection to the Light.

One such libram was held in the Abbey's archives, but it has been stolen by the Defias bandits to the east. Recover the libram, then study it and follow its guidance to learn a new combat technique. Return to me when you have done this.

77618.objective_text: Recover the lost rune from the Defias camps and use it to learn a new ability, then return to Jorik Kerridan in Northshire.
77618.description:
I'm ashamed to admit it, <name>, but those Defias jerks got the drop on me. They stole a magical rune I... uh, 'borrowed' from the Abbey's archives. I figured it would give me some kinda advantage in a fix, but I couldn't crack how to make it work.

Make your way east and see if you can snatch it back from their stash, would ya? And try to use the rune yourself, when you find it. You seem like a bookish sort. No offense.

77619.description:
The Light has shown me your future, fighting the kobolds in Echo Ridge Mine. Within the mine, the Light will grant you a memory of the past. Once this is revealed to you, return to the Abbey and kneel within these halls to meditate on the Light's mysteries.

Once you have focused your thoughts, you will be able to make sense of this memory and learn a new technique. Return to me when you have done this.

77621.objective_text: Recover the rune from the Defias camps to the east and use it to learn a new ability, then return to Drusilla La Salle in Northshire.
77621.description:
I've been experimenting with a new type of magic - a rune which can channel fel energies to fuel powerful spells. I would share this power with you, but my notes were stolen last night. I suspect the bandits calling themselves the 'Defias' are to blame.

Go to the east, and see if you can find my rune stashed among their possessions. Learn its magic, and report back to me. I would like to see my experiment put to use.

77642.objective_text: Kneel at the Loa Altar in Sen'jin Village. Commune with the Loa spirit, then use the memory to learn a new ability. Afterwards, return to Ken'jai  in the Valley of Trails.
77642.description:
Joining the Horde has given our people a safe home, <name>, but we must remember that it is the Loa who are always watching over us.

Now, clear your mind, and I will share an ancient memory with you. Go to the Loa Altar in Sen'jin Village, and kneel before it to commune with the great Loa spirit. Once you have received the Loa's wisdom, you will come to understand the memory I have given you. Through this understanding, you will discover a new power.

Return to me once you have done this.

77670.description: I will summon to your mind a memory of the living - it may even be your own memory. Go to the graveyard beside this chapel and find where the chill of death is strongest, then kneel and focus your thoughts. Through focus on the mysteries of undeath you will find clarity in this memory and learn a new technique. Return to me when you have done this.

77690.description:
Greetings my esteemed <class> acquaintance! My name is John Trinketman, world renown traveler and puzzle solver! Never heard of me, have you? No matter! I am here in Ironforge looking for two of the most prestigious pieces of jewelry this side of Azeroth has ever seen! It is said they form a puzzle!

Unfortunately, rumor has it that they both reside in the dangerous Blackrock Mountain! Surely an adventurer of your caliber would have no issue finding these pieces for me?

78537.description:
The motes you gathered are an important clue, <name>, but we will also need some spiritual guidance if we're to fully understand the situation.

There is a ritual I often practice that requires an Elixir of Insight. The visions it grants will reveal the next steps we must take.

I can brew the elixir from two others. An Elixir of Water Breathing to free the body, and an Elixir of Wisdom to open the mind.

Bring these to me, and we can begin the ritual.

78575.objective_text: Slay Hirzek at Blackthorn Ridge, Barrens, and bring his staff to Jen'neu Sancrea at Zoram'gar Outpost, Ashenvale.
78575.description:
That quilboar you saw in your vision; I believe it was Hirzek. 

The Earthen Ring has known of the Quilboar's crude version of shamanism for some time. However, there are rumors that a few have recently been making troubling strides. Hizrek is one such Quilboar. 

From what you saw, it seems he is enslaving elementals, rather than cooperating with them as you and I would. No doubt this is causing distress among the elemental plane.

You must stop him, <name>. For the good of Shamans and elementals alike.

78830.objective_text: Get a Crimson Trophy Quill from Gharrik in the Badlands. Then, return to Hemet Nesingwary in Stranglethorn Vale.
78830.description:
This drawing reminds me of a story I'd heard on another expedition, not long ago. I was told of a great bird, Gharrik, who reigns over the Badlands as an apex predator.

She was last spotted northeast of Camp Cagg. Perhaps her nest is somewhere nearby?

You'll need live bait to draw her out. I'll lend you a cage to catch some. Small wildlife is scarce in the Badlands, so you'll need to find your bait elsewhere.

A quill from Gharrik would make a fine prize. You'd certainly be the talk of the camp.

The defeated water elemental has left behind a strange water globe.  You surmise that the object somehow fed the beast energy.  Inside the globe, a putrid-looking form of water sloshes about.  The globe itself seems impervious to any sort of physical force.

78921.description:
Strength has left me. Your help is needed!

Long ago this site was a great temple of Elune. But misfortune led to ruin when the corruption of an Old God seeped up from beneath the earth and tainted the sacred Moon Well.

Aku'Mai, servant of the Old God, rose from the waters.

The Twilight's Hammer cultists have allied with the naga to occupy these grounds. The cultists, led by Kelris, sacrifice innocents to Aku'Mai for power.

Slay Kelris and bring his head to Selgorm in Darnassus, <name>, please.

78923.name: Knowledge in the Deeps
78923.objective_text: Bring the Lorgalis Manuscript to Gerrig Bonegrip in the Forlorn Cavern in Ironforge.
78923.description:
As you might know, I collect lore.  Old lore.  Powerful lore.  Lore that opens doorways, and lore that can awaken Those Who Sleep.

There are rumors of an old piece of lore, the Lorgalis Manuscript, at the bottom of Blackfathom Deeps in Ashenvale.  That place is the old dwelling of long-dead elves.  Elves who held great knowledge before their city fell to ruin.

Search Blackfathom Deeps for the manuscript.  Do this, and I will not forget it.  Not even after ... the end days.

78924.name: In Search of Thaelrid
78924.objective_text: Seek out Argent Guard Thaelrid in Blackfathom Deeps.
78924.description:
Many rumors circulate these days about the union of the Twilight's Hammer and the naga in Blackfathom Deeps on the coasts of Ashenvale.

My role here with the Argent Dawn is to collect as much information as I can, so we know when and where help is needed.

It has been weeks now since I sent a scout to check on the activity at Blackfathom Deeps. Argent Guard Thaelrid has not yet reported back.

My other scouts are preoccupied with pressing matters.

Seek out and aid Thaelrid for me, <name>.

78925.name: Twilight Falls
78925.objective_text: Bring 10 Twilight Pendants to Argent Guard Manados in Darnassus.
78925.description:
Empowered by the ancient rites of the chaotic Old Gods the members of the Twilight's Hammer strive to bring about the return of their dark patrons and spread death and terror across the world.

We believe that the Twilight's Hammer has allied with the naga and are amassing in Blackfathom Deeps on the coast of Ashenvale.

Whatever evil plan brews in the depths of the old temple must be thwarted.

Wage war on the Hammer and bring back proof of your deeds. Your efforts will be rewarded handsomely.

78926.name: Researching the Corruption
78926.objective_text: Gershala Nightwhisper in Auberdine wants 8 Corrupt Brain stems.
78926.description:
Foolish blood elves toil with demonic magic. Have they not witnessed what happened with the naga and with the satyrs of Kalimdor?

I fear that the blood elves will meet a similar deformation. Azeroth cannot afford to give birth to another vile race of monsters.

I wish to study the brain stems of the satyr and naga so that I might deduce what fate the elves are headed toward. In Blackfathom Deeps, on the coast of Ashenvale, you will find both satyr and naga.

'Tis a long journey, <name>.

78927.name: Allegiance to the Old Gods
78927.objective_text: Kill Lorgus Jett in Blackfathom Deeps and then return to Je'neu Sancrea in Ashenvale.
78927.description:
This Twilight's Hammer follower cannot be allowed to complete his plan. The Twilight's Hammer do not understand the spirits of nature. They believe in the Old Gods--creatures of chaos and destruction that were long ago defeated. This Lorgus cannot be allowed to succeed. You must stop him, <name>. I cannot do it myself--I am too weak.

Go into Blackfathom Deeps, find him, and kill him. Return to me here at Zoram'gar when it's done.

79242.objective_text: Find Illari Duskfeather, near Arathi Highlands, and get access to her cache of stolen loot.
79242.description:
As I was saying...

Our boss wasn't with the Horde. She was a night elf named Illari Duskfeather. She gave us intel on the camps, and even let us keep most of the loot. She only kept a few of the rarer finds.

Once the Marshal was on our tail, though, she left us for dead. I don't know her motives, but I think we were set up as patsies.

I'm not the vengeful type, but I won't stop someone else from hunting her down. If you're looking for her, she once mentioned a hideout somewhere near Arathi.

We found an unusual amount of storm activity isolated in the bluffs to the northeast near Razorfen territory.

The wind was too powerful for the riders to get close and the density of the rain made it impossible to see what's waiting for you inside the eye. But maybe with that potion you can break on through to the other side.

Speak with Nyse, Wind Rider Master, when you are ready. She will provide a wyvern to ride into the storm.

79483.objective_text: Locate the Smokywood Pastures investigator that has gone missing in the snowy regions of the Alterac Mountains.
79483.description:
Listen... not to shatter the magic of the season here, but Smokywood Pastures could use some assistance - the kind you adventuring types are known to give.

We're missing an important shipment of treats that was restocking us for the season, and now we're missing the agent of Smokywood Pastures that we sent out to the field to find it!  Please - the shipment was last reported in the Alterac Mountains, and that's where our man went to look for it.

See if both are out there, safe and sound!

79492.name: Metzen the Reindeer
79492.objective_text:
Find Metzen the Reindeer.  Use the notes provided to you for clues as to where he is being held.

When you find Metzen, have the Pouch of Reindeer Dust in your possession so you can sprinkle some of the dust on him; this should free Metzen from his bonds of captivity.

Return the Pouch of Reindeer Dust to Wulmort Jinglepocket in Ironforge once Metzen is freed.

objectives.text: Find Metzen the Reindeer and rescue him

79492.description:
DISASTER has struck!  Metzen the Reindeer has been kidnapped!

Metzen is one of Greatfather Winter's eight reindeer - and property of Smokywood Pastures.  We've received not one but TWO ransom letters from groups claiming to have Metzen.  With the holiday season well under way, we're strapped to the coin box here!  Please - find Metzen and return him to us!

Check out the ransom letters for clues, and sprinkle this reindeer dust on him - it will free him from any of his bonds!

Please, hurry!

Listen... I'm not really supposed to be telling you this, but since you're the hero of the day and all...

There's fresh holly everywhere this time of the year, but it never lasts.  We've got a machine that preserves holly - it never goes bad!  We use it to spice up the holiday... and profits during the summer!

I'll let you use the preserver, but only if you're a master cook.  You'll need some deeprock salt and two, three, oh let's say five gold.  It'll net you a nice batch that's yours to keep.

objectives.text: Meet Aeonas at the Cathedral of Light in Stormwind

79970.description:
Thank you for saving me, <class>. It seems that I'm not as young as I once was, and I think I'm going to need allies for what is to come. Please, meet me in Stormwind in the Cathedral of Light as soon as you are able.

79982.objective_text: Bring Wirdal Wondergear a Charged Voidcore.
79982.description: I can repair that processor for you, but I need a somewhat hard-to-get item; a Charged Voidcore. Naga spell casters are known to carry these and while I can't be sure where the Naga get them or how they are made, they tend to act as powerful foci for certain types of magical rituals. They are the key component to my G-7 C.O.R.E. Processor unit. They aren't common so you may be in for a tough time finding one.

79985.name: A Fine Mess
79985.objective_text: Escort Kernobee to the Clockwerk Run exit and then report to Scooty in Booty Bay.
79985.description:
<Kernobee groans.> Wha.. What happened?

The last thing I remember is being captured by a group of dark iron dwarves, beaten to within an inch of my life and then thrown in here with these filthy troggs.

Get me out of here, <name>!

Here's the plan: Lead me to the exit; if we make it out alive, you go to Booty Bay and let Scooty know that I went to Ratchet to warn Tinkerwiz of the dark iron's involvement in the making of that super rig.

Let's get going!

79986.name: Grime-Encrusted Ring
79986.objective_text: Figure out a way to remove the grime from the Grime-Encrusted Ring.
79986.description:
You have uncovered what appears to be a ring from the corpse of one of the Dark Iron dwarves.  It is difficult to tell what kind of ring it is, however; dirt and hardened residue cake the item completely, making wearing it impossible.  You think you can make out the slight luster of precious metal and maybe even the glint of a gem under the residue.

If you are going to make use of this ring, you are going to need to find something to get the hardened residue off of it.

79987.name: Return of the Ring
79987.objective_text: You may either keep the ring, or you may find the person responsible for the imprint and engravings on the inside of the band.
79987.description:
Opening the box produced by the Sparklematic 5200 reveals what you had suspected - a shiny ring!  Wearing the ring, you feel magic power surge through you body.

Inside the band is a small but nonetheless discernable imprint of the seal of Ironforge.  Next to that, three small initials are engraved: "TdK".  This may signify either the initials of the previous owner, or perhaps the initials of the ring's crafter.  Keep the ring... or return it to this person.  Decisions, decisions...

80131.name: Gnome Improvement
80131.objective_text: Bring the Brilliant Gold Ring, a Silver Bar, a Moss Agate, and 30 silver coins to Talvash del Kissel in Ironforge.
80131.description:
Listen <name>, that ring is yours, sure... but I can make you a better one!  That design, like I said, is really simple.  I am a lot more skilled now, and for the mere fee of thirty silver coins I'll spruce it up for you!  Well, a little more than thirty, actually...

I'm in a tight spot right now; all my material stock is all dried up.  If you bring me a bar of silver and a moss agate, I'll add a silver and agate lattice to the ring that will give it a little more pizzazz!

Trust me!

80132.name: Rig Wars
80132.objective_text: Retrieve the Rig Blueprints and Thermaplugg's Safe Combination from Gnomeregan and bring them to Nogg in Orgrimmar.
80132.description:
Gnome technology - two years ago its most common use was as a punch line. Times certainly have changed. Now they've got a new rig built that's better than all our shredder models combined. I need the blueprints, <name>!

Unfortunately, the plans are locked away in a safe near Mekgineer Thermaplugg. To make matters worse, the combination to the safe is only known by Mekgineer Thermaplugg.

Do whatever you have to do to get that combination, <name>. Then crack open that safe and bring back those blueprints!

80134.name: Gnomer-gooooone!
80134.objective_text: Wait for Scooty to calibrate the Goblin Transponder.
80134.description:
As long as you have the transponder in your possession, all you need to do is step on the pad and you'll be teleported to Gnomeregan.

You may experience some unusual side effects, but none of those should be permanent... anymore.

I almost forgot the most important part - getting back. When you're ready to come back, just step on the transpolyporter pad in Gnomeregan!

Now to calibrate the transponder to your size and weight.

80135.name: Klockmort's Essentials
80135.objective_text: Speak with Klockmort Spannerspan in Ironforge.
80135.description:
A gnome friend, Klockmort Spannerspan, sent word to me from Ironforge.  He tells me he needs help on a dangerous, but essential, mission into Gnomeregan, the once great gnome city now contaminated and filled with mad gnomes and their devices.

I must stay here, but my heart aches to help my friend.  If you can go in my stead, then I would be much indebted to you.

You may find Klockmort in Tinkertown, in Ironforge.

80136.name: Essential Artificials
80136.objective_text: Bring 12 Essential Artificials to Klockmort Spannerspan in Ironforge.
80136.description:
A nigh-universal mechanical component--the essential artificial--was of great use to the tinkers and smiths of Gnomeregan.  But during the frantic exodus from our city, no one remembered to take any of these devices with them!  And I need a large supply of them for work I will soon undertake.

Please, go into Gnomeregan and get me some essential artificials.  You'll find them in the deeper areas of our city, held in containers called artificial extrapolators.

Thank you, <name>, and please hurry!

80137.name: Save Techbot's Brain!
80137.objective_text: Bring Techbot's Memory Core to Tinkmaster Overspark in Ironforge.
80137.description:
When our beloved city Gnomeregan fell, a rogue spark must have jolted my poor creation, Techbot.  It once aided me and my associates with its countless gizmos and limitless store of information, but its positronic brain has polarized.  Now it's negatronic... and Techbot's behaviors are reversed.  It roams Gnomeregan in a frenzy!

But perhaps it can be salvaged.  Perhaps, if you can retrieve Techbot's memory core and bring it to me, I can discover the cause of the polarization and fix my poor Techbot.

80138.name: Tinkmaster Overspark
80138.objective_text: Speak with Tinkmaster Overspark in Ironforge.
80138.description:
Tinkmaster Overspark is very upset with the fate of his mechanical creation, Techbot.  I remember Techbot as a kind and helpful tool for the gnomes, but Overspark tells me it's malfunctioned.

Very sad.  But with luck perhaps he can be fixed!

Speak with Tinkmaster Overspark, in Tinker Town in Ironforge.  He would welcome your help.

80140.name: Return of the Ring
80140.objective_text: You may either keep the ring, or you may find the person responsible for the imprint and engravings on the inside of the band.
80140.description:
Opening the box produced by the Sparklematic 5200 reveals a shiny ring!  Donning the ring, you feel magic power surge through your body.

Inside the band is a small but nonetheless discernable imprint of the seal of Orgrimmar.  Engraved letters are next to it, but only the first three stand out even after cleaning: "NOG..."

This may signify either the initials of the previous owner, or perhaps the initials of the ring's crafter.  Keep the ring... or find "NOG" - decisions, decisions...

80142.name: Castpipe's Task
80142.objective_text: Speak with Master Mechanic Castpipe in Ironforge.
80142.description:
Master Mechanic Castpipe in Ironforge has need of adventurers!  He's organizing bands to reenter Gnomeregan on a data retrieval mission of top security and importance.

Castpipe might not be a member of the Enlightened Assembly of Arcanology, Alchemy and Engineering Sciences like I am, but he's still a smart gnome so if he thinks it's important, then by my calculations there's an eighty-four percent probability that it really is important!

Those are good odds!

80143.name: Data Rescue
80143.objective_text: Bring a Prismatic Punch Card to Master Mechanic Castpipe in Ironforge.
80143.description:
When we fled Gnomeregan, we left so much data behind!  Vitally important data!

I need the data on a prismatic punch card, from a Matrix Punchograph 3005-D high security terminal, deep in Gnomeregan.  You must access the terminal, but to do that you first need clearance... and to get that you must access lower security terminals-- models -A, -B and -C.  And to do THAT you need security punch cards, starting with white... and we left all the punch cards in the city.

It's a catastrophe!  Can you help?

80180.name: The Grand Betrayal
80180.objective_text: Venture to Gnomeregan and kill Mekgineer Thermaplugg. Return to High Tinker Mekkatorque when the task is complete.
80180.description:
I trusted Thermaplugg, <race>. Never did I expect that he would betray me and the entire gnomish people. And for what? Power? Wealth? All things that he would have had in time. Now we have been displaced from our home and that madman is in charge. The king of nothing....

We will retake Gnomeregan, <name>. We will not stop until the city is back in our control. If you wish to join in our fight, a simple task I ask of you: Kill the betrayer. Destroy Mekgineer Thermaplugg.

80181.name: Gyrodrillmatic Excavationators
80181.objective_text: Bring twenty-four Robo-mechanical Guts to Shoni in Stormwind.
80181.description:
It's terrible, <name>. We are not going to have enough parts to get our fleet of gyrodrillmatic excavationators to Dun Morogh.

What we need are spare parts, <name>. What better place to get the spare parts for our vehicles than Gnomeregan? I hear that bots and mechs roam around that place like cattle on an open range.

What I need you to do is go to Gnomeregan and tear apart those robots. Bring me back their robot guts. Two dozen should be sufficient.

80241.name: The Origins of Smithing
80241.objective_text: Bring six Golden Scale Bracers to Hank the Hammer in Stormwind.
80241.description:
When I was about your age, a dwarf by the name of Galvan took me under his wing and trained me in the ways of the armorsmith. Before he left for Booty Bay, he made me promise to train all those with the desire and determination to advance in the craft of blacksmithing -- so here I am -- all these years later.

So, now it's time for you to learn a little something. Make me six golden scale bracers and you will learn where smithing comes from, <name>.

82023.objective_text: Find the lair of the "Beast" that the injured gnome was referring to and recover the Void-Powered Vambraces
82023.description: You see, I'm a knight of some renown and I recently took it upon myself to rid the land of a particularly terrible evil making its home on a nearby island to the east. When I found the vile creature, a truly epic battle was met. We must have fought for hours until at last I sent the beast into full retreat, no doubt run off to succumb to its wounds. I was barely able to make it back to town myself before I collapsed in exhaustion. The vambraces must have slipped from my arm during the battle.

82098.name: Into The Temple of Atal'Hakkar
82098.objective_text: Gather 10 Atal'ai Tablets for Brohann Caskbelly in Stormwind.
82098.description:
According to legend, The Temple of Atal'Hakkar is a holy shrine dedicated to the ancient god, Hakkar the Soulflayer. Maintained by a vicious tribe of trolls named the Atal'ai, the temple is rumored to be impenetrable.

Now sunk beneath the Pool of Tears, retrieving artifacts from the temple is even more difficult. But that's what I need you to do, <name>.

Aid me by gathering the intact Atal'ai Tablets. Bring them to me and I will return to the Explorers' Guild a hero. Together we will share the glory.

82110.objective_text: Return the Azure Key to Lord Jorach Ravenholdt.
82110.description:
It will take some time to decipher the fragments and remove the enchantment.  When I am complete, I'll deliver the bag to Lord Ravenholdt personally.

There is still the matter of the key, said to be held by a green drake known as Morphaz.  The drake has made its home deep in the Temple of Atal'Hakkar, the entrance to which lies in the Swamp of Sorrows.

Gather your friends and venture to his lair.  Lord Ravenholdt will await your return with the key.

82113.objective_text: Bring the voodoo feathers to Bath'rah the Windwatcher.
82113.description:
The spirit totem just isn't enough.  We be needin' some voodoo magic to make it work jus' right.

The trolls in the sunken temple have feathers strong with voodoo magics.  Go there and kill Gasher, Mijan, Zolo, Hukku, Zul'lor, and Loro.  Then we have magic enough for a real spirit totem.

82662.name: The Way of the Weaponsmith
82662.objective_text: To become a Weaponsmith, you must make the following items and return them to Ironus: 4 Moonsteel Broadswords, 4 Massive Iron Axes, 2 Heavy Mithril Axes, and 2 Big Black Maces.
82662.description:
As a weaponsmith you'll find that more often than not, heroes and adventurers will be coming to you for gear. While the workload can be unbearable at times, the riches more than make up for the back strain and ash lung.

Oh yes, <name>, weaponsmiths are the ones with all the gold!

If you wish to join our ranks, you'll need to show me that you can make me a silver or two - I mean, show me that you've got what it takes to be the go to <guy/girl> when people need superior quality weapons. Get to work!

84147.name: An Earnest Proposition
84147.objective_text: Acquire 15 Winterspring Blood Samples and 20 gold and bring them along with a set of Wildheart Bracers to Deliana in Ironforge.
84147.description:
Well met, <class>.  I've something that might interest you.

I have in my possession a set of armor much like the one worn by those of your profession, but of much higher quality.  I'd be willing to trade the bracers for ordinary ones in exchange for a small favor.

The blood of the frostsabers and bears that inhabit Winterspring has properties I'm in need of at the moment.  Bring me a sizeable sample of it along with the bracers and a small amount of gold.  You shall find the effort worth your while.

84179.objective_text: Return to Deliana in Ironforge with a set of Wildheart Boots, a Wildheart Kilt and Wildheart Spaulders.
84179.description:
Valthalak's soul was stored in this amulet.  In our greed we foolishly split it into three parts, not knowing the curse that would await us.

The only way to stop Valthalak's spell is to put the medallion back together.  Return to Deliana and tell her that Bodley is her only hope for finding the remaining pieces.  Speak to her about any rewards you've arranged for.

I, for once, shall rest in peace.  I wish you the best of luck; you shall need every bit of it!

84324.name: Diplomatic Overtures
84324.objective_text: Gather the supplies and deliver them to High Priestess Laurena in Stormwind Cathedral.
84324.description:
<name>, as I have studied the shard of light you brought, it has granted me visions. I see a priest of the Horde finding a similar shard, and I see the Alliance and Horde coming together in a surge of light.

Unfortunately, our relations with the Horde have continued to decline.

I suggest putting together a diplomatic gift as a gesture of cross-faith goodwill. Bring these supplies to me, and we will see if we can open a dialogue between our people.

84326.objective_text: Bring the requested materials to High Priestess Laurena in Stormwind Cathedral.
84326.description:
The diplomatic gift you assembled has reached the Forsaken priest Dietrich Praice, and I have made discreet contact with them. We both agree this search should be kept among the faithful. If the shards can be used as a weapon, it is best that they not fall into the hands of either faction's leaders.

We have devised a secret means of identification for those seeking the shards. Bring me materials to forge a ring that will contain a sliver of one of the shards.

84881.name: Into the Hold of Shadows
84881.objective_text: Find Caius inside of Shadow Hold, in Felwood, and stop his ritual. In addition, bring proof of his demise to Fahrad at Ravenholdt Manor. You must go alone, and remain unseen until you find Caius.
84881.description:
Caius' betrayal is a troubling wrinkle. It points towards another, more dangerous, organization.

Our intelligence indicates that this may be the Shadow Council.
  
The council's base of operations is Shadow Hold, in Felwood. If our information is correct, Caius' ritual will likely be performed there. You must infiltrate Shadow Hold, find Caius, and stop him.

It is imperative you remain undetected. If Caius catches wind of your presence, he is likely flee, or have you killed.

85446.name: Scale of the Dragon Lord
85446.objective_text: Speak with Riosus and form a plan for how to dispose of the Simulacrum of the Dragon Soul.
85446.description:
<Riosus listens as you recount your tale>

Yes, Garek had the right of it, this is not the true Dragon Soul... and thank the titans for that. I'd feel no more comfortable with a dimwitted mortal like yourself wielding an artifact that powerful than I would the Lord of Blackrock himself. Regardless, this is still dangerous and we should see to its disposal. The original Dragon Soul was not easy to destroy. Come, let us speak of options for the disposal of this lesser simulacrum.

85447.objective_text: Bring the Simulacrum of the Dragon Soul to the leader of the dragon host near the entrance to the fortress of Grim Batol.
85447.description:
Nefarian has long been engaged in experimentation involving the five dragonflights, and it seems this "simulacrum" of the Dragon Soul was one such experiment. I shudder to think of what could come of him successfully emulating even a fraction of the power of the true Dragon Soul. Please, seek out agents of the red dragons near the ruins of Grim Batol. 

I will enchant the simulacrum you carry to mark you as a friend of the red flight.

85454.description: You've done much to defend our brood, <class>. It seems fitting that we repay you with a gift that you may use to continue to defend others. Speak with me when you are ready and we'll destroy this false Dragon Soul together. I believe that I can harness some of the energy released as the simulacrum's magic dissipates along with a bit of my own magic to create something special for you.

85507.objective_text: Find Aeonas near Sorrow Hill in the Western Plaguelands.
85507.description:
I'm glad you are here, <name>. We've got word that a traveler matching the description of our friend Aeonas has been seen near Chillwind Camp, heading in the direction of Sorrow Hill. 

After what happened in felwood I wanted to give him space  but there are those in the order who still distrust him, and at some point he's going to need to come in from the cold to explain why he withheld his prolonged involvement with a known agent of the Lich King. Go and find him, see if you can convince him to come in.

85508.objective_text: Speak with Aeonas before heading back to Stormwind to let Katherine know his answer.
85508.description:
You look like you've grown strong since last we met. I'm very glad. If there's anything I've done right in my life, its saving your life in Felwood and that is a comfort to me.

Anyway, best be getting going back to Katherine now, unless there was anything else you needed to ask me?

85509.objective_text: Speak with Vault Keeper Faranister in the Canal District of Stormwind and return to Katherine when you've learned what you can.

objectives.text: Find out more about the break-in

85509.description: Please make your way over to the southeastern area of the canals and speak with the Vaultkeeper there, Julien Faranister. He can tell you what he knows. Learn what you can about the crime. There were a lot of people who would have wanted to steal that orb, so gathering as much information as we can now while the crime scene is fresh is vital.
