85510.objective_text: Explore some of the more disreputable parts of Stormwind for information on who may have been plotting to rob the vault.
85510.description:
This is undoubtedly a burning blade medallion, which suggests legion cult involvement. As for where to start, you might try to head over to the taverns in the city and try to shake down some of the more unsavory types for information.  

It's not much, but its a start.

85511.name: Plaguelands Rendezvous
85511.objective_text: Find Ada Darkhardt at Caer Darrow in Western Plaguelands.
85511.description:
Of course I expected you to find me here. Why do you think I left those cultist's corpses for you to find in that vault? 

Before you get too worked up; yes the orb is safe. More safe than this city, apparently. If I had entered the vault just a few moments later the orb would have been long gone.

I've said enough for now and this tavern has ears. Find me on the Island of Caer Darrow in Western Plaguelands. You'll get answers when you arrive.

85555.name: Heavy Metal
85555.objective_text: Find someone who can work with exotic metals and is willing to help you crate something special with this chunk of elementium.
85555.description:
The large flat disc of elementium you hold before you seems to thrum with elemental energy. When you hold it you can almost hear the elemental spirits whispering to you. You aren't sure what use you can find for this, but the connection you feel to it is instantaneous.  

With a little work from a sufficiently talented smith able to work with the mysterious metal known as elementium, you suspect that this could be made into a weapon or piece of armor.

85556.name: A Particular Set of Skills
85556.objective_text: Find a way to get into Blackwing Lair and speak with Master Elemental Shaper Krixix without engaging him in combat.
85556.description:
Krixix is a genius for sure, but he may not be too friendly if you just storm into that mountain demanding his help, to say nothing of the goons that place is likely crawling with. You'll probably want to find a way to get to him without burning the place down along the way which is likely to be pretty tricky. 

If you can figure out a way to get in there without stabbing, shocking, or burning anyone that is probably a good start. I've got no real ideas myself on how to do that though, so good luck!

85605.name: Paragons of Power: The Augur's Bracers
85605.objective_text:
Bring Maywiki of Zuldazar a Primal Hakkari Armsplint.  You must also have a reputation equal to or greater than Friendly with the Zandalar Tribe.

Maywiki of Zuldazar is located on Yojamba Isle, Stranglethorn Vale.
85605.description:
The augurs of our tribe are revered for their gifts of the divine sight, ya mon.  They ain't a witch doctor; they spend their time castin' bones or readin' the leaves for insight - not hexin' people.  As a shaman, you already know somethin' about the power of augury; we Zandalar prize the insight they give to the tribe.

Bring me an offerin' of the Paragons of Power from inside Zul'Gurub and prove your worth to us.  Do this for us, and I'll give ya some bracers that our augurs prize above all others!

85606.objective_text:
Bring Maywiki of Zuldazar a Primal Hakkari Girdle.  You must also have a reputation equal to or greater than Honored with the Zandalar Tribe.

Maywiki of Zuldazar is located on Yojamba Isle, Stranglethorn Vale.
85606.description:
Augurs know the mojo of the elements, mon.  They use it as a means to guide the tribe to glory.  In the dark days after the Gurubashi Empire ripped itself up, our augurs led us to our safe haven in the South Seas.  They've also led us back here to the Vale, right back to the heart of evil brewin' in Zul'Gurub.

Bring me an offerin' of the Paragons of Power from inside Zul'Gurub and prove your worth to us.  Do it and I'll give ya a belt that our augurs use - one with powerful mojo inside it!

Maywiki of Zuldazar is located on Yojamba Isle, Stranglethorn Vale.
85607.description:
The augurs of the Zandalar all wear a distinctive chest piece called a hauberk.  It's fitted with the finest of silks and cloths, interwoven with strong chain.  It's a symbol of not only their divinity, but also of their authority, mon.  It's never wise to cross one whose life is devoted to speakin' with the spirits...

Bring me an offerin' of the Paragons of Power from inside Zul'Gurub and prove your worth to us.  Do it and I'll give ya one of the finest hauberks our augurs would ever hope to wear!

85609.description:

We Zandalar know not of druidic ways; nature is to be shaped by our need, not the other way around.  Still, a haruspex is the one of us most in tune with nature, and rightly so.  To give up the ghost of a beastie is to know what it is to be one of them.  That is the real power of nature.

Bring me an offerin' of the Paragons of Power from inside Zul'Gurub, proving yourself to us.  Do this, and I'll give ya a powerful item - a belt used by many of the Zandalar's haruspices.

Strong mojo, ya mon!

85611.description:
The ultimate symbol of a haruspex's power is what they wear, <name>.  Of these, the tunic symbolizes the connection between themselves and the divine wisdom they seek.  It often weaves parts of the beasties they sacrifice into the tunic; this reminds them of the connection they have to their gifts.

Bring me an offerin' of the Paragons of Power from inside Zul'Gurub and prove your worth to us.  Do this, and a tunic seeping with the true power of a haruspex is yours.

85613.objective_text:
Bring Jin'rokh the Breaker a Primal Hakkari Armsplint.  You must also have a reputation equal to or greater than Friendly with the Zandalar Tribe.

Jin'rokh the Breaker is located on Yojamba Isle, Stranglethorn Vale.
85613.description:
Vengeance is power.  The Zandalar vindicator is such power.  The tribe has many enemies.  The vindicator exacts retribution on them.  No crime against us is unpunished.  The vindicator delivers this punishment.  Our enemies fear our vengeance.  They should.  They forever will.

Become one of our vindicators.  Seek the Paragons of Power inside Zul'Gurub.  Slay the minions of Hakkar and claim vengeance in the tribe's name.  You will be rewarded.

85614.objective_text:
Bring Jin'rokh the Breaker a Primal Hakkari Girdle.  You must also have a reputation equal to or greater than Honored with the Zandalar Tribe.

Jin'rokh the Breaker is located on Yojamba Isle, Stranglethorn Vale.
85614.description:
The ultimate vengeance waits within Zul'Gurub.  Hakkar must not rise again.  Hakkar destroyed the Gurubashi Empire from within.  No sacrifice was enough.  The trolls are a shadow of former glories.  I know this is because of Hakkar.

Become the vindicator you were meant to be.  Wreak havoc on the minions of evil.  Zul'Gurub must taste Zandalar vengeance.  Bring me proof in the Paragons of Power.  You will receive the vindicator's belt.  You will receive real power.

Go.

85615.objective_text:
Bring Jin'rokh the Breaker a Primal Hakkari Kossack.  You must also have a reputation equal to or greater than Revered with the Zandalar Tribe.

Jin'rokh the Breaker is located on Yojamba Isle, Stranglethorn Vale.
85615.description:
The vindicator's symbol of power is the breastplate.  It is forged with powerful mojo.  It is trusted only to those we revere.  It is the Zandalar symbol of vengeance.

To become a vindicator is to become vengeance.  Take the Paragons of Power we need from Zul'Gurub.  Bring them to us.  We will take the mojo stolen from us.  We will make the minions of Hakkar pay.  We will reward you with the vindicator's breastplate.

Go.  Be our vengeance, <name>.

85618.name: Paragons of Power: The Freethinker's Armguards
85618.objective_text:
Bring Jin'rokh the Breaker Primal Hakkari Bindings.  You must also have a reputation equal to or greater than Friendly with the Zandalar Tribe.

Jin'rokh the Breaker is located on Yojamba Isle, Stranglethorn Vale.
85618.description:
You are a heathen.  Heathens have a place in the tribe.  Heathens are freethinkers of Zandalar.  Freethinkers do not fear oppression.  Freethinkers die for what they believe in.  We know you would die for what you believe in.  This earns our acknowledgement.  This earns you a chance to prove yourself further.

We must have the Paragons of Power.  Go to Zul'Gurub.  Kill the minions of Hakkar.  Return when you have what I seek.  Claim the first battle gear of a Zandalar freethinker.

Go.

85619.name: Paragons of Power: The Freethinker's Belt
85619.objective_text:
Bring Jin'rokh the Breaker a Primal Hakkari Shawl.  You must also have a reputation equal to or greater than Honored with the Zandalar Tribe.

Jin'rokh the Breaker is located on Yojamba Isle, Stranglethorn Vale.
85619.description:
Your beliefs are alien to us, heathen.  Ancient Zandalar were once branded as heretics.  This was when the Gurubashi Empire was strong.  Heathens dared to challenge the priest of Hakkar.  Heathens then were hunted and killed as vermin.  Those heathens never wavered in their fight against the Blood God.  We honor the price they paid.  They are the freethinkers.

Destroy the minions of Hakkar in Zul'Gurub.  Bring me the Paragons of Power I seek.  Success will be greatly rewarded.

Go.

85620.name: Paragons of Power: The Freethinker's Breastplate
85620.objective_text:
Bring Jin'rokh the Breaker a Primal Hakkari Tabard.  You must also have a reputation equal to or greater than Revered with the Zandalar Tribe.

Jin'rokh the Breaker is located on Yojamba Isle, Stranglethorn Vale.
85620.description:
Battle gear gives you power in the tribe.  The freethinkers are honored in this way.  They are zealots.  They imbue their breastplates with powerful mojo.  If their beliefs falter in the face of the enemy, their breastplate will not.

You must be revered amongst us to possess such a breastplate.  Go to Zul'Gurub.  Take the Paragons of Power I need.  Take the Paragons most painfully from the fools inside.  Bring them to me.  Prove your worth as a freethinker once and for all.

85622.name: Paragons of Power: The Confessor's Wraps
85622.objective_text:
Bring Al'tabim the All-Seeing a Primal Hakkari Stanchion.  You must also have a reputation equal to or greater than Friendly with the Zandalar Tribe.

Al'tabim the All-Seeing is located on Yojamba Isle, Stranglethorn Vale.
85622.description:
We Zandalar invest power in those who speak with the authority of divinity.  Our priests are more than just healers - they are our confessors.  Evil comes both from outside threats - such as Hakkar - and from within the tribe.  Our confessors act as the judges amongst us, preserving us from the same evil that devoured the Gurubashi from inside itself.

Go to Zul'Gurub and bring back the Paragons of Power from the Gurubashi.  Learn what it means to be the confessor, and preserve us from evil.

85623.name: Paragons of Power: The Confessor's Bindings
85623.objective_text:
Bring Al'tabim the All-Seeing a Primal Hakkari Sash.  You must also have a reputation equal to or greater than Honored with the Zandalar Tribe.

Al'tabim the All-Seeing is located on Yojamba Isle, Stranglethorn Vale.
85623.description:
Shortly after the fall of the Gurubashi, we Zandalar almost succumbed to a final defeat from evil within our own tribe.  It was then that the confessors amongst us arose, preserving the tribe by banishing out those who would destroy their own kind.  They not only keep us in tune with the spirits, but they also preserve the flesh.

Go forth into Zul'Gurub and witness first hand the depravity of Hakkar and the Gurubashi.  Wrest the Paragons of Power that we seek from them; success will be rewarded!

85624.objective_text:
Bring Al'tabim the All-Seeing a Primal Hakkari Aegis.  You must also have a reputation equal to or greater than Revered with the Zandalar Tribe.

Al'tabim the All-Seeing is located on Yojamba Isle, Stranglethorn Vale.
85624.description:
The confessors of the Zandalar all wear a distinctive mantle, marking them as the preservers of the tribe.  These mantles are woven with powerful mojo that aids them in judging those who would threaten our tribe.  As a priest, you too must spend your time judging those worthy and not; such a mantle would definitely be a blessing to you.

In exchange for fighting Hakkar's minions in Zul'Gurub and bringing me the Paragons of Power I seek, I will give you a mantle worthy of our finest confessors.

85626.objective_text:
Bring Al'tabim the All-Seeing a Primal Hakkari Stanchion.  You must also have a reputation equal to or greater than Friendly with the Zandalar Tribe.

Al'tabim the All-Seeing is located on Yojamba Isle, Stranglethorn Vale.
85626.description:
Warlocks tread dangerous ground in dealing with demons, but our demoniacs take this one step further.  Through an ancient and arcane ritual, they allow a demon to enter their being.  Rather than let it possess them though, they enslave the demon from the inside, absorbing the power of the beast for their own command.  It is a feat few are ever able to master.

For you to learn of the power of the demoniac, I must have Paragons of Power from Zul'Gurub.  Go there and retrieve that which we seek.

85627.objective_text:
Bring Al'tabim the All-Seeing a Primal Hakkari Sash.  You must also have a reputation equal to or greater than Honored with the Zandalar Tribe.

Al'tabim the All-Seeing is located on Yojamba Isle, Stranglethorn Vale.
85627.description:
The demoniac seeks to embody power outright, not just possess it.  More than one of our demoniacs has lost a fight with a demon; with our enemies threatening us - especially in Zul'Gurub - the power that a demoniac is able to unleash on our foes is worth the sacrifice.  Our survival depends on crushing those who would destroy us; the fall of the Gurubashi Empire taught us this.

Travel to Zul'Gurub and gain the Paragons of Power we need.  Do this, and a valuable demoniac item shall be yours.

85628.objective_text:
Bring Al'tabim the All-Seeing a Primal Hakkari Kossack.  You must also have a reputation equal to or greater than Revered with the Zandalar Tribe.

Al'tabim the All-Seeing is located on Yojamba Isle, Stranglethorn Vale.
85628.description:
The ultimate symbol of power amongst the tribe is the garb we wear in battle.  A demoniac's robes have fused fine runecloth and devastatingly powerful mojo into a single fabric.  The visage of the robe is said to instill fear into the minds of all who see it... especially the demons that the demoniac will eventually dominate.

From Zul'Gurub, you must bring me a very specific set of the Paragons of Power.  It will be difficult... but your success will assure you of acquiring a robe for yourself.

85630.objective_text:
Bring Al'tabim the All-Seeing Primal Hakkari Bindings.  You must also have a reputation equal to or greater than Friendly with the Zandalar Tribe.

Al'tabim the All-Seeing is located on Yojamba Isle, Stranglethorn Vale.
85630.description:
Mages in our tribe are known as illusionists.  They employ powerful mojo in their incantations, often befuddling and confusing the tribe's enemies!

<Al'tabim laughs wickedly.>

It is quite the sight to see a powerful illusionist at work, bringing our enemies to their knees from their own madness!

For you to know the way of our illusionists, go to Zul'Gurub and bring back to me selected Paragons of Power.  For this, I will give you arm wraps our illusionists use to weave their spells.

notShown: Rewards: no longer Zandalar Illusionist's Wraps, Zandalar Tribe +150 reputation

notShown: Rewards: no longer Zandalar Illusionist's Mantle, Zandalar Tribe +150 reputation

85631.name: Paragons of Power: The Illusionist's Mantle
85631.objective_text:
Bring Al'tabim the All-Seeing a Primal Hakkari Shawl.  You must also have a reputation equal to or greater than Honored with the Zandalar Tribe.

Al'tabim the All-Seeing is located on Yojamba Isle, Stranglethorn Vale.
85631.description:
Magic is a raw, primal force to be shaped by those strong enough to do it.  Mojo is our extension of this power; one such potent manipulation of it is in the form of illusion.  How can one truly hope to win against a foe that is not even really there?  We Zandalar know the power of this, and as such illusionists hold a honored place within the tribe.

Take the needed Paragons of Power from Zul'Gurub - for this, honor from the tribe and a powerful mantle used by our best illusionists will be yours!

list.name: Paragons of Power: The Illusionist's Mantle

notShown: Rewards: no longer Zandalar Illusionist's Mantle, Zandalar Tribe +150 reputation

notShown: Rewards: no longer Zandalar Illusionist's Robe, Zandalar Tribe +150 reputation

85632.objective_text:
Bring Al'tabim the All-Seeing a Primal Hakkari Kossack.  You must also have a reputation equal to or greater than Revered with the Zandalar Tribe.

Al'tabim the All-Seeing is located on Yojamba Isle, Stranglethorn Vale.
85632.description:
The tribe acknowledges station and power through what we wear.  Our vestments are made from the finest of materials, and interwoven with the mojo we use to make us powerful.  Illusionists are no exception; their robes are said to embody the essence of illusion in their look.  Legend states that their ancient robes never looked the same twice.

I will give you an illusionist's robe, <name>... but earn your place of reverence among the tribe first!  Bring me the Paragons of Power from Zul'Gurub!

85634.objective_text:
Bring Falthir the Sightless a Primal Hakkari Armsplint.  You must also have a reputation equal to or greater than Friendly with the Zandalar Tribe.

Falthir the Sightless is located on Yojamba Isle, Stranglethorn Vale.
85634.description:
The madcaps of Zandalar are similar to rogues, but above all else they embrace madness... chaos... the unpredictability of existence.  A terror to behold on the battlefield, they sowed the seeds of confusion and mayhem amongst our enemies in the savage times after the tribes splintered.  We would not be here today without them.

Bring to me the Paragons of Power from Zul'Gurub that I seek, and I will grant you the first of the madcap's prized armors.  Embrace the madness!

notShown: Rewards: no longer Zandalar Madcap's Bracers, Zandalar Tribe +150 reputation

notShown: Rewards: no longer Zandalar Madcap's Mantle, Zandalar Tribe +150 reputation

85635.name: Paragons of Power: The Madcap's Mantle
85635.objective_text:
Bring Falthir the Sightless a Primal Hakkari Girdle.  You must also have a reputation equal to or greater than Honored with the Zandalar Tribe.

Falthir the Sightless is located on Yojamba Isle, Stranglethorn Vale.
85635.description:
One of Zandalar's legendary madcaps was Khar'vaxal the Cracked.  Legend states that when facing the enemies of the tribe for the first time, Kar'xavan used his mantle specifically woven with "the weave of madness".  His form was shrouded not only by the mantle, but also with the blinding speed of his twin daggers.  Madcaps today cherish their mantle as a sign of their place in the tribe.

Bring to me the Paragons of Power I seek, and such a mantle will be yours to weave madness unto your own enemies.

list.name: Paragons of Power: The Madcap's Mantle

lines: Rewards: no longer Zandalar Madcap's Mantle, Zandalar Tribe +150 reputation
notShown: Rewards: no longer Zandalar Madcap's Mantle, Zandalar Tribe +150 reputation

notShown: Rewards: no longer Zandalar Madcap's Tunic, Zandalar Tribe +150 reputation

85636.objective_text:
Bring Falthir the Sightless a Primal Hakkari Aegis.  You must also have a reputation equal to or greater than Revered with the Zandalar Tribe.

Falthir the Sightless is located on Yojamba Isle, Stranglethorn Vale.
85636.description:
My eyes failed me long ago, but I do not miss them.  Even in a tribe such as ours - where one's vestments convey station and purpose - the most potent of garb exudes power that simple eyes cannot see.  The prized tunic of the Zandalar madcap is no exception, exuding the raw power of chaos and madness that they are able to channel.

The Paragons of Power I need lie in Zul'Gurub; bring me what I seek, and I will reward you with your own legendary tunic... one befitting a weaver of madness.

85638.objective_text:
Bring the following Paragons of Power from Zul'Gurub to Falthir the Sightless: A Primal Hakkari Bindings.  You must also have a reputation equal to or greater than Friendly with the Zandalar Tribe.

Falthir the Sightless is located on Yojamba Isle, Stranglethorn Vale.
85638.description:
In the dark times after the fall of the Gurubashi Empire, Zandalar predators used their prowess to provide sustenance for the tribe.  Hunters claim to be much like our tribe's predators - to seek the hunt is to embody the essence of the predator, yes.  Your hunt in Zul'Gurub, however, will show us how you truly rate amongst our finest predators.

Bring to me a sampling of the Paragons of Power from within Zul'Gurub.  Do so, and you'll take first steps in becoming the penultimate predator.

Falthir the Sightless is located on Yojamba Isle, Stranglethorn Vale.
85639.description:
A predator knows how to stalk their prey, but a successful one knows how to strike at it once they have closed ranks.  You must master both to have any chance of success in Zul'Gurub... and any chance of being like the Zandalar predators.

Bring me choice parts of the Paragons of Power from within Zul'Gurub.  My reward will be the power that the trinkets yield, while yours will be the Zandalar predator's belt - equipment well worth the trade.

85640.objective_text:
Bring the following Paragons of Power from Zul'Gurub to Falthir the Sightless: A Primal Hakkari Aegis.  You must also have a reputation equal to or greater than Revered with the Zandalar Tribe.

Falthir the Sightless is located on Yojamba Isle, Stranglethorn Vale.
85640.description:
We Zandalar prize what we wear as a symbol of accomplishment.  You don't need to be able to see what one wears to be able to sense what emanates from it - power transcends sight.  The garments of the Zandalar predator are like this, and most cherished by them is the mantle they wear.  It helps to obfuscate them from view... and to make their presence known when they wish it.

The Paragons of Power await your retrieval in Zul'Gurub.  Bring me what I seek, and the predator's mantle shall be yours.

85704.name: Elemental Leatherworking
85704.objective_text:
Bring 2 Heart of Fire, 2 Globe of Water, 2 Core of Earth, and 2 Breath of Wind to Brumn Winterhoof in the Arathi Mountains.

Completing this quest will give you access to the Elemental Leatherworking arts.

The completion of this quest will prevent you from learning Dragonscale Leatherworking and Tribal Leatherworking; be sure this is the path you wish to follow before doing so.
85704.description:
Elemental leatherworking is what I know, and if you're willing to open your mind to the greater powers of substance, I will share with you all there is to learn.

Know this, <class>: by choosing this path you agree never to learn dragonscale or tribal leatherworking; there is only room for practice of one of the three arts.  Furthermore, I'll need adequate proof that you are in tune with the elements of nature; to that end, bring me the purest essences of fire, water, earth, and wind.

85706.name: Tribal Leatherworking
85706.objective_text:
Bring a Wild Leather Vest and a Wild Leather Helmet to Se'Jib in Stranglethorn Vale.

Completing this quest will give you access to the Tribal Leatherworking arts.

The completion of this quest will prevent you from learning Dragonscale Leatherworking and Elemental Leatherworking; be sure this is the path you wish to follow before doing so.
85706.description:
To learn tribal leatherworking demands an understanding of how primal nature truly is; I know that you have already mastered the art of making wild leather armor, and I am willing to complete your training.

Know this, <class>: by choosing this path you agree never to learn dragonscale or elemental leatherworking; there is only room for practice of one of the three arts.  Furthermore, bring to me the finest samples of your wild leather armor.  From there, we will begin your mastery.

86574.name: Stonetalon Supply Run
86574.objective_text: Collect 6 Stonetalon Supplies from Pridewing Wyverns and deliver them to Innkeeper Faralia.
86574.description:
<The unfortunate body here bears the marks of many strikes from the Pridewing wyverns. The pack nearby is rumpled and discarded, with its contents missing, and only a small note clutched in the courier's hand to indicate what was lost: a shipment meant for Innkeeper Faralia at Stonetalon Peak.>

<The wyverns have probably carried off the supply bundles to line their nests.>

86576.name: Bloodfury Trinkets
86576.description:
In addition to spreading their filth across the Charred Vale, the Bloodfury harpies gather anything shiny that they can find. I'm told that they collect a variety of golden-yellow sunstones for decoration. I have no use for such trinkets, but Mor'rogal has mentioned using them before.

While you're fighting the harpies of the Vale, keep your eye out for Glittering Sunstones. Bring any that you find to Mor'rogal, up on the hills above us.

86585.name: Banner of the Fallen
86585.objective_text: Raise the standard of Ironforge, call out the trogg Headsplitter and kill it, then report to Captain Rugelfuss.
86585.description:
The fallen mountaineer bears a standard of Ironforge. Perhaps she was scouting, or making a doomed charge. Either way, the standard has been cast down and trampled. The mountaineer was hit on the head so hard that her helm was knocked off and she was killed outright by a trogg, likely with a spiked club.

The trogg that killed her is probably still nearby, and likely remembers the banner. Raising the banner of Ironforge once more may call it out.
comments: Pick the banner up and plunk it down exactly where you found it, next to Mountaineer Ylva. A wave of level 12-14 troggs will start entering the cave from both sides one to two mobs at a time. Clear these waves, and Headsplitter (level 16) will spawn and run towards you. The banner has only a 30 second cooldown and it doesn't disappear upon use, so if you miss the tag, you can just attempt again.

86613.name: Excavation Tools
86613.objective_text: Return 6 Excavation Tools to Magmar Fellhew.
86613.description: The excavation's tools, left behind when the dwarves fled from the troggs, seem mostly untouched. Returning them to the excavators will surely aid their work.

start.name: Object #665289 (unnamed, e.g. a poster or crate)

86614.name: Silver of the Waves
86614.objective_text: Return the monogrammed silver hair clip to its owner.
86614.description: <Among the fishing knickknacks in the debris are some rusty hooks, broken spools of wire, and a slightly corroded but ornate silver hair clip with the monogram "K.D.">
comments:
This new WoW: Forever quest starts from an underwater object in the Loch itself. For me, the exact location was 48.9, 54.2. Look for a wrecked wooden boat at the bottom of the lake toward the southern end of the lake. In the same exact location I also found a Battered Chest.

I was able to loot it without pulling any of the level 19-20 threshadons at level 13, so it's a nice source for some green

86667.name: Snowbound
86667.objective_text: Deliver a Jar of Snow to Norric Lochthane.
86667.description:
My old mentor, Norric, sent a minor elemental with an odd request. He needs a jar of snow for some of his shamanic workings! I don't know what he's going to do with that, but I learned a long time ago not to question his ways with respect to magic.

I'm busy settling in and learning about the local elementals, so I can't leave to help him. Could you do this for me? Head over to South Gate Pass where there's snow year-round. Scoop some up in this ceramic jar and bring it to him before it melts.
comments: You have 10 minutes to deliver the jar of snow once you fill it

86758.name: Twisting the Knife
86758.objective_text: Find and defeat the crocolisk Daggerfang and bring back Marek's knife.
86758.description:
Did I ever tell you how I almost lost me hand to a crocolisk? Managed to jam me knife into its jaw, and scrambled out real quick. I thought I had the knife around here somewhere, but I can't seem to find it.

Anyway, that croc is probably still out there hunting along the edge of the lake. That nasty brute probably needs to go, for the safety of the other hunters, if nothing else.

I've taken to calling it Daggerfang. If you see it, give it a friendly hello from me! And by "hello" I mean "stab."

86776.name: Ingredients for the Forge
86776.objective_text: Bring 10 Bronze Bars to Morhan Coppertongue.
86776.description:
Thelsamar's a great place to live, but we don't have all of the amenities of Ironforge. I'm always running out of bronze! I need more bronze if I'm going to keep making tools and kettles and pots!

I can tell you have a little experience at the forge. Think you could smelt me some bronze bars? I can pay you well for it!

87288.name: Soft Saber Pelts
87288.objective_text: Bring 6 Soft Nightsaber Pelts to Aldria.
87288.description:
Hello, traveler! I hope you are enjoying your visit to our village. I like Dolanaar because it is small and rustic and everyone is friendly.

I'm a local trader, and I bring in all sorts of tools and trinkets that might be useful to you in your travels. Indeed, if you are interested in a trade, I find myself in need of some nightsaber pelts. While these majestic creatures are beautiful, the local ones are rather aggressive, so don't feel too bad about defending yourself.

87760.objective_text: Find a Stormscale Beastmistress, slay her, and bring back her Rod of Deep Dominion.
87760.description:
I have received word back from Darnassus, <name>!

From the animal samples, we learned that the naga dominated these sea creatures to use as unwilling mounts and beasts of burden. The ones that were too obstinate, or too old or badly injured, they drove out for sport. Monstrous!

It is our sacred duty to put a stop to this!

The naga have forces in the Ruins of Mathystra, and they must be seizing threshers from off the shore. Find their beastmistress, slay her, and bring back her tools of domination!

89474.name: Forgiveness
89474.objective_text: Travel to the Scarlet Monastery in Tirisfal Glades. Enter the monastery's cathedral while wielding the Corrupted Ashbringer and bear witness to what occurs there.
89474.description:
Alexandros Mograine was murdered by his son and the weight of that betrayal is a shackle around his very soul. The Ashbringer was as much the man as the sword itself, and the blade will not find peace until the spirit of Alexandros himself does. Take the weapon to the Scarlet Monastery cathedral in Tirisfal Glades. Once there confront Mograine's son, the Scarlet Commander. 

Mograine must find the will to forgive for this to truly end.

lines: Rewards: no longer Argent Dawn +200 reputation

89475.name: The Lonely Path of the Damned
89475.objective_text:
Speak with Lord Maxwell Tyrosus at Light's Hope Chapel. 

You should stow the Corrupted Ashbringer in your bags, or else the members of the Argent Dawn may react with hostility upon seeing the tainted weapon.
89475.description:
<The spirit standing before you shows no awareness of your presence. After a moment, you realize that Lord Maxwell Tyrosus will want to know what occurred here. You should return to Light's Hope chapel and speak with him.>

<You suspect that the Argent Crusaders may not be too excited to see you carrying the Ashbringer in its current, twisted form. You may want to keep the blade out of sight when you approach.>

series.name: The Lonely Path of the Damned

list.name: The Lonely Path of the Damned

lines: Rewards: no longer Argent Dawn +200 reputation
notShown: Rewards: no longer Argent Dawn +200 reputation

lines: Rewards: no longer Recipe: Discolored Healing Potion, Recipe: Major Discolored Healing Potion
notShown: Rewards: no longer Recipe: Discolored Healing Potion, Recipe: Major Discolored Healing Potion

90567.name: Unfamiliar Foulness
90567.objective_text: Gather Discolored Beast Hearts and Bleeding Hearts from the plaguelands. Bring them and the Mishandled Healing Potion to an interested alchemist in Darnassus.
90567.description:
<You have found a vial of foul, viscous liquid on a laboratory table. It was surrounded by various ingredients that have been meticulously measured and diced into careful portions. Though the herbs are unidentifiable, one undamaged and discolored beast heart rested nearby.

Alchemists in Darnassus might have an idea of how to tap into whatever restorative properties might be present in the potion. You should also bring them some flowers, as to not come barreling into a shop with just a pile of hearts.>

lines: Rewards: no longer Recipe: Discolored Healing Potion, Recipe: Major Discolored Healing Potion
notShown: Rewards: no longer Recipe: Discolored Healing Potion, Recipe: Major Discolored Healing Potion

91723.name: Delicate Instruments
91723.objective_text: Kill 8 Kobold Geomancers in Jasperlode Mine, then return to Hamish Bergwort in the Tower of Azora.
91723.description:
Blast it! Every time I try to calibrate these sensitive arcane instruments, they get thrown off again by a surge of energy.
The surges seem to be coming from the north, where those primitive Kobolds have been practicing their crude magic. Could you clear some of them out, so I can continue my work?

91724.name: Delicate Instruments
91724.objective_text: Kill 6 Defias Rogue Wizards at Stone Cairn Lake, then return to Hamish Bergwort in the Tower of Azora.
91724.description:
Almost there, and... By the Nether! Something is still disrupting my instruments.
This is most frustrating, <name>. I have heard rumors that the local bandits have been practicing spells near Stone Cairn Lake. Maybe if you stop them, these disruptions will finally cease and I can get some work done?

91725.name: Stolen Enchanting Supplies
91725.objective_text: Collect 5 Stolen Enchanting Supplies from gnoll camps around Stone Cairn Lake, then return to Blixie Fitzwink near the Tower of Azora.
91725.description:
I was sent by Master Theocritus to pick up some enchanting supplies from the trading post, but on the way back I was ambushed by a pack of gnolls!

I dropped the package and escaped, but if I return without it, I'll be cleaning up after the polymorph experiments for weeks as punishment! Do you think you could find the supplies for me?

91732.name: Good Steel
91732.objective_text: Collect 4 Mining Tools from Jasperlode Mine, then return to Hagar Lowe in Eastvale Logging Camp.
91732.description: Good steel is in short supply after the war, and our tools have suffered for it. The Jasperlode miners used finely-crafted picks, and I imagine some of them are still there in the depths of the mine. Could you retrieve some for me, and I'll see if I can repurpose the steel?

91733.name: Downstream
91733.objective_text: Collect the Waterlogged Axe, Waterlogged Saw, and Waterlogged Toolbox that have washed downstream from Eastvale Logging Camp, then return to Ormin Pelford.
91733.description:
I was bringing back a supply shipment from the trading post, but my wagon tipped over and the supplies fell in the river! Before I could catch them, they had already washed downstream.
Between the murlocs and wolves down there, I don't stand a chance of retrieving the supplies on my own. You seem like the hardy sort - do you think you could find them for me?
comments: Locations: Axe 77, 82 / Toolbox 77, 86 (at the boat) / Saw 74, 76

The 3 items is down stream from the bridge. Follow the River on the left side for best view of the items and less mobs.

First you will find the SAW at /way 74.3, 76.3
- by the big rock & riverplants

Second is the AXE at /way 76.8, 82.4
- Its on the island where the river splits.

Third is the toolbox at /way 77.3, 86.9
- Underwater in the big river between Elwynn Forest and Duskwood.
There is a river in front of Soldier Thomas,  saw is beside the second big stone.

start.name: Object #562131 (unnamed, e.g. a poster or crate)

end.name: Object #562131 (unnamed, e.g. a poster or crate)

91736.name: Applejack Still
comments: You have to do a little bit of climbing to get to the Applejack Still, path starts at 28, 59. Turn in 4 Shiny Red Apple and you get Thunder Applejack. Hold onto the item, take it to Sergeant De Vries (enter the building and turn left) at Westbrook Garrison to start An Apple Treat.

91740.name: Croaky's Head
91740.objective_text: Deliver Croaky's Head to Merell Ross at Ridgepoint Tower.
91740.description: This murloc has no doubt been terrorizing the local roads for some time. You suspect the nearby watch guards will want to know of its demise.
comments: I dont think this quest exists in the beta. I found Merell Ross and she doesn't have a quest available.

91741.name: Nibbled-On Book
91741.objective_text: Return the book to Brother Paxton.
91741.description:
<One of the kobolds dropped this book. It looks like the kobold might have tried to eat it.

Brother Paxton inside the abbey has a small library he maintains. The book must have come from there.>

91743.name: Rascally Rodents
91743.objective_text: Retrieve 8 Stolen Books from kobolds in Northshire Valley and return them to Brother Paxton.
91743.description: Those awful kobolds are eating my books! You have to get them back before they devour my whole library.

91745.name: Mining Consultant
91745.objective_text: Talk to Kelsey Fargo outside the Echo Ridge Mine in Northshire Valley.
91745.description: Go talk to the new mining apprentice, Kelsey Fargo. She works right outside the mine and has probably seen what the kobolds are up to. Maybe she can teach you a thing or two about mining while you're at it.

91746.name: Elmpaw's Head
91746.objective_text: Deliver Elmpaw's Head to Helene Peltskinner near Goldshire.
91746.description: The trophy serves as an impressive reminder of your victory over Elmpaw. A local hunter or skinner might be interested to hear the story.

91751.name: Rough Wolf Pelts
91751.objective_text: Skin wolves around Elwynn Forest to obtain 7 Rough Wolf Pelts, then deliver them to Helene Peltskinner near Goldshire.
91751.description: Are you looking for an opportunity to practice skinning? My husband usually helps with hunting wolves, but he's busy up by the abbey. I could use a hand collecting more pelts to finish the orders I'm working on.

91752.name: The Big Picture
91752.objective_text: Retrieve a Sack of "Picture" Books from Shinyfinder Narf. Bring the sack to Marshal McBride just inside Northshire's Abbey.
91752.description:
Every once in a while, a kobold comes through yelling "Picture for Narf!" I don't know who Narf is. Maybe one of the head kobolds at the back of the mine? I bet he has a whole sack of books by now.

Go get those books and bring them to our local law enforcement, Marshal McBride. You should find a friend to help. Those kobolds inside the mine are a lot meaner.

91753.name: An Enchanting Lesson
91753.objective_text:
Kitta Firewind in the Tower of Azora wants you to collect 3 Luminous Residue.

Luminous Residue can be obtained by disenchanting Crude Wax Effigies dropped by Kobold Geomancers.
91753.description:
Academic rigor is of course essential to the enchanter's craft, but a practical foundation can pay dividends. Consider, as an example, the lowly Kobold. Lacking formal education, they nevertheless demonstrate a sort of innate aptitude for simple cantrips and enchantments.

Obtain some of their wax effigies and deconstruct the enchantments bound within them. You may find it elucidating.

91758.name: Follow That Kobold!
91758.objective_text: Speak to Tordrin Sternblade near the stable behind Northshire's Abbey.
91758.description:
You're not done with those kobolds yet. We just got word from Kelsey that a kobold left the mine carrying a large sack of books. I need you to track down this kobold so we can retrieve the books for Brother Paxton.

Go talk to Tordrin Sternblade. He's the new Hunter trainer that just arrived from Ironforge. You can find him behind the abbey, near the stable. He can help you track this kobold thief.

91772.name: Shhh! We're Hunting Kobolds
91772.objective_text: Follow the kobold tracks and report to Marshal Dughan in Goldshire with your findings and the Kobold Tracking Kit.
91772.description:
Alright. Take this kobold tracking kit. It'll let ye' track the kobold that Marshal McBride is concerned with.

Follow the tracks and bring what ye' find to Marshal Dughan in Goldshire.

I have a feelin' these varmints are up to somethin' outside Northshire. So ye'll be needin' Dughan's help.

91775.name: Book Return
91775.objective_text: Find 6 Lost Books and "Fun with Elementals" and return them to Marshal Dughan.
91775.description:
While you're investigating the Fargodeep Mine, see if you can find any of Brother Paxton's books to return. In particular, Paxton is very concerned about a book titled, "Fun with Elementals". He thinks even a kobold could use it to summon an elemental servant. Be warned, the depths of the mine are fairly dangerous. You should bring friends.

Take this book bag to protect the books when you find them!
comments:
this appears to leave the book bag quest item in your bags, but it does not seem to have any later use

you can most likely delete it

The elementals book drops off named kobold named Nimsy (not the other one named Goldtooth). Enter in the top entrance of the mine, and from the large room in the mine, go east and curve north up the stairs. He's up there with some henchmen. Probably can't solo at appropriate level.

91777.name: Rare Books
91777.objective_text: Recover "Geomancy for Curious Young Wizards" and "Arcane Explainer: Magical Stuff in Simple Words" and return them to Brother Paxton inside Northshire's Abbey.

objectives.text: Arcane Explainer: Magical Stuff in Simple Words

91777.description:
There's just two books left missing on Brother Paxton's list: "Geomancy for Curious Young Wizards" and "Arcane Explainer: Magical Stuff in Simple Words".

The kobolds must have taken them to the Jasperlode Mine. Please track down those two books and bring them back to Brother Paxton.

But I'm afraid it will be quite dangerous. If the "apprentice" kobold was summoning an elemental, who knows what the master can do. I'd bring some friends if I were you.

248004.name: Arcane Explainer: Magical Stuff in Simple Words

92109.name: My First Alchemy Set
92109.objective_text: Gather 5 Empty Vials, 5 Silverleaf, and 5 Peacebloom to the young, aspiring alchemist inside the barn of Moonbrook in Westfall.
92109.description:
Erm... 'Ello, <mister/miss>. I'm not supposed to talk to strangers, but... Hey, what are those shiny bottles sticking out of your backpack for? Are you an alchemist? That's so cool!

When I grow up, I want to be an alchemist too. Daddy won't let me play with any of his herbs; too dangerous, he says.

Well, I want to start learning now. Could you maybe get some supplies for me, pretty please?

92110.name: My First Real Potion
92110.objective_text: Gather 3 Murloc Eyes for the young, aspiring alchemist inside the barn of Moonbrook in Westfall.
92110.description:
Wow, my very first potion! Did you know that mixing those two herbs together would change the potion to a bright red color when you first started?

That was fun, but mixing a few flowers doesn't seem like the kind of alchemy Daddy does. He uses other ingredients too.

I don't know what else to use, so let's try the first thing that comes to mind! Let's see... maybe murloc eyes? That sounds so gross, but I bet something will happen.

92124.name: Book Inventory
92124.objective_text: Speak to Daniel, Brother Paxton's assistant in the library.
92124.description:
We need to take stock of how many books are missing!

Go talk to my useless assistant, Daniel. He can do a quick inventory and let us know how serious the problem is.

He's obsessed with the various trade professions in Elwynn Forest. The boy keeps focusing on those instead of his important work helping me.

Don't let him prattle on about tradeskills, and find out what's happened to my books!

92415.name: Remember That I Love You
92415.objective_text: Bring the Blood-Stained Letter to Orphan Matron Nightingale in Stormwind City.
92415.description: <A torn and stained bundle of parchment has barely survived the undead trodden grounds of the graveyard. It mentions a missing child of the Heartweaver family. Perhaps the orphan matron in Stormwind City will know more.>
comments:
The "Blood-Stained Letter" can be found in the Dungeon Ruins of Lordaeron at Undercity.
It is located at the Graveyard deep inside the dungeon at one of the bosses. 
After picking it up, bring it to Orphan Matron Nightingale infront of the Stormwind Cathedral.
She will send you to Darkshire in Duskwood where your gonna talk to Avette Fellwood, to give her the letter and turn in the 2nd quest.

92421.name: Light's Justice
92421.objective_text: Collect 25 Intact Limbs within The Ruins of Lordaeron for Morbin Lightbane in the Undercity.
92421.description:
As a paladin of the Forsaken, it is my duty to exact the will of our Dark Lady while tending to our people's needs. We are fortunate with an opportunity to accomplish both.

Above the Undercity, the scourge still roam unchecked in great numbers. Our forces dwindle trying to reclaim our land, and decaying flesh cannot be reknit. Not without replacements.

Would that our glorious captain Garek Bandarion still be with us, I know what he would wish. To finish what he started and heal our kin. For Lordaeron!

92422.name: The Wrath of Rath'mael
92422.objective_text: Kill Rath'mael in the Ruins of Lordaeron for Deathguard Kristof in Brill.
92422.description:
Reports have come in from the Lordamere Overlook deep within the Ruins of Lordaeron. An unholy fog has taken over the streets and graveyard, affording the scourge up there some measure of stealth. 

Our scouts indicate they're being conjured by a new power within their ranks, a necromancer known as Rath'mael. We do not have the luxury of waiting this one out, <name>.

If you have allies, summon them and their aid to the Forsaken. Drive this creature out of our lands.
comments: Turn in is at 65.2 60.1 just outside of UC to the east along the road. The "?" does NOT show up on the world map.
This does not award any XP

on some website it is written that this quest is available on both faction : it's not i confirm as a NE the NPC that give the quest is Horde faction only. 

I prefer to point out since the undead NPC inside the dungeon is neutral
says "side:none" but he is hostile to alliance

92460.name: Coming of Age
92460.objective_text: Speak with Rorian the Dayseeker in Thendal Grove.
92460.description:
Look at you, bright eyed and ready for adventure! We've been awaiting your arrival and anticipating your much needed help here in Thendal Village. I imagine you are brimming with both nerves and excitement for what is to come. After all, you only get to come of age once in a lifetime.

<Ailee smiles kindly.>

Go, seek out our village leader Rorian the Dayseeker at the entrance to the greatfather tree just west of here. He will get you started on your journey.
comments: The game just welcoming you !

92461.name: Harmony in Balance
92461.objective_text: Slay 8 Vuldren Juveniles in Thendal Grove.
92461.description:
We live in times of great uncertainty for our people. We face unprecedented challenges that may require bold solutions, but we also must contend with the ordinary and mundane here in Thendal Grove. Take, for example, the recent unsustainable rise in the vuldren population.

The vuldren are a vital part of our ecosystem. However, imbalances must be corrected to maintain the delicate harmony that all creatures in Thendal Grove share.

Head east and cull some of the vuldren there.
comments: On launch day, look a bit Northeast of the questgivers to near where the map says Thendal Village. There's some Juvenile Vuldren up there, that won't be as heavily populated.

92462.name: Infestation Investigation
92462.objective_text: Slay 8 Pesky Cirrusflies in Thendal Grove.
92462.description:
One of our rangers recently reported an infestation of cirrusflies here in Thendal Grove. 

Cirrusflies can be dangerous if the swarm is allowed to grow too large, so please head to the eastern end of the Grove and exterminate as many as you can.
comments: Don't kill the Cirrusfly Queens yet. The follow-up quest will be The Cirrusfly Queen

92463.name: The Cirrusfly Queen
92463.objective_text: Destroy the Cirrusfly Queen in Thendal Grove.
92463.description:
If the forest is as thick with these insects as it sounds, simply killing the workers won't be enough.

Go deeper into the forest and find the queen. She'll be close to the hive and surrounded by bigger and more aggressive soldiers, so be careful.

Put her down and return here when it's done. That'll be one less problem to think about around here.
comments:
Introducing "boss" concept.
Does melee and Venom Spit - small nature damage - attacks.
Slightly more damage than Cirrusfly Soldiers. Soldiers do Acid Spit instead, but is just different naming, same damage.

92464.name: Elemental Unrest
92464.objective_text: Speak to the Yala Windwatcher in Thendal Grove.

objectives.text: Learn more about the agitated winds.

92464.description:
Ever since our elemental benefactors left us, it seems that we are simply moving from one unrest to another. The problem we face now is that the manifestations of the winds near the standing stones to the northeast are agitated.

Not truly self-aware like the sentient wind spirits that once lived here, these simple sprites respond in kind to forces, emotions, and intentions of the creatures around them. 

My apprentice Yala Windwatcher went to observe them. Seek her out and discover what she's learned.
comments: First quest sending you slightly away from start point.

92465.name: Agitators
92465.objective_text: Slay 6 Roiling Winds and 7 Al'Aketh Converts in Thendal Grove.
92465.description:
The Al'Aketh cult is a blight upon this island. These cultists are surely the ones responsible for agitating the simple wind sprites that reside here and turning them violent.

Regrettably, we'll need to disperse these roiling winds here before they harm someone. We also need to send a clear message to the cult that they are not welcome in the grove.

Will you lend me your aid, <class>?
comments:
Roiling Winds do nature auto attack damage.
Al'Aketh Converts are shaman like humanoids, they will do auto attacks and shock as nature damage.

92466.name: Call of Earth
92466.objective_text: Bring a Signet of Akir to Windshaper Boro.
92466.description:
While we owe much of our prosperity to the elements of wind, the path we walk requires that we obey the call of all four of the primary elements and undertake a trial for each. Before you begin your first trial in earnest however, you must prove the strength of your resolve.

Travel to the standing stones to the east. A force of Al'Aketh converts has been spotted there and they must be driven off. Confront the cultists there and bring me one of their signets as proof of your deeds.

92467.name: Call of Earth
92467.objective_text:
Find the Rise of Spirits and drink the Earth Sapta.

Provided item:
92467.description:
A sapta is a drink created to bind our spirits to the elements. Fused with magic, the potion will allow the strong willed to see the elements as no one else can. Your spirit will be connected to the element the sapta was created for, and only a select few shaman know the recipe.

The sapta is always drunk in a sacred place, and never anywhere else--remember that.

Seek out the Rise of Spirits up the pass northeast of here. Drink your sapta there, and... well, you will see what you need see.
comments: The path is just up the hill from where you fought the flies.
Start of path is /way 47.5 25.3

92468.name: Call of Earth
92468.objective_text: Bring the Rough Quartz to Windshaper Boros in Thendal Grove.
92468.description:
Take this Rough Quartz from me and bring it to the one you call Windshaper Boro as proof of our meeting. He will craft a totem for you, and this shard will be the heart of it. As small as it may seem, you will come to find that size does not matter, and that even the smallest of things can outlast many others.

Be patient, <name>. Remain strong. And seek wisdom. This is what the elements ask of you. In the end, you shall become one with the earth--respect it as it shall respect you.

92469.name: Return to Rorian
92469.objective_text: Bring word of the Al'Aketh to Rorian the Dayseeker in Thendal Grove.
92469.description:
You've done enough here, <class>. I'll stay and clean up any stragglers down there.

Head back to the Village and tell Rorian about the cult's presence. He will not be pleased.
comments: Simple return and report quest.

92470.name: Foul Matriarch
92470.objective_text: Slay 8 Ursera Scavengers and collect the head of the den mother, Urs'anah in Thendal Grove.
92470.description:
Rorian informed you that I've been watching you. I now offer you a test of resolve. However, be warned--it will send you into great danger.

Go to the caves to the south. Thin out the ursera's numbers there, and find their matriarch, one the rangers call "Urs'anah". Put her down and bring me proof of her demise. Once you have done that, you will have taken an important step on your path.
comments:
First quest in an actual cave, I think the cave is same as the old model used in Dun'Morogh but flipped over to the left.
If you are all alone in there and respawn is still high consider hearthstone out once done.
Provides the first very good weapon upgrade as reward.

92471.name: Aetheen of the Gales
92471.objective_text: Speak with Aetheen of the Gales in Thendal Grove.
92471.description:
You may not realize this but everything you've done has been a trial of sorts. A test for what is to come for you. It's a big island out there, and Zephras needs spirited young adventurers such as yourself if we are to survive the trials our people face.

The one called Aetheen of the Gales is one of the leaders of our people here on Zephras Isle, and she has been watching you. She has a task that you must complete. Speak with her to learn more.
comments: Simple introduction to new NPC.

92472.name: The Next Step
92472.objective_text: Report to Constable Aonda in Shen'dar Village.
92472.description:
One of the most pervasive threats on Zephras Isle is the Al'Aketh Cult. They are religious zealots devoted to the worship of the supposed elemental ruler of Skywall, Al'Akir the Windlord. They are brutal, single minded, and their power and ambitions are growing more deadly by the day.

Your path will soon take you to Shen'dar Village to the south. Present yourself to Constable Aonda when you arrive. The cult threatens Shen'dar and they are in need of aid. Tell Aonda that I sent you.
comments: Quest sending you from Thendal Village to Shen'dar Village.

92473.name: Aggressive Encroachment
92473.objective_text: Collect 6 Scrawny Ursera Claws from Scrawny Ursera in Thendal Grove.
92473.description:
The ursera den to the southwest is rapidly becoming a problem. Just last week the rangers had to kill an adolescent ursera who wandered too close to the village and attempted to attack a boy playing near the base of the elder tree in the center of the village.

We were fortunate that the boy escaped with his life. Hunger and desperation makes these beasts too dangerous to be left unchecked. Go south and put the scrawniest among the ursera down. Bring me their claws as proof when it is done.
comments: Regular grindy quest, slightly south-west from Thendal Village.

92474.name: Falling With Style
92474.objective_text: Jump from the top of the watchtower in Thendal Grove and use your Walk on Air ability to slow your fall.
92474.description:
Well hello there, <name>! Want to play a game?

All you've got to do is step up on that ledge... then jump! Use your innate ability to walk on the air to slow your fall and see how far forward you can float.

The rules are made up and the points don't matter, but you get bonus points if you can land right in front of Rorian the Dayseeker and startle him! He won't like it but I'll certainly get a good laugh if you can get him all worked up! Hah!
comments: Skyborne have a racial called Walk on Air (Walk on Air). Jump off the ledge of the tower and press the button to slow fall your way down.

92479.name: A Scribbled Letter
92479.objective_text: Read the Scribbled Letter and speak to Tordrin Stemblade in Northshire Abbey.
92479.description: I was asked to bring this to your attention as soon as you returned from the kobold camps, <name>. It appears to be a letter sealed with the mark of Tordrin Stemblade, our local hunter trainer. Take a moment to read it before you go about any other business here in the Abbey.

92481.name: A Student of the Arcane
92481.objective_text: Examine the Glowing Recall Crystal, then speak with Dorii Brightwhisper in Thendal Grove.
92481.description: While you were away dealing with our vuldren problem, our resident mage trainer--Dorii Brightwhisper--left this recall crystal for you. It contains some sort of message for you, so give it a look. Afterwards, you can find Dorii in the structure just behind me.

92482.name: The Way of the Hunter
92482.objective_text: Read the Scribbled Note and then speak with Tai'ree Farsight in Thendal Grove.
92482.description: While you were away dealing with our vuldren problem, our resident hunter trainer--Tai'ree Farsight--left this note for you. You can find her just over yonder near the center of the village. Read the note then seek her out.

92483.name: At Home in the Shadows
92483.objective_text: Read the Simple Note then speak with Akeri Duskblade within the watchtower in Thendal Grove.
92483.description:
While you were away dealing with our vuldren problem, our resident rogue trainer--Akeri Duskblade--has requested to speak with you. He left this note, so read that first, then seek him out inside the watchtower, here in the village.

He's a shady fellow, but then again, so are you. I think you'll get along well.

92484.name: Embracing the Elements
92484.objective_text: Examine the Humming Recall Crystal then speak with Windshaper Boro in Thendal Grove.
92484.description: While you were away dealing with our vuldren problem, our resident Shaman trainer--Windshaper Boro--left this recall crystal for you. Please examine it, then speak with Boro just over yonder near the center of the village.

92485.name: A Student of Nature
92485.objective_text: Read the Folded Parchment then speak with Xyton Silverwind in Thendal Grove.
92485.description:
While you were away dealing with our vuldren problem, our resident druid trainer--Xyton Silverwind--left this note for you. Read it as soon as you can, and then seek out Silverwind on the ground floor of this great tree just behind me.

Heed his words and his counsel, he can teach you much.

92514.name: Welcome to Shen'dar Village
92514.objective_text: Speak with Illaya Amberwind and Coriella Calmbreeze in Shen'dar Village.
92514.description:
You've got that "Windshaper" air about you. Something about how I can feel a tiny bit of static on my skin when near someone spirit-touched that gives it away. Before I properly put you to work around here, you should check in with our resident Windshaper elder, Illaya Amberwind. She's just outside, near the center of town.

Oh, and check in with Coriella Calmbreeze as well, she runs the local inn and can provide lodging and supplies, should you need them.

92515.name: The Problem With Prideclaws
92515.objective_text: Collect 10 Prideclaw Pelts from the Prideclaws in Shen'dar Highlands.
92515.description:
As if bandits and mad cultists weren't enough, the hills are thick with prideclaws as well right now. They are starting to encroach on the village borders and growing bolder by the day. It's only a matter of time before someone's pet or child is taken. It would be a mercy for us to cull their numbers now rather than after some tragedy occurs.

Bring me a dozen or so of their pelts. I can turn them into all sorts of goods that will be of aid to the village.

92516.name: Hippogryph Harrassment
92516.objective_text: Slay 8 Hippogryph Youths, 6 Hippogryph Protectors and a Hippogryph Matriarch in the Shen'dar Highlands.
92516.description: A flock of Hippogryph have recently established nesting grounds southeast of Shen'dar Village and they've been wreaking havoc on travelers on the road. I need someone to head down there and thin them out for us.

92517.name: The Criminal Element
92517.objective_text: Kill 10 Highlands Bandits and their leader, "Badwind" Bennic in the Shen'dar Highlands.
92517.description:
There's a cave not far to the north, hidden behind a waterfall. It's well known to me that there's a group of bandits that are operating out of that cave. They were a problem for us before the cult arrived, but now they are a real terror. I can't spare the people to go and clear them out, unfortunately.

I need you to go there and take care of them for me. Kill as many as you can, and if possible, take out their leader, the one they call "Badwind" Bennic. That cave is dangerous, so be careful.

92528.name: Among the Faithful
92528.objective_text: Look around Falaath Village to learn about the cult's intentions in the Shen'dar Highlands.
92528.description:
The faithful of Al'Akir grow ever stronger with each eager new recruit like yourself. As you can see, our strength gives form to the storm itself!

Normally I'd send you straight to Skypriest Aanders for assessment, but he is occupied at present receiving a guest at the inn on the north side of town. Please avoid that place for now. An unshaven recruit like yourself in the presence of such a guest would be inappropriate.

For now, just don't get in anyone's way.
comments: This quest seems to be bugged for me. Im at the house on the top floor, theres Skypriest Aanders and High Priestess Lorthuna, but nothing is going on. Abandoning and retaking the quest does not help.
You need to "hide" behind the wardrobe (click on it with your mouse) and wait for the NPCs to finish talking.

92529.name: Falaath Village
92529.objective_text:
Report to Missionary Jasaan near the entrance to Falaath Village.

If you lose your Mark of Akir, speak with Sania Silverstream in Shen'dar Village to regain the effect.

objectives.text: Speak with Missionary Jasaan at the entrance to Falaath Village

92529.description:
It gladdens my heart that you wish to serve Al'Akir. Our current trials as a people stem from our own complacency. We grew prideful and took the bounty of the winds for granted. The stagnation that followed is the reason the spirits of the wind abandoned us.

Only through acts of contrition may we feel the wind's caress once more. If you seek the fellowship of like-minded shen'dorei, go to Falaath Village and find Missionary Jasaan there. I will mark you so that the faithful will know you as a recruit.

92532.name: The Warrior's Path
92532.objective_text: Read the Crumpled Note you've been given, then seek out Blademaster Ren inside the Thendal Village watchtower.
92532.description:
While you were gone our warrior trainer--Blademaster Ren--requested that we send you their way when you returned. She dropped this note off for you as well.

Give it a read, then find Blademaster Ren inside the village watchtower.
comments:
Regular start zone warrior quest. 
Don't forget to train skills, you should be level 2 already. Remember to come and train each 2 levels for new skills.

92544.name: Al'Aketh Thugs
92544.objective_text: Slay 6 Al'Aketh Brutes, 4 Al'Aketh Neophytes, and Malduko Cloudcrush in Thendal Grove.
92544.description:
A band of Al'Aketh cult ruffians have taken up residence near the temple ruins just southwest of here, led by a real monster called Malduko Cloudcrush. This rabble has no doubt been dispatched here by High Priestess Lorthuna at the Shrine of Akir to attack travelers and coerce our people into joining the cult.

I need to stay here at my post to alert travelers leaving the grove of the danger, but I would be grateful if you could do something about those cultists and their leader for me.
comments:
Quest to cull out thug threat. 
Brutes are shaman like mobs with melee and shocks.
Neophytes are the more elemental shaman type but they will still primarly melee.
Malduko shock like shaman. Careful with him, pull him away, at least in his current state he respawns instantly.

Small chest can spawn behind a pillar where the miniboss is.
Ley line available behind for buff.

92550.name: Havoc in the Highlands
92550.objective_text: Travel to the ruins of Falaath Village and slay 6 Al'Aketh Stormcallers, 4 Living Lightning and take the head of Commander Cyclas.
92550.description:
Our best defense here might just be a strong offense. The advantage we now have is that we expect an attack is coming. What they won't expect is for us to hit them first.

I've already asked a lot of you, but please head back over to Falaath Village. Kill as many cultists as you can and if you can get close enough, kill the commander and bring me his head. I'll stay here and organize the citizens and our few peacekeepers to prepare a defense... just in case you don't return.

92551.name: Stolen Supplies
92551.objective_text: Collect 10 packs of Stolen Shen'dar Supplies from Falaath Village in the Shen'dar Highlands.
92551.description:
I overheard you might be going to Falaath Village? While you are there, please keep an eye out for our stolen supply caches.

The Al'Aketh have been raiding our supply caravans carrying various goods such as food and windstones to and from the lowlands for months. They've been blaming the bandits, of course, but we all know that it all ends up in the same place. If there's any of that stuff left in Falaath, it would be a huge help if you could recover it.

92553.name: Restocking the Larders
92553.objective_text: Collect 3 Small Eggs and 8 Strider Meat from creatures found throughout the Shen'dar Highlands.
92553.description:
Up for a bit of work? I could use a bit of muscle from a strong adventuring-type such as yourself. With how dangerous things are getting around here, no one's had much time to hunt or forage of late, and I need someone to get out there and source me fresh eggs and strider meat to keep this village fed.

I'd be happy to teach you one of my famous recipes if you can bring me what I need. What do you say?

92579.name: To Valanaar
92579.objective_text: Deliver Aonda's Written Report to Valennia Stormfist in Valanaar.
92579.description:
For now it seems the pylon and the village are safe, so I'd like you to deliver this report to the Valennia Stormfist in Valanaar, at the southeastern edge of the island. Valennia is the leader of the peacekeepers on the island and she needs to know what happened here.

The cult is expanding rapidly and the peacekeepers have avoided direct conflict until now, but those days are over. Valanaar will need to be ready for a fight.

At any rate, thank you. You'll always have friends in Shen'dar, <name>.

92595.name: The Windshapers
92595.objective_text: Listen to what Illaya Amberwind has to say.
92595.description:
<Illaya smiles warmly at you.>

I am glad you returned to speak with me, child of the winds. I knew it the first moment you walked into my presence, that you were strong in the skysight. Do you find this surprising? Even those who have not trained as a Shaman may possess the gift. 

Come, let us speak about the mandate of the Windshapers, the nature of our struggles on Zephras, and the plight of our people.

92596.name: The High Order
92596.objective_text: Have a seat and speak with Rathiril Sunlance.
92596.description:
The aura of arcane energy that surrounds you is strong, even though you are not initiated as a mage. I am quite sure that you are going to be a capable adventurer, and your connection with our ancient magic will only ever be a boon to you even if you were to never utter a single word of power in spellcasting.

Come, let us sit and speak some on my order, the nature of the arcane here on Zephras, and the plight of our people.
comments: Let me tell you a story.

92597.name: Reading the Ley Lines
92597.objective_text: Use your Read Ley Line racial ability at the ley line in Thendal Grove.

objectives.text: Use your Read Ley Line ability near the Thendal Grove Ley Line

92597.description:
Here in the elemental plane, we derive much of our arcane strength from ley lines that still run through the ground under our feet. Of late, these ley lines have begun to pierce the surface, giving us more direct and powerful access to these latent arcane energies.

Go to the standing stones to the northeast. There is a ley line there. Tap into your birthright and draw in its energy.
comments: Quest initiating you on your racial ability - Read Ley Lines

92598.name: The Gift of Skysight
92598.objective_text: Use your Skysight racial ability at the Elemental Convergence in Thendal Grove.

objectives.text: Use Skysight near the Elemental Convergence

92598.description:
As a Windshaper, you have the ability to use the sacred skysight gifted to us by the elemental spirits. Travel to the standing stones to the northeast of the village. Find the elemental convergence there and use your gift.

You'll find that you may draw upon the skysight anywhere, but its boon is much more powerful if you do so in the presence of an elemental convergence. You may at times receive other bits of wisdom from the spirits that are drawn to such places of power, as well.

92640.name: Desperate Times
92640.objective_text: Speak with Valennia Stormfist in Valanaar and follow her instructions.
92640.description:
Since engaging the cult in the open is not viable, our best chance is going to be to use this opportunity to attack the shrine itself. We can take Lorthuna herself off the board before she can finish her part of this scheme.

It so happens that Valennia has been preparing a strategy for a potential assault on the Shrine for some time now. The only problem is, we will need help. 

Speak with Valennia for the details.

92642.name: Disrupting Logistics
92642.objective_text: Slay 4 Al'Aketh Healers and 8 Al'Aketh Brawlers in the Gustberry Lowlands.
92642.description:
Valennia only sent one person to help repel a full-scale assault... by the winds.

You don't look like much but I'll take what I can get. We need to inflict as much damage as possible to stop this soon. My people can't hold out much longer.

Go down the hill and disrupt their logistics. Their healers are keeping the attackers coming, if we take them out we might be able to rally and push them back. Any other cultists you kill while you are out there are helpful as well.
comments: As a level 10 druid, I have no interrupts yet that I know of. I can't stop the healers from healing themselves, so soloing this seems impossible. Maybe I can find a group?

92643.name: The Turncoat
92643.objective_text: Find the cultist turncoat at the house just inside the highlands northwest of Valanaar.

objectives.text: Find the secluded house in Shen'dar Highlands

92643.description:
There is a turncoat amongst the Al'Aketh. They claim to know the cult's true intentions for the island and want to come in, but will only do so with assurances of protection.

This defector is hiding at a secluded residence just northwest of Valanaar inside the highlands. I need someone who can discreetly go there, find the traitor, and escort him back to us. This might be a trap, but if this information is as important as this traitor claims, its worth some risk.
comments:
The place is swarming with level 9 mobs, so expect that, nevertheless, the guy you are looking for is the Dead Cultist located inside the house at coords:
/way 56 58.8

92644.name: Unfortunate News
92644.objective_text: Deliver the glowing crystal to Talanaanis Shadowsong in Valanaar.
92644.description: <You reach beneath the still-warm body of the turncoat cultist and recover a small, glowing blue crystal. It appears to be damaged, but it may still be important. High Elder Shadowsong may be interested in this.>

92645.name: Breaking the Breaker
92645.objective_text: Slay Commander Belguilos in the Gustberry Lowlands.
92645.description:
This attack is going to be hard to repel unless we can take out the cult commander. Belguilos "the Breaker" they call her, and she's a veritable terror. She used to be a peacekeeper before the cult got out of control, and even then she was... off. As a cultist I can only imagine how much worse she could be now.

I might just be sending you to your death, but someone needs to take Belguilos out if we are going to survive here. You can find her at the villa at the hill's base. Good luck, <class>.

92646.name: Confront Lorthuna
92646.objective_text: Take the portal to the Rohashi Spires overhead and join Elaadrin Evengale and Ayessa Dawnsinger in their confrontation with the High Priestess Lorthuna.
92646.description:
Lorthuna fled up to the spires above using some sort of portal. Ayessa and Elaadrin went in after her. That was just a few moments ago.

I'm afraid I took one too many hits and this is where I stay. Go through the portal, find Ayessa and help them stop Lorthuna.

Unless that help that Elaadrin and Ayessa said they sent for arrives soon, you are on your own from here. Good luck, <class>.

92679.name: Blood Tithe
92679.objective_text: Listen to what Alvarion Windfield has to say and find Aamelia Windfield at the Windfield Orchard.
92679.description:
H--Hello, stranger. You have the look of a capable adventurer about you. I...

<The Skyborne man winces, clearly suffering terrible pain>

...I was wondering if you were seeking employment? I came here to Valanaar to recruit fighters to help save my farm. If you are interested, please go find my wife Aamelia Windfield at our orchard to the west of Valanaar, in the lowlands.
comments: Good grief but that's a horribly sad tale the man has if you stay and listen.

92682.name: Make Yourself Useful
92682.objective_text: Gather 10 Ripe Stormapples and slay 5 Hungry Bandits at the Windfield Orchard.
92682.description:
Oh, so you've got more courage than sense, then? Fine, I won't argue.

Ferauu and his goons aren't due to pick up their take of the harvest just yet, so I'm going to put you to work for your meals until they arrive.

Head outside and gather today's batch of stormapples for me. Oh, and the bandits lurking around the stormapple trees... They think they are sneaky. They aren't. Kill them for me. 

Let's see what you've got in a fight.

92683.name: Flutterfly Dust
92683.objective_text: Gather 5 Flutterfly Dust from the Flutterflies around the Gustberry Lowlands.
92683.description:
I'm sure you've noticed the giant flutterflies out in the outer fields near the orchard? They are pleasant to look at, but they also have other benefits; namely their wing dust. It can be a mess, but if you can gather it up in large amounts, it has useful household applications.

Take this Flutterfly Swatter and give the big bugs a good swat for me. They'll usually just get scared and flee, but sometimes they'll take some offense. Either way, they'll give their rumps a shake and drop a pile of dust.

92684.name: Ornery Ornery Galestriders
92684.objective_text: Gather 7 Lowlands Galestrider Tenderloins from the Ornery Galestriders found throughout the Gustberry Lowlands.
92684.description:
As if the harvest wasn't light enough this year already, the galestriders in the area have been getting into the orchard and stealing my stormapples. Think you can head out to the fields and cull them for me?

Take care though stranger, these lowlands galestriders are bigger and angrier than the highlands variety. Watch yourself. A well timed kick is all it takes to put you down for good if you aren't paying attention.

Bring me some of their meat and I can make us a hot meal with it as well.

92685.name: The Hills Have Eyes
92685.objective_text: Loot 7 Blood-Stained Bandit Masks from Highwayman Bandits in the Gustberry Lowlands.
92685.description:
The bandits have camps all over and there's a small one in the hills just north of here. Head up there and start cracking skulls. If we can catch them off guard and take them out before they come for us, we might just even the odds enough to stand a chance.

Bring me their masks. The bloodier the better.
comments: so far, 5 bandits taken out, one mask dropped. Sigh.

92693.name: Standing Our Ground
92693.objective_text: Speak with Aamelia Windfield when you are ready to confront the bandit leader.

objectives.text: Follow Aamelia and make your final stand

92693.description:
You've done a lot to give us a fighting chance. Even if we die today, we'll at least know we gave it our best shot.

This is your last chance, stranger. If you want to head back to Valanaar and live another day, I wouldn't blame you.

On the other hand, if you really have a thing for lost causes just let me know when you are ready to go. We'll walk out there with our heads held high and whatever happens, happens.

92698.name: What Is My Purpose?
92698.objective_text: Speak with Aamelia Windfield about the Malfunctioning Cyclone Construct.
92698.description:
<You lean in close to try and hear the words coming from beneath the giant construct's armor plates.>

...Function error...

...Question...

...What is....

...Function...

<These fragmented words and phrases seem to just repeat. Maybe someone nearby knows more about this construct?>

92699.name: The Supreme Magister
92699.description:
Now that you've arrived in Valanaar, you'll likely want to check in with the other members of the High Order here. The current Supreme Magister, Elaadrin Evengale and his people operate out of the lodge on the far southeastern part of Valanaar.

You should also take care, the High Order and Windshapers don't get along very well here. Be careful and give the Windshapers a good, wide berth. We've got enough to worry about with the cult, I won't tolerate faction violence in the streets of Valanaar.

92700.name: The Grand Skyseer
92700.description:
Now that you've arrived in Valanaar, you'll likely want to check in with the other members of the Windshapers here. The current Grand Skyseer and her people operate out of the lodge near the center of Valanaar.

You should also be aware, the Windshapers and High Order don't get along very well in these parts. Be careful and give the High Order a good, wide berth. We've got enough to worry about with the cult, I won't tolerate faction violence in the streets of Valanaar.

92701.name: To Valanaar
92701.objective_text: Deliver Aonda's Written Report to Valennia Stormfist in Valanaar.
92701.description:
For now it seems the pylon and the village are safe, so I'd like you to deliver this report to the Valennia Stormfist in Valanaar, at the southeastern edge of the island. Valennia is the leader of the peacekeepers on the island and she needs to know what happened here.

The cult is expanding rapidly and the peacekeepers have avoided direct conflict until now, but those days are over. Valanaar will need to be ready for a fight.

At any rate, thank you. You'll always have friends in Shen'dar, <name>.

92703.name: Deliver the News
92703.objective_text: Speak with Alvarion Windfield in Valanaar.
92703.description:
