I guess it doesn't feel quite right to keep calling you stranger after all of this so... thank you, <name>. 

If you wouldn't mind and are back out that way, please let Alvarion know what happened here. Also, tell him that once he's up on his feet he needs to bring a windshaper back here to look at that construct for us to make sure it's safe to have around our... our family.

<Aamelia touches her belly gently.>

He doesn't know about this part. Let's just keep that bit between us for now.

92708.name: A Grand Adventure
92708.objective_text: Listen to what Ayessa Dawnsinger has to say.
92708.description:
The Windshapers have been hard at work trying to respond to the current crisis on Zephras Isle. We have made several surprising discoveries in our search for the missing wind spirits, and we are developing a plan of action that could help us gain the means to save the island.

We'll need strong young adventurer's like yourself for this to work however. Please, if you have a moment, let us speak on this further.

92709.name: A Grand Adventure
92709.objective_text: Listen to what Elaadrin Evengale in Valanaar has to say.
92709.description: Your highborne lineage shines as clearly in your eyes as the sky above. You are one of us, and its youth like yourself that will help us save our home. But first, let me tell you more of our mission and plans here on Zephras... and beyond.

end.name: Object #581822 (unnamed, e.g. a poster or crate)

92727.name: The Missing Scholar
92727.objective_text: Discover what became of Fillion Flamebreeze.
92727.description:
Seeking knowledge is the primary mandate of the High Order, but this work has never been more dangerous than it is now on Zephras.

One of our scholars--Fillion Flamebreeze--was en route to the Shen'dar Highlands to study the windborne magic that congregates in some areas there. Regrettably, he has not returned and we fear that something may have befallen him on the road.

If you can, please locate him for us. He was last seen on the road leading west from Valanaar towards Shen'dar Highlands.

92741.name: Unwelcome Visitors
92741.objective_text: Travel to Shadowgale Forest and collect 8 Shriekling Talons for Iaadaria Bitterwind in Valanaar.
92741.description:
The Shadowgale Forest is incredibly dangerous and is usually off limits to normal adventurers. In recent months there's been an explosion in the shriekling population and they've started to expand their territory outside the woods, which is a potential problem. I have an interest in the alchemical properties of shriekling talons, so a much-needed culling also presents an opportunity for scholarly gain.

Travel to Shadowgale Forest and hunt the beasts. Bring me as many of their talons as you can.
comments: The drop rate on the talons is REALLY low. I've killed a good 30 of them, and only got 1 talon.

92742.name: Testing the Wells
92742.objective_text: Use the Well Water Sample Kit to collect samples from the wells at the Jansen Stead and the Molsen Farm.
92742.description:
We must determine the source and nature of the poison corrupting this land. Let us begin with the groundwater under the farms in the area.
Go to the Jansen Stead and the Molsen Farm, and collect samples from the wells there.

92744.name: Murloc Gills
92744.objective_text: Alba Fairmoon wants you to collect 7 Longshore Murloc Gills along the shoreline of Westfall.
92744.description:
The corruption affecting Westfall's crops may have seeped into the ocean as well. If the local fish are affected too, it could doom Stormwind to famine.
Collect gills from the murlocs along the shoreline and bring them to me. Murlocs are quite hardy, but their physiology is extremely sensitive to contaminants. Any toxins in the seawater will be readily apparent in the gills you find.

92745.name: The State of the Mines
92745.objective_text: Slay 4 Kobold Diggers in the Jangolode Mine and 6 Riverpaw Miners in the Gold Coast Quarry.
92745.description:
The well samples you collected contain toxic metals! If we do not put an end to this corruption quickly, it will be decades before crops can grow in this soil again.
The Defias have seized the mines of Westfall and use creatures as labor to strip their resources. Disrupt them by slaying their miners in the Jangolode Mine to the north, and the Gold Coast Quarry to the west.

92747.name: Moonbrook Espionage
92747.objective_text: Collect 8 Suspicious Industrial Supplies from Moonbrook.
92747.description:
Strange - the poison does not seem to originate from the mines you investigated.

I am told the Deadmines under the town of Moonbrook are the largest, deepest mines of Westfall, but they have been abandoned since the First War. Could the Deadmines be active again?

Please travel to Moonbrook, <name>, and look for evidence of mining or industrial activity. This is the last lead we have!
comments: The crates are inside the cave on the way to the entrance to the Deadmines. So, go into the building that leads to the Deadmines and work your way down into those caves. You will find them there.

92748.name: Explosive Consultation
92748.objective_text: Travel to the Dwarven District in Stormwind and find an engineer who can help.
92748.description:
The supplies you found point to a massive industrial operation somewhere in the Deadmines. There's no question that this is the source of the toxins plaguing the farmland of Westfall. We need to stop it, quickly.

Whatever's down there will be difficult to destroy. Go to the Dwarven District of Stormwind, and find an engineer who can supply us with some explosives.

92749.name: A Dynamite Plan
92749.objective_text: Obtain 10 Coarse Dynamite from crafting, trading, or the auction house, then return to Sprite Jumpsprocket in the Dwarven District of Stormwind.
92749.description:
Industrial sabotage? You've got my attention!
We'll start with some dynamite...

92750.name: Detonation at a Distance
92750.objective_text: Talk to someone in Stormwind Intelligence about acquiring a remote detonator.
92750.description:
I assume you want a "controlled" explosion? Not as much fun, but a good choice if you want to keep all your limbs.
I'm afraid I don't have a remote detonator - why don't you go check with the sneaky folks down at Stormwind Intelligence? They should be able to find us something.

92751.name: Detonation at a Distance
92751.objective_text: Bring the Remote Detonator Kit to Sprite Jumpsprocket in the Dwarven District of Stormwind.
92751.description:
You need something destroyed? Would this have anything to do with your activities in Moonbrook? Don't look surprised. SI:7 stays apprised of all that goes on in Stormwind's lands.
If you're planning to set off an explosion in the caves below Westfall, you'll want to be well outside beforehand. Take this remote detonator - it's a recent prototype from our own engineers.
Oh - and it would be best if you didn't mention my involvement to your elf friend.

92752.name: Explosive Consultation
92752.objective_text: Return to Alba Fairmoon in Westfall.
92752.description: That's it - the bomb's ready to go! Careful with that detonator, now.

92753.name: Destruction in Deadmines
92753.objective_text: Find the forge hidden in the Deadmines, and plant the Extra-Destructive Explosives nearby. Then, meet up with Alba Fairmoon at the Deadmines exit.
92753.description:
The source of the poison is likely a large metallurgical forge of some kind. Find a way into the Deadmines and locate the forge, then place the explosives.
I will wait for you in the hills behind Moonbrook. Once you return, we can detonate the explosives. Hopefully with the forge gone, the land can begin to heal.

92819.name: Destruction in Deadmines
92819.description: We are almost finished. Use the detonator, and end this.

92834.name: Avenged Tenfold
92834.objective_text: Collect 10 Al'Aketh Windstone Charms from Al'Aketh cultists found north of Valanaar at the Gustberry Fields or Shrine of Akir.
92834.description:
When the cult began their campaign of violence, the Peacekeepers and Windshapers responded with posturing. I saw this as foolish escalation so I advocated for peaceful dialogue. Yesterday I dispatched my friend Belathaan Brightwish to the Shrine of Akir, hoping to establish that dialogue.

A box just arrived containing Belathaan's tongue, dipped in silver pigment. 

Its clear to me now that there is no reasoning with the cult. Kill any cultists you see, and bring me the prayer charms that they carry.

92840.name: Catching Wind
92840.objective_text: Take the Index Esoteria to the Overlook Standing Stones in Shen'dar Highlands and use it once there. Protect the Index from harm as it gathers data.
92840.description:
The same magic that sustains this island can be found lingering around the standing stones in the Shen'dar Highlands. Unfortunately, these are considered sacred sites and are under the direct protection of the Windshapers, which has made it difficult for us to study the magic present there.

With the Windshapers focused elsewhere, we have an opportunity to study the nature of this elemental magic.

Take this device to the standing stones and protect it as it gathers vital data. Be discreet, please.

start.name: Object #581822 (unnamed, e.g. a poster or crate)

92849.name: The Missing Scholar

objectives.text: Carry Fillion Flamebreeze to safety while avoiding enemies

92849.description: <Judging by what you've just found, its very likely that Fillion befell some misfortune here. He may still be nearby, and he might be in need of aid. You notice a cave just to the north of your current location. You should continue searching for him there.>

92850.name: The Missing Scholar
92850.objective_text: Slay the Shriekling Matriarch in the Shriekling Den then return its head to Dondallion Whisperwind in Valanaar.
92850.description:
I am feeling much better already. I have some skill with the arcane arts and we are but a short distance from Valanaar. I can make it on my own. More important than my safety however is how close to Valanaar these shrieklings have nested and the danger they pose. If you would be so kind, please head back inside and take the head of that beast!

After it's done, you'll find me with Dondallion back in Valanaar. I need to return to him as soon as possible. He's probably going to pieces with worry.
comments:
This shouldn't be a hard situation to figure out where to go to kill the monster for the quest, but if you are like me and gather every quest and just do what is closest first, you might have lost track of where the cave is and that the monster is inside the cave. You might end up on top of the mountain wondering, "Where is this mob at!"
#1 The monster is inside the cave you brought the dude out o

92860.name: In Service of Zephras
92860.objective_text: Report to Valennia Stormfist and let her know that High Order is with them in their fight against the Al'Aketh.
92860.description:
The High Order has done our best to avoid direct conflict with the cult, but that is clearly no longer an option. Their hostility has been clearly demonstrated, and now there's rumors of larger-scale cult movements around the island. They are clearly gearing up for something and whatever it is can't be good for the people of Zephras.

Report to Valennia Stormfist and inform her that the High Order offers our full support in Valanaar's efforts against the Al'Aketh, should the need arise.

92871.name: In Service of Zephras
92871.objective_text: Report to Valennia Stormfist and let her know that the Windshapers are with them in their fight against the Al'Aketh.
92871.description:
Valennia Stormfist and her peacekeepers have ever been the protectors of Zephras, and we've done our best to lend aid where we can. There's rumors of larger-scale cult movements around the island, and they are clearly gearing up for something.

Report to Valennia and reiterate to her that the Windshapers offer their full support in Valanaar's efforts against the Al'Aketh, should the need arise.

92880.name: Return to Valanaar
92880.objective_text: Bring Yorna's Report to Valennia Stormfist in Valanaar.
92880.description:
I suspect it will take a bit of time for us to mop up what's left of the attackers, but our chances are far better now. Head back to Valanaar and let them know that we are stable here now.

I can't thank you enough for your help. We'd be in much worse shape without you. I asked for reinforcements and it seems that I got a burgeoning hero instead. I'll take that.

May the four winds bless you, <class>.

92881.name: The High Elder's Request
92881.objective_text: Speak with Talaanis Shadowsong in Valanaar.
92881.description:
The attack on both the western and eastern watchtowers are not a coincidence. Based on what you told us about what occurred at the western watchtower with that skypriest, our best guess is that the cult is trying to do something to the anchor pylons.

Please speak with High Elder Shadowsong. He will tell you about a lead that could prove to be promising.

92909.name: Harvesting the Harvesters
92909.objective_text: Ozwin Ironsprocket at Saldean's Farm wants you to bring him 14 Golem Isosprings and 5 Harvester Gyrostabilizers.
92909.description:
Oh no... I'm in for it now!

I heard about the harvesters terrorizing the fields of Westfall, so I traveled all the way from Ironforge to see if I could recalibrate them. But they're far more aggressive than my calculations anticipated, and they chased me into this stable!

If I had some isosprings and gyrostabilizers from the harvesters, I could build a device to cover my escape. Could you gather the parts for me?
comments: might be the worst quest off all time. never seen a lower drop rate anywhere

92910.name: Harvesting the Harvesters
92910.objective_text: Bring the Precessive Autocognition Assembly to Ozwin Ironsprocket at Saldean's Farm.
92910.description: The part you managed to salvage from the harvester appears mostly intact. Someone interested in harvest golems may want to see it.

92911.name: Harvesting the Harvesters
92911.objective_text: Ozwin Ironsprocket at Saldean's Farm wants you to bring him 8 Golem Isosprings, 4 Copper Modulators, and a Crude Scope.
92911.description:
I see... this gives me some insight into what makes those monsters tick. I have an idea how we could override their systems, at least momentarily.

I'll continue tinkering with the assembly you brought me. In the meantime, could you scrounge up some parts for the device?

92947.name: Making Our Move
92947.objective_text: Slay 8 Al'Aketh Guardians, 6 Al'Aketh Spiritcallers, and 6 Al'Aketh Blademasters, then report to Hyusaa Quickbreeze at the Shrine of Akir.
92947.description:
Everyone is here, good. I've just sent a few of my best fighters in through the front of the shrine to cause a bit of trouble and serve as a distraction, while I lead the Windshapers and High Order in from the flank.

If all goes well, we should be able to punch through quickly and take out the High Priestess. As for you, get in there and start cracking skulls. Meet my second, Hyusaa Quickbreeze, near the steps to the shrine after you've caused some trouble.

Winds guide you, <class>.

93036.name: Infiltrating the Cult
93036.objective_text: Speak with Sania Silverstream in Shen'dar Village.
93036.description:
You may or may not be aware of this, but Sania Silverstream over there is a "missionary" for the Al'Aketh. They like to play at being a normal religious order and send non-threatening emissaries around to recruit. We've tolerated Sania so far to avoid direct conflict with the cult, but its obvious the illusion of peace won't last much longer.

You are new here and unknown to most, so I'd like to see if you can use Sania to get close to the cult and find out what their plans are for the village.

93065.name: Prepare for Battle
93065.objective_text: Speak with Valennia Stormfist in the Gustberry Lowlands.
93065.description: The Peacekeepers are mobilizing and we are all gearing up to head out. Make whatever preparations you need to make and meet us at the eastern road leading north out of town. We'll have one final check-in with everyone before we move out.

93089.name: What Comes Next
93089.objective_text: Speak with Elaadrin Evengale when you are prepared to leave Zephras Isle.
93089.description:
Please extend my thanks to Elaadrin for all that the High Order and your new friends from this "Kirin Tor" have done for Zephras Isle. I'm aware of the High Order's plans to leave the island, and your order has my blessing and well-wishes in this expedition.

I can only hope that whatever arcane solution the High Order finds can truly provide us with the stability we've lacked these past years. If you plan to go with them... well, his mission will be all the stronger for it.

Winds be with you, <name>.

93090.name: What Comes Next
93090.objective_text: Speak with Ayessa Dawnsinger when you are prepared to leave Zephras Isle.
93090.description:
Please extend my thanks to Ayessa for all that the Windshapers and your new friends from this "Earthen Ring" have done for Zephras Isle. I'm aware of the plan to take the Windshapers shamans and leave the island, and your order has my blessing and well-wishes in this expedition.

I can only hope that whatever solution the Windshapers find can truly provide us with the stability we've lacked these past years.

Winds be with you, <name>.

93159.name: The Strange Hermit
93159.objective_text: Speak with the Strange Hermit in the Shadowgale Forest and learn more about him.

objectives.text: Learn more about the Strange Hermit

93159.description:
Uh, um... h-hello, I mean to say, hi! Greetings, even! I'm sorry... its um, been so long since I've actually spoken to another person. I'm afraid I'm a bit rusty at this.

<The strange hooded figure shifts uncomfortably before you.>

So er, um... how is your day going?

93160.name: The Forest's Bounty
93160.objective_text: Gather 8 Shadowgale Acorns in Shadowgale Forest.
93160.description:
I do appreciate you stopping by to talk with me! I-If you do want to help out, I could use a bit of help gathering up acorns from the forest floor. I've gathered most of the ones close by but there sure are a lot of raptor-bird things in the forest. It's dangerous out there and I'd rather not become a giant bird's lunch!

So if you want, you could maybe gather them for me? I'll make us something tasty if you do!

93165.name: Mercy Falls on Deaf Ears
93165.objective_text: Collect 10 Al'Aketh Cultist's Ears from the Al'Aketh cultists in Shadowgale Forest, the Shine of Akir, or Gustberry Lowlands.
93165.description:
The Al'Aketh have visited great tragedy upon our enclave, and blood must be repaid with blood.

I have an offer for you, stranger. Should you find conflict with these accursed cultists, bring me the ears of those you kill. I will reward you for each that you return with in both coin and, in time, access to the Nightclaw's secrets should you prove yourself to be a true friend.
comments:
Reporting in from the beta, drop rate is AWFUL :'(

that being said, you do not need to finish this as soon as you get the quest. there are plenty of other quests upcoming to kill Al'Aketh
Head to the Shrine of Akir, the drop rate is much higher there
Подтверждаю, выбиваются с каким то супер низким шансов, более 60 мобов (дальше перестал считать) ну где то минут за 30 управился, это чудовищно много.

93172.name: Free the Hollows
93172.objective_text: Destroy 10 Wind Hollows in Shadowgale Forest.
93172.description:
Most of the elves on this island seem to think that these woods are haunted, and they aren't wrong.

At the old ruins to the northeast, a strange type of ghost-like spirits gather. Some nights, you can almost hear them "singing". It's not like any song I've heard before, but its definitely a song and its... just so sad.

I'm not sure why, but I think something terrible happened there at some point, and the spirits are trapped there somehow. If you are feeling brave, maybe you can help set them free?

93317.name: Crab Season
93317.objective_text: Collect 6 pieces of Windsong Crawler Meat.
93317.description:
Are you familiar with Windsong Crawlers? You see, these crabs are native only to Windsong Lake here on Zephras, and they are only able to be harvested a few weeks of the year.

With all of the cult activity of late, I've not been able to get out to the lake to harvest them, and our window is rapidly closing. I'd be appreciative if you could go and gather some for me. They can generally be found along the shorelines around the lake and in rivers.

Do be careful though, they are meaner than they look!

start.name: Object #610954 (unnamed, e.g. a poster or crate)

93318.name: WANTED: Vulgara the Insatiable
93318.objective_text: Kill Vulgara the Insatiable in the Shen'dar Highlands and bring her head to Danarii Bellowveil.
93318.description:
By order of Constable Aonda of the Peacekeepers, a bounty is hereby placed upon the scourge of the highlands, Vulgara the Insatiable. Last spotted on a hilltop rise just southwest of Shen'dar Village, the winged vuldren terror is highly dangerous and should be approached with caution.

Deliver the beast's head to Danarii Bellowveil to receive your reward.

93319.name: Pilfered Windstones
93319.objective_text: Collect 10 Pilfered Windstones from the Highlands Bandits in the Shen'dar Highlands.
93319.description:
We are relying on windstones more and more for day to day living here on Zephras so we try and maintain a cache of them in reserve for emergencies. Lately I've noticed some go missing from our stores.

We've found windstones on bandits we've captured recently, and I suspect they are behind our shortages.

If you find yourself near the bandit cave to the north, mind knocking a few heads together and reclaiming some of our pilfered windstones for me?

93320.name: Tower Defense
93320.objective_text: Report to Yorana Windyreed at the eastern watchtower in the Gustberry Lowlands.
93320.description:
I've just received word that the cult is attacking the pylon watchtower just outside of town! I've sent the few extra peacekeepers we have here to try and break through the enemy back line to relieve the defenders, but any additional help could mean the difference between our people there living or dying.

Please leave immediately for the east watchtower and provide whatever aid you can.

My lieutenant Yorana Windyreed led the relief force. If she still lives she can tell you how best to help.

93459.name: More Al'Aketh Ears
93459.objective_text: Collect 10 Al'Aketh Cultist's Ears from the Al'Aketh in Shadowgale Forest, the Shine of Akir, or Gustberry Lowlands and return them to Vayn Moonclaw in Shadowgale Forest.
93459.description:
The Al'Aketh cult normally gives this forest a wide berth, fearing the rumors that it is haunted... rumors we are happy to maintain. The Druids of my order wish only to live quiet, peaceful lives here in Shadowgale and they threaten that. 

Many among us are afraid.

I come with an offer. Fight the cultists for us, and bring us the ears of those you kill. We will reward you for each that you return with in both coin and, in time, access to our secrets should you prove yourself to be a true friend.
comments: So repetition for an additional 5 ears (first turn-in of blue "?") gave me 1000 Nightclaw Druids rep and brought me to Friendly with them.

93461.name: Welcome to Shen'dar Village
93461.objective_text: Speak with Rathiril Sunlance and Coriella Calmbreeze in Shen'dar Village.
93461.description:
You've got that "High Order" look to you. Those with Highborne ancestry always seem to have a slight twinkle in their eyes that gives it away. Before I properly put you to work around here, you should check in with our resident High Order elder Rathiril Sunlance. You can find him here in the main lodge, just around the corner from me.

Oh, and check in with Coriella Calmbreeze as well, she runs the local inn and can provide lodging and supplies, should you need them.
comments: Simple quest showing you around main NPCs in village.

93552.name: Harvesting Windstones
93552.objective_text: Collect 15 Windstone Clusters from Raw Windstones in Thendal Grove.
93552.description:
Windstones are a critical resource on Zephras Isle as they contain the raw, concentrated energy of the winds themselves. The wind elementals who used to live here on zephras with us vanished several centuries ago, and since then, the magic that sustains this island is slowly fading. Not without limitations, the Windstones are still a reliable energy source, and are incredibly valuable to us.

You'll find raw Windstones scattered around the grove, think you can help me harvest them?
comments: They spawn most commonly alongside the mountain ridges and the village ridges along the stone walls.

Quest allowing you to learn your first gathering profession.
You will receive the reward as an item, so totally up to you if you want to use it or not.
If you choose to learn skinning or mining do not forget to buy Skinning Knife / Mining Pick from Uualia Suncrest.
Also for a small amount of copper you can buy your first 4 slot reagent bag for the corresponding chosen reward.

93735.name: The Broken Construct
93735.objective_text: Find Riaani Nightwind on the west side of Valanaar.
93735.description:
Historically, the Windshapers have seen to the tending of the magical instruments and devices that were gifted to us by the spirits of the wind. This includes the myriad of magical constructs around the island. Since the spirits left us, only a scant few of these are still functional.

One of the few remaining working constructs in Valanaar has become damaged. One of our artisans was dispatched to help, but he may be in need of aid. Travel to the west end of the city and offer any assistance you can.

93736.name: Unwelcome Spirits
93736.objective_text: Gather 10 Wind Hollow Essences from Wind Hollows in the Shadowgale Forest.
93736.description:
The paramount concern of the Windshapers is to better understand why the spirits left us, and what we may be able to do to bring them back. One curious fixture of Shadowgale Forest to the north is the presence of a curious form of wind sprite that some call "hollows". We know little of them and why they are there, but we do know that they first started to appear after the spirits of the wind left us.

I need you to go there and disperse them. Gather the remains and bring them back here.

93737.name: The Broken Construct
93737.objective_text: Speak with Rianni Nightwind and list to what he has to say.

objectives.text: Listen to what Riaani Nightwind has to say

93737.description:
Oh, hello. Ayessa sent you to assist me? Very well then. 

Not sure what an obvious novice like yourself can do, but if you give me a moment to pull my head out of this construct's innards I might have a few ideas of things you can do to help.
comments: Whoever added the swimming part, what did I do to annoy you so much?

Air Construct Core - 45.0, 73.0 - On the left of the road above Windfield Orchard if you are walking towards the Shen'dar Highlands.

Enchanted Gyrozephyr - 52.0, 48.0 - At the bottom of Windsong Lake, above Falaath Village at the center of the map.

Crystallized Lightning - 52.0, 67.0 - Along the walls as you run through the cave.

This quest really frustrated me as I walked around asking for dir

woooooooooooow what an abortion of quest design this one was. 
it's crazy how obnoxious the horde quests are compared to the alliance quests in this area.

make the damn item 100% loot chance at the VERY least. 
competing over a loot (MULTIPLE TIMES) at the bottom of a lake with other players was top-tier trolling Blizzard.

93738.name: The Broken Construct
93738.objective_text: Report back to Ayessa Dawnsinger in Valanaar.
93738.description:
Brightwish, eh? So the High Order wanted to remove these components for some reason. But why though?

The High Order has always been meddlesome, constantly wanting to experiment with the wind spirits' magic. They are too bold by a mile, and we've strictly forbade them from meddling with knowledge under Windshaper purview, but lately they've been testing our patience. 

I think you should report what you've learned back to Ayessa Dawnsinger. She can instruct you further on what to do.

93740.name: Blood for Blood
93740.objective_text: Collect 10 Al'Aketh Windstone Charms from the corpses of Al'Aketh cultists in the Gustberry Lowlands.
93740.description:
A number of our Windshaper novices were found dead in the Highlands this morning. We can't be certain but there is a strong chance that the Al'Aketh are responsible. Windshapers trade blood for blood, every time.

Head north and kill any Al'Aketh you encounter. Bring me their windstone prayer charms as proof of the deed. We do not forgive and we do not forget.

93746.name: A Firm Response
93746.objective_text: Confront Belthaan Brightwish along the road to the Shrine of Akir.
93746.description:
The High Order has been warned of the consequences of meddling with the Windshaper's affairs. I think we need to make an example out of Belathaan and send him back to the High Order with a few bruises and a healthy respect for the boundaries we set.

Belathaan was seen leaving town, traveling north towards the Shrine of Akir. I don't know why he was going there, but confronting him alone on the road is the safest option. Find him, and put a bit of fear into his heart.
comments: As of Sept 20th in beta, this quest will not proceed after speaking with Belathaan Brightwish. The dialog option is present but nothing happens when clicking it. Bug report was submitted.
The only way right now is to whisper someone from /who for an invite to change layer, and start the encounter once the girl disappears

(Beta, 9/21): I had a bug where it wouldn't give me credit for killing the Living Storms, but relogging after fighting them unsuccessfully for the 3rd time auto-completed it for me. Abandoning and picking it back up did not fix it, which was my first instinct... save yourself the run.

93791.name: Speak with Belann
93791.objective_text: Speak with Belann Windwood in Valanaar.
93791.description:
<name>, it is clear your skill with magic is growing and I believe it is time for you to partake in one of the High Order's oldest traditions for young and aspiring mages. It is time for you to craft a spell focus of your own.

Seek out Belann Windwood in Valanaar. He has been crafting staves and wands for the High Order for over a century, so you will be in good hands.

93797.name: Boughs in the Wind
93797.objective_text: Bring a Wind-Infused Bough to Belann Windwood in Valanaar.
93797.description:
It is a time-honored tradition for young mages to create their own spell focus when they have shown a certain degree of magical proficiency. This is typically done by gathering a fallen branch from our oldest trees, as they have some lingering traces of elemental wind.

I have found the most ideal ones to be near the wind shrine, just south of Falaath Village. Go and bring me back a large branch and I will teach you about the traditions as we create your spell focus.
comments:
The item that you need to pick up off the ground to complete the quest is located at coords:
/way 48.5 68.2

93835.name: Confront Lorthuna
93835.objective_text: Take the portal to the Rohashi Spires overhead and join Elaadrin Evengale and Ayessa Dawnsinger in their confrontation with High Priestess Lorthuna.
93835.description:
Lorthuna fled up to the spires above using some sort of portal. Ayessa and Elaadrin went in after her. That was just a few moments ago.

I'm afraid I took one too many hits and this is where I stay. Go through the portal, find Elaadrin and help them stop Lorthuna.

Unless that help that Elaadrin and Ayessa said they sent for arrives soon, you are on your own from here. Good luck, <class>.

93836.name: The Fate of Zephras
93836.objective_text: Speak with Talaanis Shadowsong in Valanaar.
93836.description:
Muln has told me much of the elemental lords and I am afraid that we have good reason to fear Al'Akir. Now that the wards that have hidden Zephras from his view are down, we are utterly defenseless.. If he chooses to attack us, we stand no chance against him here in his own domain.

High Elder Shadowsong needs to know of the danger we are in, and more importantly, what our intentions are for our mission to Azeroth. We will find the means to save our home. I swear it.

93926.name: The Western Watch
93926.objective_text: Find Peacekeeper Vaaniel at the western watchtower.

objectives.text: Check in on the Western Watchtower in the Shen'dar Highlands

93926.description:
Whatever reason the cult has for attacking the tower, it's not worth losing our people over.

I'd like for you to head to the southwest and check in on that watchtower for us. Find the peacekeepers there and tell them to head back to the village. Holding that tower is not worth the lives it would cost and I'd rather concentrate the defenders we do have here to protect our citizens.

Peacekeeper Vaaniel is in charge, let him know to head back here as quickly as possible. Hurry!

93927.name: A Last Request
93927.objective_text: Collect the note you found near the dead peacekeeper and read it to determine your next steps.
93927.description: <As you inspect the body of the dead peacekeeper, a bloody note falls free of his hands. Picking it up and reading it may give you a clue as to how to proceed from here.>

93928.name: Of Mice and Milk
93928.description:
I need a cookie, see? 

Nyeah!
comments: What was the point of that? send a level 15 to STV for no reason at all? did my character hallucinate this?
Quest appears to be incomplete. Turning the quest in to Nesingwary just gives placeholder text.

93948.name: Deliver the Signet
93948.objective_text: Deliver the Shadowsong Family Signet to Talaanis Shadowsong in Valanaar.
93948.description:
Since you are going to Valanaar anyway, please deliver the signet ring you recovered from the tower to Talaanis Shadowsong in Valanaar. 

He will want this back, and more importantly, he will want to learn the fate of his nephew. Talaanis is the High Elder of Zephras Isle and more importantly, he is a good man who is well loved by the people, despite our current hardships. It pains me to think of how he will react to this news. Please express my condolences for his loss.

93949.name: Bugged
93949.objective_text: Kill Skyhoppers in Valanaar until you've eliminated 8 enchanted Skyhoppers.
93949.description:
We've been bugged.

It's skyhopper season in the lowlands, which means the pests are everywhere. One of the High Order mages reported that one of the insects that they killed had an enchantment of some kind placed upon it. When we inspected it closely it seems to be some sort of listening spell.

We suspect that the cult is using these enchanted insects as spies. Go and exterminate them for us. You won't be able to tell which are enchanted by looking at them, so you'll just have to kill them all.
comments: These are not random. Look for skyhoppers near areas listening to people. Such as the tower or the inn, it will always be enchanted.

93951.name: A Little Beauty
93951.objective_text: Collect 8 Hippogryph Down feathers in the Shen'dar Highlands.
93951.description:
The Hippogryph that have taken up residence southwest of the village can be a nuisance, but they also present a rather unique opportunity to obtain their feathers. Many skyborne love to adorn their hair with vibrant plumes and the down feathers of a hippogryph are exceptionally vibrant and more importantly, silky soft.

If you are heading that way, try and gather as many of the fallen feathers as you can from in and around their nesting grounds. Do be careful, as wild hippogryph are not tolerant of guests.

93958.name: The Inner Sanctum
93958.objective_text: Speak with Valennia Stormfist inside the inner sanctum at the Shrine of Akir.
93958.description:
Valennia's forces just breached the inner sanctum. The fighting was thick in there at first, but it's grown... unsettlingly quiet. Go in there and do your best to link up with Valennia and her forces... if any of them are left.

I'll stay here and watch your back.

93963.name: Exploring the Alliance
93963.objective_text: Speak with Randal Emerson in Stormwind Keep to receive further instructions. Use the instructions received to locate and speak with King Magni Bronzebeard, High Tinker Mekkatorque, and Tyrande Whisperwind.
93963.description:
Stormwind, Ironforge, and Darnassus all have unique peoples and cultures. As a guest of the Alliance here on Azeroth, you should take some time to visit each of our capital cities in turn. 

Speak with Randal Emerson in the southern antechamber for directions to get you started.

94003.name: The Skybreaker Bulwark
94003.objective_text: Reclaim the Skybreaker Bulwark from Zaal Stormshield at the Shrine of Akir.
94003.description:
I am all that remains of the line of Skybreakers here on Zephras Isle. The rest were murdered by the Al'Aketh.

The only thing that outweighs my sorrow is my shame. My family's ancestral shield--the Skybreaker Bulwark--is now in the hands of a cultist named Zaal Stormshield. Family lore holds no harm may befall a worthy wielder of this shield.

Zaal is not worthy, of that I am sure. Find this man at the Shrine of Akir and reclaim my shield from him. Do this and I will teach you the Skybreaker Defense.

94006.name: The Great Ursera Spirit
94006.objective_text: Speak with Urs'endris near the falls northeast of Valanaar.
94006.description:
Greetings, <name>. You have progressed in your druidic studies far enough that I think it is time for you to meet one of the great spirits that reside here on Zephras. Urs'endris is a wise and noble spirit, who has taught druids how to take on the ursera shape for generations. Unfortunately his domain has begun to wither and fall into the sky like many other areas of Zephras.

To find him, travel northeast near the waterfall in the shadow of the Shrine of Akir. He should be able to instruct you further.

94007.name: Taming the Beast
94007.objective_text: Report to Quel'ana Quickgale in Valanaar.
94007.description:
Now that you've gained a level of comfort in the wilds of the highlands, I believe it is time for you to seek your very own animal companion.

Go to the port of Valanaar to the southeast, and speak with Quel'ana Quickgale there. He will instruct you in the art of beast taming.

94013.name: Taming the Beast
94013.objective_text: Use the Taming Rod to tame a Vuldren Alpha in the Gustberry Lowlands. Practice your skills, then return the Taming Rod to Quel'ana Quickgale in Valanaar.
94013.description:
You've returned triumphant from taming two beasts, it's time now for your last trial. The winds of Zephras whisper of greater challenges ahead. 

Take this Taming Rod and journey to the Gustberry Lowlands. There, tame a Vuldren Alpha and prove your mastery. 

Complete this lesson and you'll be ready to learn the deeper ways of the hunter.

94050.name: Training the Beast
94050.objective_text: Speak to Quel'dora Quickgale in Valanaar.
94050.description:
You now have the power to tame a pet, but you must also gain the skills to train it. For this, there is none better than my sister, Quel'dora. She will give you the ability to train your new pet. 

Go with the winds, young <class>.

g.name: Craftsman's Writ: Lesser Troll's Blood Elixir

94217.name: Craftsman's Writ: Lesser Troll's Blood Elixir
94217.objective_text: Acquire the items requested by the customer and deliver them to the location marked on your map. This writ must be in your possession to complete the transaction.

objectives.text: Craftsman's Writ: Lesser Troll's Blood Elixir

94217.description: <Penned in faded ink, the note is requesting $2oa Lesser Troll's Blood Elixir, along with information about delivery location and payment.  At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.>

264017.name: Craftsman's Writ: Lesser Troll's Blood Elixir

list.name: Craftsman's Writ: Lesser Troll's Blood Elixir

94369.name: The Fate of Zephras
94369.objective_text: Speak with Talaanis Shadowsong in Valanaar.
94369.description:
Ansirem has told me much of the elemental lords and I am afraid that we have good reason to fear Al'Akir now that the wards that have hidden Zephras are down. If the Windlord chooses to attack us, we stand no chance to defend ourselves while we are here in his domain.

High Elder Shadowsong needs to know of the danger we are in, and more importantly, what our intentions are for our mission to Azeroth. We will find the means to save our home. I swear it.

94411.name: Meddlesome Mages
94411.objective_text: Slay 6 High Order Apprentices in Shen'dar Highlands.
94411.description:
Be warned, members of the High Order have been seen in the vicinity of the standing stones north of the village. We have warned them time and again to not meddle at our sacred sites, but they are growing more bold in pushing us. Prove your resolve to us by going to the standing stones and dispersing them.

I am loathe to condone outright bloodshed, but do what you must to drive them off. Return to me when its done.

94413.name: A Magical Affront
94413.objective_text: Slay 6 Windshaper Novice Seers in Shen'dar Highlands.
94413.description:
The recent emergence of the ley lines on the surface of Zephras has been profound for our order. We have more direct and tangible access to the energies that permeate this place and it has increased our understanding of said magic greatly.

The Windshapers, however, view these emergences as scars on the land that must be "healed". This is an affront to our order and is something we simply cannot abide.

Go to the ley line in the forest to the southwest and drive off the Windshapers you find there.

94414.name: The Anchors of Zephras
94414.objective_text: Speak with Halaan Hawk-Eye and borrow his gift to view the anchor pylon in the distance.
94414.description:
Greetings, young <name>. I often times come here to look upon the ancient anchor pylon. Gifts from the spirits of the winds, they bind and sustain our island. Of late however, their magic has grown unstable and inconsistent.

They suffer no distress I can see. Their splendor has not changed.

If you'd like, I can lend you my gift to look upon them yourself.
comments: First chance to look from above on the actual anchors and starting area.

94466.name: Call of Fire
94466.objective_text: Bring 1 Fire Tar and 1 Reagent Pouch to Braldir Ashmantle in Loch Modan.
94466.description:
Bah, ye didn't trek all this way for tales, did ye, <name>? Ye seek the Eternal Flame and the fire totem.

First, ye'll need a sapta to bind yer spirit to the flame.

I'll craft it--but I'll need two things: fire tar from Tunnel Rat Geomancers in the kobold caves up north, and a reagent pouch from a Stonesplinter Seer lurkin' in the southern hills. Dangerous work, but worthy of the flame.

94467.name: Call of Fire
94467.objective_text: Defeat the Minor Manifestation of Fire, and place the Glowing Ember in the brazier atop the Shrine of Eternal Flame.
94467.description:
The fire sapta's ready, <name>. Now ye face the flame. Use it at the shrine, then climb to the peak. There, ye'll see the spirit--he'll not strike 'til ye do, but he'll know ye see him.

Strike fast, lad. The longer ye wait, the stronger he burns. When he falls, take his glowing embers and place 'em in the brazier. Light the torch and earn the fire's favor.

94473.name: Fire Sapta
94473.objective_text: Speak to Braldir Ashmantle for another Fire Sapta

94484.name: Unnerving Silence
94484.objective_text: Find and speak with Elegael Thornpaw in the northeastern part of Shadowgale Forest.
94484.description:
A moment, if you will <name>. Are you headed towards Shadowgale Forest? There is a druid conclave there in a cave to the northeast. I have been waiting on word from them but their correspondence is long overdue.

With Ban'aethall in ruins and all the unrest lately I worry something dire may have happened. Please, if you are able go, seek out Elegael Thornpaw and put my mind at ease.

94485.name: Tears of the Lady
94485.description:
If we are to save my fellows in the Nightclaw Den, I am going to need some ingredients for a poultice. The first and most important is a spindly moss called Lady's Tear. It typically grows on the base of the trees here in Shadowgale.

This moss secretes a sticky substance that acts as an antiseptic and is perfect for binding open wounds. I have gathered what little I can reach but I know there is more in this forest.

Go and be swift. We are going to need a lot if the injured I left behind still live.
comments: If you were looking all over the floor for moss like me, look up as they're hanging from the sides of trees in the area

94486.name: Feathers for Binding
94486.objective_text: Collect 20 feathers from the Shadowgale Shrieklings in Shadowgale Forest.
94486.description:
The other ingredient I need for the poultice is feathers from the Shadowgale shrieklings that roam this forest. In their juvenile form, the shrieklings have insulative feathers which would be ideal to put over the moss. These feathers will prevent the antiseptic sap from drying out and will provide at least some protection against the elements.

Be warned, the shrieklings are normally docile but they have been incredibly hostile of late. Their large talons can easily disembowel you if you aren't careful.

94487.name: Unwanted and Unworthy
94487.objective_text: Collect 10 Bloodied Heirlooms from Al'Aketh Footsoldiers and Al'Aketh Stormchasers in the Shadowgale Forest.
94487.description:
The Al'aketh Cultists ambushed us with no warning, though their motives remain a mystery to me. I knew these cultists had clouds in-between their ears, but I never imagined they would upset the delicate balance here on Zephras with such brutality. Go, slay as many as you can and take their heirlooms if they wear any.

<Elegael spits.>

These storm cursed cultists don't deserve to be called shen'dorei. The beasts of the forest can have their bodies. Their ashes don't deserve the winds.

94488.name: The Ties That Bind
94488.objective_text: Kill Commander Haalien and bring his head to Elegael Thornpaw in the Shadowgale Forest.
94488.description:
The reason for cultists presence here still baffles me, but I smell a familiar scent over the bloodshed.

One of our circle druids, Haalien, disappeared months back. It appears he's thrown his sorry hide in with the cultists.

Show him what happens when he spills the blood of his kin! Take his head and return it to me.
comments: The head of the commander is not in the cave. He is outside around 65 36.

94489.name: The Wounds of Betrayal
94489.objective_text: Enter the Nightfang Den and heal 7 druids and find Jorel Windsinger in Shadowgale Forest.
94489.description:
I have finished the poultices. Quickly, take them to the druids in the cave, north just across the clearing. I know my brethren are in much more dire condition than I. They are likely too injured to heal their own wounds. There are so few of us shen'dorei druids that every life is precious.

Before you go, I have a selfish request. My mate, Jorel Windsinger was in dire condition when I left. Please, see to his wounds if he still lives.
comments: Could only heal 6 out of 7 druids. Can't find the 7th anywhere
Quest seems to be bugged still, can only heal 6/7
In the new hotfix as of 9/22 its now bugged at 0/7 :'(

I was unsure if I needed some sort of ointment in my bag to heal the druids but all you have to do is enter the den/cave, find all 7 druids that turn your cursor into a "hand" when you mouse over, then click the druid and they get "healed". No enemies to fight, very easy quest.

Quest worked for me, I could heal all 7 druids.

94490.name: Ripped Missive
94490.objective_text:
Bring the Ripped Missive to Elegael Thornpaw in the Shadowgale Forest.

Provided item:
94490.description: <Tucked behind one of Haalien's bracers is a note that's been slightly torn and bloodstained in your fight. It looks like it contains useful information for about the cultist motivations for the attack on the druid den. Elegael would be interested in this intel.>

94491.name: The Fate of the Den
94491.objective_text:
Give the missive to Lotheluum in Valannar and tell him what has transpired.

Provided item:
94491.description:
It would appear that there is a correspondent hiding somewhere in Valanaar feeding information to the cult. I am clearly in no shape to make the journey, but Lotheluum needs to know what transpired here.

He should also know the fate of those who are no longer with us. Thanks to your help I think we can handle the rest of the situation from here, thought the damage has been done.

Please go swiftly, <name>. I hope our paths will cross again someday. Until then, I have cultists to slay.

94493.name: A Sacrifice in Vain
94493.objective_text: Speak with Elegael Thornpaw in the northeastern part of Shadowgale Forest.
94493.description:
Thank goodness our message got to Lotheluum. Wait, where are the rest of the reinforcements? Surely it is not just you they sent?

<Elegael pales as you explain yourself.>

So the message did not get to Valanaar. We are in dire straights indeed then.

<Elegael sighs deeply then looks resolute.>

Then we must handle this on our own. Time is of the essence.

94494.name: Call of Water
94494.objective_text: Find Norric Lochthane in Loch Modan.
94494.description:
Long has it been since ye were last tested, <name>. Ye have shown patience thus far in yer studies, but the time has come for ye to learn about the purity of water.

Seek out Norric Lochthane in Loch Modan. He is along the north western edge o' the lake, south of Stonewrought Dam. Ye  will find him there at his burrow hut. Good luck to ye, <name>.

94495.name: Call of Water
94495.objective_text: Find Hervdana Saegrund in the Wetlands.
94495.description:
If there's one truth ye need to learn about water, it's this: water means rebirth. It carves stone, cleanses filth, and heals the weary -- but only when it's pure. Taint it, and it'll ruin all it touches.

If ye seek the water sapta, find Hervdana Saegrund in the Wetlands. Her family dwells in a cave beneath the southern falls.

Go on then, don't let the river outrun ye.

94497.name: Call of Water
94497.objective_text: Fill the Empty Brown Waterskin at the bottom of the waterfalls below Hervdana's cave and return it to her in the Wetlands.
94497.description:
Ah, so ye've come seekin' the sapta, have ye? Well then, listen close, love. To find understandin' and earn the sapta, ye must seek water in its various forms. As ye gather the samples, keep yer eyes open. Watch the beasts that guard it, the land it nourishes, and how it changes lives.

We'll start simple: fill this skin at the base o' the falls, where the fresh meets the brackish. Go on now, and mind the marsh.

94499.name: Call of Water
94499.objective_text: Fill the Empty Red Waterskin at Stonewatch Falls near the Nightcrawler Murlocs and return to Hervdana Saegrund in the Wetlands.
94499.description:
Aye, Redridge drinks deep from Lake Everstill, but by the time the waters tumble down Stonewatch Falls, somethin' has seeped in. The murlocs down there are big, twisted brutes. Not like the ones ye find here or in the Loch. Lucky for the townsfolk they keep to the base o' the falls.

Bring a sampling to me. I've a mind to find out if it's magic, venom, or somethin' worse that's taintin' the waters near that old fort.

94500.name: Call of Water
94500.objective_text: Fill the Unfilled Blue Waterskin at the waters of Astranaar in Ashenvale and return to Hervdana Saegrund in the Wetlands.
94500.description:
Take this waterskin and journey deep into the emerald shade o' Ashenvale. Astranaar rests cradled by waters untouched by corruption. Ruins litter the bed o' the lake, hinting at a bygone era. Bring back a sample from the lake. Pure, ancient, and possibly enchanted water.

It's the last liquid I need before I send ye back to Norric.

Board the boat in Menethil to Auberdine, it stops in Southshore on the way over.

And mind yerself... the forest's got eyes, and they don't blink.

94501.name: Call of Water
94501.objective_text: Bring the Vial of Purest Water to Norric Lochthane in Loch Modan.
94501.description: Norric will have one more task for ye before rewarding ye with the water totem rites. The vial of water I've given ye is necessary for whatever that task is. Go now and find him. We shall meet again some day.

end.name: Object #619896 (unnamed, e.g. a poster or crate)

94502.name: Call of Water
94502.objective_text:
Cleanse the corruption at Stendel's Pond in Westfall.
Return to Norric in Loch Modan when finished.
94502.description:
In Westfall, outside o' Moonbrook lies Stendel's Pond. Once a pure spring, now touched by dark forces. The spirits there 'ave gone silent. 

Ye must face the corruption that fouls the waters. Take its bracers and the last drops o' Hervdana's potion, then place 'em on the shrine. That'll call forth a spirit, cleansed and true. Speak with it, learn what ye can.

Bring me proof the deed's done, and I'll grant ye the totem.

94505.name: Call of Water
94505.objective_text: Bring the Shard of Water to Norric Lochthane in Loch Modan.
94505.description:
Take shard. Take shard and give life.

Give life and understand. Understand water is life... corruption stops life.

You protect and give life with water's power.

94568.name: The Cult's True Plans
94568.objective_text: Speak with Talaanis Shadowsong and observe the conversation.

objectives.text: Learn what you can from the crystal

94568.description:
The turncoat clearly was afraid of the what the cult had planned, enough so to defect and seek our aid. It's truly unfortunate that he is dead and took his secrets to the grave with him.

We must discuss this further to determine our next steps.

94638.name: Strength and Mercy
94638.objective_text: Find and kill Ur'endra in the Shen'dar Highlands.
94638.description:
You have come to me in hopes of learning to take a shape of strength. I have a task for you, though it lays heavy on my heart.

My mate, Ur'endra, has lost herself to madness and has begun to attack her own kin. Without the winds many creatures have begun to lose themselves, and with Ur'endra's great might she poses a dire threat to the delicate balance. She roams the Shen'dar Highlands to the northwest of here.

Show me you have the fortitude to end her suffering and I shall grant you my blessing.
comments:
Had a bit of trouble to find it myself as I was looking for it next to the foggy cave but instead it's on the upper mountainface. So, from Valanaar take the path west instead of north.

What I recommend is you take this quest Catching Wind and complete it at the same time as its on the way. From there, you can cross the river via the wooden log bridge and Ur'Endra is right in the cave at the edge

94774.name: Divine Grace
94774.objective_text: Speak to High Priestess Laurena in Stormwind.
94774.description: You've caught the attention of our superiors, <name>. They've asked you travel to the Cathedral of Light in Stormwind as soon as possible. Apparently they feel you've proven yourself already and are prepared to further your training. When you get there, find High Priestess Laurena. She will be able to guide you further. Good luck, and may the Light be with you.

94792.name: Taming the Beast
94792.objective_text: Use the Taming Rod to tame a Rockhide Boar. Practice your skills, then return the Taming Rod to Josephine Carson.
94792.description:
Many hunters prefer to travel with animal companions. With a beast at your side, you will find that you can survive even the most dangerous of circumstances. As they say, everything is easier with a friend. However, obtaining an animal companion is something that must be done with care. The balance of nature is delicate, and must always be respected.

Take this Taming Rod with you to the forest. With it, you will be able to tame a Rockhide Boar and practice your skills as a hunter.

94793.name: Training the Beast
94793.objective_text: Speak to Isaac Chan in Goldshire.
94793.description:
You now have the power to tame a pet, but you must also gain the skills to train it. For this, there is none better than Isaac Chan, a lifelong woodsman. He will give you the ability to train your new pet.

Go with the winds, young <class>.

94819.name: Contingency Plan
94819.objective_text: Speak to High Priestess Mims in Ironforge.
94819.description: <name>, your High Priestess Mims would have an audience with you in Ironforge. Make haste, my clever friend, your next test quickly approaches. Although I wish I could bear witness to your race's own special rites, my place is here. But may the Light go with you in your travels. Mims should still be in the Mystic Ward once you reach the city. She will be waiting.

94822.name: Confounding Flash
94822.objective_text: Speak to High Priestess Mims in Ironforge.
94822.description: You've caught the attention of our superiors, <name>. They've asked you travel to the Hall of Mysteries in Ironforge as soon as possible. Apparently they feel you've proven yourself already and are prepared to further your training. When you get there, find High Priestess Mims. She will be able to guide you further. Good luck, and may the Light be with you.

94863.name: Taming the Beast
94863.objective_text: Use the Taming Rod to tame a Gray Forest Wolf. Practice your skills, then return the Taming Rod to Josephine Carson.
94863.description:
You've alraedy mastered taming a boar, now it's time for the next lesson. The forest holds fiercer companions, and with care, you can earn their trust.

Take this Taming Rod and seek out a Gray Forest Wolf. Remember, nature's balance must be respected. Prove your skill as a hunter once more.

94864.name: Taming the Beast
94864.objective_text: Use the Taming Rod to tame a Young Forest Bear. Practice your skills, then return the Taming Rod to Josephine Carson.
94864.description:
You've proven yourself by taming a boar and a wolf, now it's time for your final challenge. Elwynn's balance depends on respect and skill. Take this Taming Rod and seek out a Young Forest Bear. Show that you can earn the trust of even the mightiest companion. 

Completing this lesson will deepen your attunement to beasts.

94896.name: Aid For The Refugees
94896.objective_text: Collect 8 Abandoned Belongings from the ruins of Ban'aethal.
94896.description:
You look like a capable adventurer. Do you happen to be headed towards Shadowgale Forest? Ban'aethal lies deep in the forest; that's where we're all from.

<Ealaane gestures to the other refugees.>

We've recently had to evacuate Ban'aethal, as it began to fall into the sky. It was sudden and in the middle of the night. If you are headed that way, would you please look for any belongings left behind? The forest and village are far too dangerous for us to return to now.

g.name: The Fate of a Loved One

94897.name: The Fate of a Loved One
94897.objective_text: Find Resaan in the Ruins of Ban'aethal.
94897.description:
If you are traveling to Ban'aethal, I have a selfish request. My love, Resaan... I believe is no longer a part of this world. He had tried to go back to get supplies even though I begged him to stay. It has been over a week already and I fear the worst.

Please, if you find him bring him home. If he has perished then I beg you to please bring me his heirloom.
comments: The Resaan's heirloom is found on a corpse outside a ruined building in NW of the quest area. Resaan Nimbuswalker Ban'aethal Citizen.

list.name: The Fate of a Loved One

94912.name: Child of Nature
94912.objective_text: Speak with Sheldras Moontree in Stormwind.
94912.description:
Greetings, young <class>. 

Have you heard of the Cenarion Circle? I'd expect not. They are an ancient order of naturalists and practitioners of the druidic arts, much like yourself. In the city of Stormwind you'll find a night elf by the name of Sheldras Moontree. He will teach you how to reach the stronghold of the Cenarion Circle on Kalimdor, a place called Moonglade.

Go now. You have much to learn if you wish to save your home.

94914.name: Moonglade
94914.objective_text: Use the spell "Teleport: Moonglade" to travel to Moonglade.  When you arrive, speak with Dendrite Starblaze in the village of Nighthaven.
94914.description:
All druids are welcomed to the sacred lands of Moonglade.  Keeper Remulos - Moonglade's guardian - keeps watch over all druids who hibernate there. I'll teach you the spell that lets you transport yourself there. Cast it whenever you seek Moonglade's knowledge or solace.

As for your first lesson here on Azeroth, travel to Moonglade and speak with Dendrite Starblaze in Nighthaven about the path you're now on. Good luck, young druid.

94946.name: The Magical City of Dalaran
94946.objective_text: Take the skycutter ship from Zephras Isle to Dalaran City and speak with Danaaris Stargale when you arrive.
94946.description:
I had intended to be the first of us to step foot onto Azeroth, but recent events with the cult have changed my plans. As a result, I will be remaining here in Valanaar for a time. Fret not though, one of our mages will be waiting to receive you upon your arrival in Dalaran. I'd encourage you to explore Azeroth while we set our affairs in order here. We will call upon you when you are needed.

When you are ready, please proceed to the dock just outside this lodge and board the skycutter ship there.

94947.name: Welcome to Azeroth
94947.objective_text: Take the Skyborne Portal to Stormwind and report to Bolvar Fordragon in Stormwind Keep.

objectives.text: Take the Skyborne Portal to Stormwind

94947.description:
Its a big world down here, and we need our people to start branching out to explore it. That's where you come in.

The Kirin Tor is a member of an "Alliance" of like-minded nations. The de-facto heart of this alliance is the city of Stormwind to the south. Elaadrin has asked me to find someone to travel to Stormwind and meet with the regent lord there, a human named Bolvar Fordragon.

When you are ready, the Kirin Tor mages have set up a special portal for the High Order to use to access Stormwind.

94978.name: Taming the Beast
94978.objective_text:
Use the Taming Rod to tame a Windsong Crawler found near bodies of water. 
Practice your skills, then return the Taming Rod to Quel'ana Quickgale in Valanaar.
94978.description:
Every hunter begins by learning the bond between beast and master. This is your first challenge. In time, you'll tame creatures from every corner of the world, but for now, start with our rivers and lakes on Zephras. 

Take this Taming Rod and seek out a Windsong Crawler.

Show that you can earn its trust, and begin your path toward true mastery.

94979.name: Taming the Beast
94979.objective_text:
Use the Taming Rod to tame an Ornery Galestrider in the Gustberry Lowlands. 
Practice your skills, then return the Taming Rod to Quel'ana Quickgale in Valanaar.
94979.description:
You've proven you can tame the river's crawler, now it's time to test your skill on open ground. The plains of Zephras echo with the cries of the Galestrider, a proud, winged hunter that runs like the wind.

Take this Taming Rod and seek one out. Travel to the lowlands and earn its trust.

Show you're ready for the trials yet to come.

95042.name: Seeking the Kor Gem
95042.objective_text: Bring a Kor Gem to Ulric Frostveil in Ashenvale.
95042.description:
A Forsaken paladin... here in Ashenvale? Amusing. 

So you seek a Kor Gem? Unsurprising as these are sometimes employed to empower magical weapons and implements by the paladins of the alliance. Why should a fallen paladin like you be any different?

If you truly desire one of the gems, then you must head north to the ruins known as Blackfathom Deeps. The naga who still use the gems are down below. Do not go alone, <class>.
comments: Ott is at the south east part of Tarren Mill. He's next to a Horde Wagon. You basically turn it in and accept the next quest where you spend about 30 seconds watching him forge the sword.

95065.name: Fishin' Time
95065.objective_text: Bring 1 Shiny Bauble and 3 Nightcrawlers to Gilbert Gray at the harbor in Stormwind.
95065.description:
What a view... Best an old man can ask for.

The fish sure are bitin' now, though I'm down to my last bait. I don't suppose you have any spare fishing supplies on you? Of course not, forgive me. I get so excited at the thought of casting another line it didn't dawn on me I may be one of the few carrying supplies everywhere I go.

Would you be able to help refresh my stock? Catherine Leland has an assortment of fishing goods just west of the Trade District along the canals. Tell her old Gray sent you.

95161.name: Remember That I Love You
95161.objective_text: Deliver the Blood-Stained Letter to Avette Fellwood in Duskwood.
95161.description:
If you're looking for Jeremy Heartweaver, your best bet is to talk to his newly adopted mother, Avette Fellwood out in Duskwood. Sweet woman. Likely needs another pair of hands for her work, but it beats staying in the orphanage.

If you see little Jeremy do be sure to tell him we're all thinking of him, won't you?
comments:
The "Blood-Stained Letter" can be found in the Dungeon Ruins of Lordaeron at Undercity.
It is located at the Graveyard deep inside the dungeon at one of the bosses.
After picking it up, bring it to Orphan Matron Nightingale infront of the Stormwind Cathedral.
She will send you to Darkshire in Duskwood where your gonna talk to Avette Fellwood, to give her the letter and turn in the 2nd quest.

95189.name: Crest of Lordaeron
95189.objective_text: Return the Crest of Lordaeron to Lady Dena Kennedy in Stormwind City.
95189.description: <A weathered crest depicting the mark of Lordaeron. With so few relics left after the kingdom's fall, someone in Stormwind would be very keen to get their hands on this.>
comments:
This item you can find in ground or pinned to the wall in tower in dungeon Ruins or Lordaeron.
Works also for Horde.

95195.name: Bloodied Insignia
95195.objective_text: Collect 10 Bloodied Insignias and take them to General Marcus Jonathan in Stormwind City.
95195.description: <The old Alliance insignia appears to have belonged to a soldier of Lordaeron. These ruins are likely filled with similar medals that living relatives would be grateful to have returned to them.>

95204.name: Crest of Lordaeron
95204.objective_text: Bring the Crest of Lordaeron to Oran Snakewrithe in Undercity.
95204.description: <A weathered crest depicting the mark of Lordaeron. With so few relics left after the kingdom's fall, someone in the Undercity would be very keen to get their hands on this.>

95216.name: The New Plague
95216.objective_text: Collect the Highly Toxic Strain from Witherfang in Ruins of Lordaeron for Theodore Griffs in Undercity.
95216.description:
Welcome to the most vital organ of the Undercity: The Apothecarium! Here we experiment on the most virulent of Azeroth's exotic specimens.

You've caught me in a good mood, so I will let you in on my latest investigation. It appears there is a particularly venomous arthropod stalking the ruins above our fair city. Its toxins are said to eat through even undead flesh. How exhilarating!

I wish to validate these claims. Should you find yourself withering away from its bite, I should love a sample.

95250.name: Abominable Creatures
95250.objective_text: Collect the Head of the Baron in the Ruins of Lordaeron and bring it back to Captain Truman.
95250.description:
What do you want, <race>? Can't you see there is a war to be won?

My master has already charged into the fray and has ordered me to maintain my post. It has been quite some time, however.

I doubt you'll survive ten minutes in combat, but if it keeps your simple mind busy, why don't you seek out the Grand Marshal. He is the tallest, most statuesque hero you've ever laid eyes on. You'll know him when you see him.
comments: You can find Captain Truman to the left right as you enter the dungeon.

95349.name: The Earthen Ring
95349.objective_text: Take the skycutter ship from Zephras Isle to Mulgore and speak with Alana Stormwalker when you arrive.
95349.description:
The recent events with the cult have delayed my plans to travel to Azeroth and I must remain here in Valanaar for a time. You and a handful of other Windshapers will be our vanguard instead. Alaana Stormwalker will be waiting to receive you upon your arrival in Mulgore, and I'd encourage you to explore Azeroth while we finish our business here. We will join you soon.

When you are ready, please proceed to the dock just outside this lodge and board the skycutter ship there. Banu-Alah, <name>.
comments:
I might have been unlucky, but the ship took a while to arrive!
I believe it was 7-8 minutes.

95816.name: Sign Me Up!
95816.objective_text: Bring the completed form to Elaine Compton in Redridge Mountains.
95816.description:
Greetings, accomplished craftsperson!

Completion of this form will grant you non-exclusive, revocable, and legally limited permission to display advertisement signs for your tradeskill(s) all across Azeroth!

Once completed, please bring this to your local Azeroth Commerce Authority branch's Contract Coordinator to begin processing.

Happy crafting!

95998.name: The Great Outdoors
95998.objective_text: Sit near Sam's Basic Campfire by typing /sit in the chat window and wait until you receive the Boosted Rest buff.

objectives.text: Use the /sit emote near the campfire

95998.description:
Well howdy there, <class>. I can see you've got the look of an adventurer about you. Good for you. The world needs more of us restless souls, seeking fortune and glory.

It's a big wide world out there and you'll need to learn to thrive in the wilds to be successful. Not sure how your outdoorsman skills are but I reckon I could teach you a thing or two, if you'd be apt to learn.

Have a seat near the fire, get comfy. I'll walk you through it.
comments: Bugged in the beta, no matter how long you sit at his fire, you won't get the Boosted Rest buff.

start.name: Object #649051 (unnamed, e.g. a poster or crate)

95999.name: WANTED: Incinerator Gar'im
95999.objective_text: Deliver the Broken Staff of Incinerator Gar'im to Magistrate Solomon in Lakeshire.
95999.description:
Wanted! Incinerator Gar'im, Leader of an orc incursion in Render's Valley. Purported to be working with the Blackrock of Stonewatch Keep.

Beware of Incinerator Gar'im. He and his Shadowcasters are extremely dangerous. A handsome reward will to be given to any brave soul that can deliver proof of Incinerator Gar'im's demise to Magistrate Solomon.

96045.name: Camping 101: Alchemy
96045.objective_text: Speak with Vosur Brakthel in Ironforge to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
96045.description: Now that you've taken up Alchemy, I can also teach you how to craft a Mana Well for your camp once you've learned a bit. Build one of these and all of the healers and spellcaster types will come running to get a refreshing taste.

96059.name: Camping 101: Enchanting
96059.objective_text: Speak with Thonys Pillarstone in Ironforge to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
96059.description:
Now that you've begun your journey into being an enchanter, I reckon I can teach you how to craft an Enchanted Lute for your camp once you've learned the ropes.

It's so important to find entertainment during your downtime, and this bit of magic can help ensure you are ready to weather all sorts of challenges when you hit the old dusty trail once again.

96101.name: The Great Outdoors
96101.objective_text: Sit near Raan's Basic Campfire by typing /sit in the chat window and wait until you receive the Boosted Rest buff.

objectives.text: Use the /sit emote near the campfire

96101.description:
Greetings, <class>. I can see you've got the look of an adventurer about you. This is good. The world needs more of us restless souls, seeking fortune and glory.

You'll need to learn to thrive in the wilds to be successful in this line of work. Not sure how your outdoor skills are but I can probably teach you a thing or two, if you'd be apt to learn.

Have a seat near the fire and get comfortable. I'll walk you through it.
comments:
Introduction to camp system.

Will open quests for each profession you learned already (will do so later on for the ones you learn later).
Camping 101: Profession

96137.name: Ira's Dagger
96137.objective_text: Defeat 10 Young Black Ravagers and 7 Black Ravagers then return to Sirra Von'Indi in Darkshire for more information.
96137.description:
A small dagger belonging to the self-appointed ranger, Ira, who kept the forests safe by preventing the beasts within from attacking travelers.

With Ira's spirit still wandering the woods, perhaps her unfinished business was to clear out the worg that continue to claim victims throughout the forest.
comments: In the Beta, this quest can be acquired from Bathrah the Windwatcher. Might be a bug idk

96138.name: Merrick's Bow
96138.objective_text: Defeat 8 Splint Fist Warriors and 4 Splint Fist Taskmasters then return to Sirra Von'Indi in Darkshire for more information.
96138.description:
A bow left by the spirit of Merrick Valor, famed Watcher who prided himself on keeping the roads safe from encroaching enemies.

With Merrick's spirit still wandering the roads, perhaps his unfinished business was to clear out invaders near his home in Raven Hill. The ogres south of town may be what's troubling his spirit.

96139.name: The Valor Family
96139.objective_text: Search Raven Hill for anything of interest and return to Sirra Von'Indi in Darkshire.
96139.description:
In dark times like these, it's important we remember our heroes as much as our foes. Darkshire would not still be standing if it weren't for the bravery of folk like the good Lady Althea or those who lost their lives at Raven Hill.

Have you read much on Raven Hill? No, of course not. Its history was wiped out along with its people. My library, impressive as it is, has little on the subject.

If you happen to find anything, I would appreciate bringing it here. Those folk deserve to be remembered.
comments:
New lore and quest line in Duskwood!

This quest introduces a new story around the Valor family of Raven Hill. They were a family of local protectors: Grant was a celebrated hero, Silvia became a Raven Hill Guard, Merrick watched the roads, and Ira ranged the surrounding woods. Their spirits are now scattered around Duskwood as the four "Lost" NPCs.

Sirra Von'Indi sends you to Raven Hill to searc

96394.name: The Restless Dead
96394.objective_text: Kill 15 Enraged Apparitions, 10 Tormented Souls and put the spirit of Anvilmar to rest.
96394.description:
Something has disturbed the tombs down in the Hall of Thanes, and strange noises have been heard coming from deep within the vaults. The spirits of the dead are light sleepers, and whatever is going on down there seems to have startled them.

Head down there and see what you can do about that for us. If any of the dead are awake--well, put them back down!

96395.name: An Ancient Grudge
96395.objective_text: Put the spirit of Faldrim Anvilmar to rest in the Hall of Thanes.
96395.description:
The... Thane... my mighty... Thane... he... needs to... rest.

Please... help him... help him... rest...

Consumed... by... ancient... grudge... No... rest...
comments: Quest starts and ends inside the dungeon

96403.name: Important Heirlooms
96403.objective_text: Collect 8 Dwarven Heirlooms from the Hall of Thanes.
96403.description:
You there, adventurer... I could really use your aid.

I was sneaking--uh... 'patrolling' in the vaults when a force of Dark Iron dwarves emerged from the depths in mole machines! I don't know what they are here for, but there is priceless loot--uh or, rather... I mean, 'important cultural heirlooms' down there! Please, recover any such relics you see and return them here.

I assure you that anything you recover will be catalogued and returned to its proper place of honor.

96606.name: The Great Outdoors
96606.objective_text: Sit near Lyreena's Basic Campfire by typing /sit in the chat window and wait until you receive the Boosted Rest buff.

objectives.text: Use the /sit emote near the campfire

96606.description:
Greetings, <class>. I can see you've got the look of an adventurer about you. This is good. The world needs more of us restless souls, seeking fortune and glory.

You'll need to learn to thrive in the wilds to be successful in this line of work. Not sure how your outdoor skills are but I can probably teach you a thing or two, if you'd be apt to learn.

Have a seat near the fire and get comfortable. I'll walk you through it.

96626.name: Camping 101: Cooking
96626.objective_text: Speak with Tomas in Goldshire to learn to become a cook.

objectives.text: Learn cooking from Tomas in Goldshire

96626.description:
So you want to learn more about camping, huh? Good for you, <class>. The first step any adventurer needs to take is to become a cook and learn how to make a campfire.

Cooking's not just about making tasty foods. It's also the foundation for your camp.

96627.name: The Adventurer
96627.objective_text: Speak to Sam Sarsparilla near Goldshire.
96627.description:
<name>, you have proven your competence as a protector thus far. That is why I am now entrusting you with an unusual task.

I've heard of a new adventurer down the road by Goldshire. Go and see what he's doing.

start.name: Object #654846 (unnamed, e.g. a poster or crate)

96630.name: The Adventurer
96630.objective_text: Bring the journal to Lyreena Duskblade near Dolanaar.
96630.description:
<The journal appears to be quite plain, detailing the life and adventures of someone you've never heard of.

There are multiple entries mentioning camping. It seems to be quite... fun.>
comments: Quest starts from a book on a table behind Tenaron Stormgrip at the top of Aldrassil in Shadowglen.

96634.name: Camping 101: Cooking
96634.objective_text: Speak with Zarrin in Dolanaar to learn to become a cook.

objectives.text: Learn cooking from Zarrin in Dolanaar

96634.description:
So you want to learn more about camping, huh? Good for you, <class>. The first step any adventurer needs to take is to become a cook and learn how to make a campfire.

Cooking's not just about making tasty foods. It's also the foundation for your camp.

96638.name: The Adventurer
96638.objective_text: Speak to Raan Wildwind near Shen'dar Village.
96638.description:
More and more adventurers like yourself have been seeking glory and fortune outside of the safety of Thendal Grove. There's one such adventurer who has made a camp outside of Shen'dar Village, along the road leading southwest out of Thendal Grove.

Seek him out and see what you can learn from him that may help you in your own travels.
comments: Quest sending you from Thendal Village to Shen'dar Village.

96646.name: Camping 101: Cooking
96646.objective_text: Speak with Zerril Softbreeze in Shen'dar Village to learn to become a cook.

objectives.text: Learn cooking from Zerril Softbreeze in Shen'dar Village

96646.description:
So you want to learn more about camping, huh? Good for you, <class>. The first step any adventurer needs to take is to become a cook and learn how to make a campfire.

Cooking's not just about making tasty foods. It's also the foundation for your camp.

97220.name: Philmor's Favor
