97220.objective_text: Bring the Gatehouse Shipment to the stockroom entrance located in Trias' Cheese shop in the Trade District
97220.description:
Every day this week we've been short dockhands.

Care to ease the stress on our cargo schedule?

Take this package to the stockroom entrance of the Gatehouse. You'll find it inside Trias' Cheese shop on the second floor. The mistress, Elaine, will be quite familiar with the deliveries. The Gatehouse often has shipments arriving with more discretion to allow for ceremonial surprises on behalf of the guard's officers.

97222.name: Gatehouse Goods
97222.objective_text: Carry the Gatehouse Shipment up the stairs in Trias' shop and leave it outside the door.
97222.description:
Yes, it's only a flight of stairs, but if it's such a small ask, it should be no problem for you to finish the delivery yourself! 

Trias' Cheese isn't part of the Gatehouse or their stocking inventory, but our buildings share a floor.

Place the crate outside their stockroom door--the guard will send someone for a regular pickup. They will see the package arrival and carry it inside as they return to post.

97234.name: Reading Room
97234.objective_text: Bring the wrapped reading material to the Stormwind library.
97234.description:
Are you here to discuss the deeper meanings of our storied legends? No?

Well, after you're done looking around, can you carry this to the library for me? We're exchanging some of our less popular bodies of work for some more modern writing. I have a list of tomes I'm quite sure the librarian will be able to procure for us within our existing arrangement.

Complimentary club refreshments on us, if you help us out.

97236.name: Fang of Githyiss
97236.objective_text: Deliver the the Fang of Githyiss to someone interested in the study of spiders in Aldrassil.
97236.description: A fresh specimen from a beast of this size is quite a find. Perhaps someone in Aldrassil familiar with the study of spiders would be interested in the fang.

97237.name: Shelf Picked
97237.objective_text: Find each of the reading materials located somewhere in the library and then return to Roy Lewells in Stormwind's Park.
97237.description:
I've checked our inventory and all of the selections Mr. Lewells has listed are currently available.

You will, however, need to procure them off the shelves yourself. Part of our librarian duty is vigilance, and for that, I will resume supervisory bookkeeping.

Returning with the material to Roy on his behalf will not mark yourself accountable for their return; as with his note you're serving as the book club's official courier. Their establishment shall carry that burden.

Good day, <name>.
comments: I found Field Accounts of Horde Razings under one of the bookshelves in the back row. Cycles of Morality is on the back table.

Field Accounts of Horde Razings scroll under first row of bookshelves on side of entrance 
Trollbane Conquests green book on same row of bookshelves from side of entrance 
The Forsaken Ally red book on second row of bookshelves on same side 
Cycles of Morality black book on table north corner

97243.name: Call of Fire
97243.objective_text: Bring the Torch of Dormant Flame to Olariaan Swiftburn at the Shrine of Flames in the Gustberry Lowlands.
97243.description:
Even though we are in the realm of skywall, this is still the elemental plane. The spirits of all four elements speak to us, if we deign to listen. One among us Windshapers is in particular attunement with the element of fire. A shen'dorei by the name of Olariaan Swiftburn.

Bring this to him at the Shrine of Flames in the Gustberry Lowlands. You'll find it tucked away along the edge of the island, west of Valanaar.

97244.name: Call of Fire
97244.objective_text: Slay Skypriest Faladiel in the Gustberry Lowlands and collect Faladiel's Heart.
97244.description:
There is an Al'Aketh Skypriest called Faladiel. He was once a caller of the flame and a stalwart Windshaper. Like so many Al'Aketh, he mortgaged his loyalty for power and his hands are now stained with the blood of  his former brothers and sisters.

You will find Skypriest Faladiel at the farm to the northeast past Valanaar, just to the south of the Shrine of Akir. Kill the betrayer. Bring me his heart. It is a gruesome task, but it is needed for the ritual we are to perform.

97245.name: Call of Fire
97245.objective_text: Find the home of Kuramaa in the Shen'dar Highlands, and defeat the spirit in combat. Bring Kuramaa's Mask to Olariaan Swiftburn in the Gustberry Lowlands when you are victorious.
97245.description:
The residents of the Shen'dar Highlands speak of an ancient forest sprite called Kuramaa. They say it lives inside of a twisted stump at the summit of a hill near the highlands Anchor Pylon.

Go to the highlands and find this stump. Rap your fist upon the bark and Kuramaa will appear. Best the spirit in combat, and bring me its wooden mask.

Be warned however, this entity will be exceptionally resistant to much of your magic. Only the touch of flame will lay low the spirit.

97257.name: Call of Fire
97257.objective_text:
Wait for Olariaan to begin the ritual at the Brazier of Offering and follow his instructions.

You must deliver the Eternal Flame to Valanaar before the timer runs out.

objectives.text: Light the Brazier of Eternal Flame

97257.description:
Now we will perform the ritual. 

I will place the materials onto the altar and call forth the spirits of flame. If the offering is accepted, they will appear and light the Eternal Flame. You will then hold your torch forth and capture the flame.

Carry the lit torch to Valanaar and place it in the Brazier of Eternal Flames. You must do so quickly, for the flames of the Firelands are quick to dissipate here in Skywall.

start.name: Object #660964 (unnamed, e.g. a poster or crate)

97263.name: Your Package Has Arrived
97263.description: <Several misplaced packages have been left by the mailbox. You note that one of them is marked for delivery from Aerie Peak, to Ironforge, to Eldrun Stormbreaker. It is marked "urgent.">

97288.name: Unending Torment
97288.objective_text: Deliver the Abominable Head to someone within the Undercity.

objectives.text: Deliver the Abominable Head to someone within the Undercity.

97288.description:
<As the creature falls, its head comes toppling off. It seems as if it has been reattached several times, and the connection gets weaker with each reconnection.

Someone in the Undercity would know more about this unique abomination.>

97289.name: Unending Torment
97289.objective_text: Bring the Head of the Baron to the body of Othmar in the Undercity.
97289.description:
We craft abomination heads all the time, but this one is special. It belonged to a Grand Marshal of the alliance once. A particularly unpleasant one. The Dark Lady had the pleasure of dispatching of this one herself.

Ooh the secrets it could tell if it could talk. And it can! If we reattach it to an appropriate host.

Go ahead and place it next to the available body in the next room. But don't attach it. Not yet.
comments: In the next room off the the same level you picked up the quest. There is a hanging corpse to turn it into.

97291.name: Unending Torment
97291.objective_text: Collect a Toxic Skullcap from Tawny Grisette in the Trade Quarter, Blisterweed near the Herbalism Trainer, and Essence of Agony from the poison vendor in the Rogues' Quarter for Master Apothecary Faranell in Undercity.
97291.description:
With the head reattached, all we need now is to bind it to the Dark Lady's will. This should not be a problem. The beast barely has brains left as it is after all the beatings it's taken.

We simply need to motivate it.

Fetch me a Toxic Skullcap from Miss Grisette in the Trade Quarter. Oh, and some Blisterweed from our local herbalist trainers, the Alliestars. Feel free to just take some, they owe me. And lastly a bit of Essence of Agony. Any old poison vendor should do.

We have a potion to make!
comments:
1. Toxic Skullcap from Tawny Grisette in the Trade Quarter (She patrols around the inner circle, upper level where the flight point is.)
2. Blisterweed from behind Katrina Alliestar at 54.6, 49.6 (Loot it from the herbs growing there, it's on the very left in a barrel.)
3. Essence of Agony from Ezekiel Graves at 75.6, 51.4 (It's a rogue only item so it might be a red item for you.)

97292.name: Unending Torment
97292.objective_text: Inject the Hissing Serum into the system above Othmar's body for Master Apothecary Faranell.
97292.description:
I have concocted a lovely serum that our new guest is sure to find quite... stimulating.

Take this. Feed it into the workings dripping from above him. Let's see if we can't show him why it's in his best interest to serve loyally.

And try not to drop it. I can't afford a new assistant.
comments: Go to the worm above. Then use the item. DONE

47:60, big pink worm
https://ibb.co/VY8F59kY
The big pink worm is outside the room up top if you exit to the right. He's huge next to the path.
At least in the beta, there is no on use text on the serum. You have to click the item in your inventory itself, not the worm.

97538.name: Pigments for Paints
97538.objective_text: Tah Winterhoof in Thunder Bluff wants 30 Mirkweed Pods from Mirkfallon Lake.
97538.description:
Greetings, friend. I wonder if I may ask a favor of you? I have just run out of red pigment for my paints, and I am looking for one with younger hooves to make the long journey into the Stonetalon Mountains on my behalf.

In the middle of the mountain pass there lies a large circular lake, Mirkfallon Lake, that has a unique plant that grows within its waters. The pods of this plant, mirkweed, turn a vibrant red when dried. Gather the pods of this plant for me, and I will reward you well for your efforts.

97894.name: Business in Auberdine
97894.objective_text:
Check on Gorbold Steelhand in Auberdine in Darkshore.

Borgus mentioned a boat on the southern-most dock in Stormwind Harbor that can take you there.

objectives.text: Take the boat to Auberdine and find Gorbold Steelhand.

97914.name: Expanding Horizons
97914.objective_text:
Bring Thundris' Letter to Baros Alexston in Stormwind.

Thundris mentioned a boat in Auberdine that can take you there.
97914.description:
Auberdine is a humble place, <class>. You will not hear its name spoken in the boughs of Darnassus. Most reference only what the Sundering took from us--the thriving cities of Ameth'Aran, Bashal'Aran, and... Lathar'Lazal.

Yet Auberdine remains in their shadow.

I would see our work here recognized. A new vessel connects us to the kingdom of Stormwind, bringing life and supplies to our shores. I beseech you join its next voyage, and bring this letter to a human called Baros Alexston.

Make our home known.

97915.name: Camping 101: Alchemy
97915.objective_text: Speak with Alchemist Mallory in Elwynn Forest near Stormwind to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
97915.description:
So, you chose to cook up brews and potions as an Alchemist. I'm sure that'll come in handy in your travels.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Mana Well for your camp. Build one of these and all of the healers and spellcaster types will come running to get a refreshing taste.

97916.name: Camping 101: Blacksmithing
97916.objective_text: Speak with Smith Argus in Goldshire to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
97916.description:
So, you've become a Blacksmith. That's a great choice if you want to make sure your blades never dull.

I reckon I know someone that can help with that by teaching you how to craft a Sharpening Wheel. Bring one of these out at your camp and all the warriors and rogues in the area will be lining up to hone their weapons.

97917.name: Camping 101: Enchanting
97917.objective_text: Speak with Betty Quin in Stormwind to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
97917.description:
Enchanters make everything better and are always welcome at any camp out in the wilds.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft an Enchanted Lute for your camp. It's so important to find entertainment during your downtime, and this bit of magic can help ensure you are ready to weather all sorts of challenges when you hit the old dusty trail once again.

97918.name: Camping 101: Engineering
97918.objective_text: Speak with Sprite Jumpsprocket in Stormwind to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
97918.description:
Engineers like yourself can cook up all sorts of bits, bots, and bombs for fun and profit.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Reagent Bot for your camp. This helpful automaton can help keep you well-supplied so that you and your allies never run out of the materials needed to fuel your spells.

97919.name: Camping 101: First Aid
97919.objective_text: Speak with Michelle Belle in Goldshire to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.

objectives.text: Raise your first aid skill to 20

97919.description:
So you've taken up First Aid? That's an honorable... and pragmatic pursuit as a <class>.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a First Aid Kit for your camp. Injuries are a reality in the world of adventuring and offering some much-needed healing at your camp could even save lives.

97920.name: Camping 101: Fishing
97920.objective_text: Speak with Lee Brown near Goldshire to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
97920.description:
You might not think so, but your skill as a fisherman can actually come in handy at camp.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Fish Bowl for your camp. You can use this fixture to help provide a bit of joy to yourself and your fellow adventurers. A happy adventurer is a strong adventurer and I'm sure your combat capabilities will reflect that.

97921.name: Camping 101: Herbalism
97921.objective_text: Speak with Herbalist Pomeroy in Elwynn Forest to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
97921.description:
Looks to me like you've gained some skill in herbalism. Picking flowers isn't just for dilly-dallying, you know. It can be useful... and profitable.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft an Incense Candle for your camp. High spirits are a key component to keeping healers and spellcasters in the fight, and an Incense Candle can provide a boost that magic users will surely appreciate.

97922.name: Camping 101: Leatherworking
97922.objective_text: Speak with Adele Fielder in Goldshire to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
97922.description:
You've become a leatherworker. Good for you, <class>. I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to make yourself a tent that will keep you cool on hot days, and dry on rainy days.

With a good tent over your head, you'll ensure that you get all the rest you need to stay sharp on your travels.

97923.name: Camping 101: Mining
97923.objective_text: Speak with Gelman Stonehand in Stormwind to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
97923.description:
Mining isn't the most glamorous, but it's good honest work and a fine profession for you to explore.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Lodestone for your camp. Build one of these and everyone who wants to swing a sword will be eager to gather round your fire and soak up the extra "oomph" it can provide to increase their combat prowess.

97924.name: Camping 101: Skinning
97924.objective_text: Speak with Helene Peltskinner in Goldshire to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
97924.description:
Being able to skillfully harvest the skins and hides of fallen beasts is one of the more valuable skills an adventurer can possess.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Camp Chair for your camp. Sometimes it's important to just take a load off, and you can use some of those hides you've gathered to make a comfy chair to sit in. A bit of relaxation can help ensure that you are at your peak condition and can strike where it counts the next time you find yourself in a dust-up.

97925.name: Camping 101: Tailoring
97925.objective_text: Speak with Eldrin in the Eastvale Logging Camp in Elwynn Forest to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
97925.description:
Tailoring is a surprisingly potent tradeskill to invest in, and I'm sure it'll serve you well.

I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Faction Banner for your camp, provided you have the skill for it. Inspiration and morale are a key part of success on any battlefield, and an inspirational banner can go a long way to keeping you energized.

97926.name: Making Do
97926.objective_text: Bring Alexston's Reply to Thundris Windweaver in Auberdine in Darkshore.
97926.description:
I wish it was that easy to help, <class>. I really do.

Should you choose to spend more time in our lands, you will find that many are without. Stormwind's coffers are not what they once were, and what remains is spread thin.

Give this reply to the elder the next time you see him. It's not what he's hoping for, but it's all I have to offer right now.

97938.name: Camping 101: Alchemy
97938.objective_text: Speak with Cyndra Kindwhisper in Dolanaar to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
97938.description:
So, you chose to cook up brews and potions as an Alchemist. I'm sure that'll come in handy in your travels.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Mana Well for your camp. Build one of these and all of the healers and spellcaster types will come running to get a refreshing taste.

97940.name: Camping 101: Enchanting
97940.objective_text: Speak with Alanna Raveneye in the Oracle Glade in Teldrassil to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
97940.description:
Enchanters make everything better and are always welcome at any camp out in the wilds.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft an Enchanted Lute for your camp. It's so important to find entertainment during your downtime, and this bit of magic can help ensure you are ready to weather all sorts of challenges when you hit the old dusty trail once again.

97942.name: Camping 101: First Aid
97942.objective_text: Speak with Byancie in Dolanaar to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.

objectives.text: Raise your first aid skill to 20

97942.description:
So you've taken up First Aid? That's an honorable... and pragmatic pursuit as a <class>.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a First Aid Kit for your camp. Injuries are a reality in the world of adventuring and offering some much-needed healing at your camp could even save lives.

97943.name: Camping 101: Fishing
97943.objective_text: Speak with Astaia in Darnassus to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
97943.description:
You might not think so, but your skill as a fisherman can actually come in handy at camp.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Fish Bowl for your camp. You can use this fixture to help provide a bit of joy to yourself and your fellow adventurers. A happy adventurer is a strong adventurer and I'm sure your combat capabilities will reflect that.

97944.name: Camping 101: Herbalism
97944.objective_text: Speak with Malorne Bladeleaf in Dolanaar to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
97944.description:
Looks to me like you've gained some skill in herbalism. Picking flowers isn't just for dilly-dallying, you know. It can be useful... and profitable.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft an Incense Candle for your camp. High spirits are a key component to keeping healers and spellcasters in the fight, and an Incense Candle can provide a boost that magic users will surely appreciate.

97946.name: Camping 101: Leatherworking
97946.objective_text: Speak with Nadyia Maneweaver on the road to Darnassus from Dolanaar to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
97946.description:
You've become a leatherworker. Good for you, <class>. I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to make yourself a tent that will keep you cool on hot days, and dry on rainy days.

With a good tent over your head, you'll ensure that you get all the rest you need to stay sharp on your travels.

97948.name: Camping 101: Mining
97948.objective_text: Speak with Kurdram Stonehammer in Auberdine to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
97948.description:
Mining isn't the most glamorous, but it's good honest work and a fine profession for you to explore.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Lodestone for your camp. Build one of these and everyone who wants to swing a sword will be eager to gather round your fire and soak up the extra "oomph" it can provide to increase their combat prowess.

97949.name: Camping 101: Skinning
97949.objective_text: Speak with Radnaal Maneweaver on the road to Darnassus from Dolanaar to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
97949.description:
Being able to skillfully harvest the skins and hides of fallen beasts is one of the more valuable skills an adventurer can possess.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Camp Chair for your camp. Sometimes it's important to just take a load off, and you can use some of those hides you've gathered to make a comfy chair to sit in. A bit of relaxation can help ensure that you are at your peak condition and can strike where it counts the next time you find yourself in a dust-up.

97950.name: Camping 101: Tailoring
97950.objective_text: Speak with Trianna in Darnassus to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
97950.description:
Tailoring is a surprisingly potent tradeskill to invest in, and I'm sure it'll serve you well.

I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Faction Banner for your camp, provided you have the skill for it. Inspiration and morale are a key part of success on any battlefield, and an inspirational banner can go a long way to keeping you energized.

97963.name: Camping 101: Alchemy
97963.objective_text: Speak with Nyassa Swiftdraught in Shen'dar Village to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
97963.description:
So, you chose to cook up brews and potions as an Alchemist. I'm sure that'll come in handy in your travels.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Mana Well for your camp. Build one of these and all of the healers and spellcaster types will come running to get a refreshing taste.

97964.name: Camping 101: Blacksmithing
97964.objective_text: Speak with Aedi Thriceforged in Shen'dar Village to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
97964.description:
So, you've become a Blacksmith. That's a great choice if you want to make sure your blades never dull.

I reckon I know someone that can help with that by teaching you how to craft a Sharpening Wheel. Bring one of these out at your camp and all the warriors and rogues in the area will be lining up to hone their weapons.

97965.name: Camping 101: First Aid
97965.objective_text: Speak with Naleeia Tattermend in Shen'dar Village to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.

objectives.text: Raise your first aid skill to 20

97965.description:
So you've taken up First Aid? That's an honorable... and pragmatic pursuit as a <class>.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a First Aid Kit for your camp. Injuries are a reality in the world of adventuring and offering some much-needed healing at your camp could even save lives.

97967.name: Camping 101: Fishing
97967.objective_text: Speak with Fenn Fairweather in Shen'dar Village to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
97967.description:
You might not think so, but your skill as a fisherman can actually come in handy at camp.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Fish Bowl for your camp. You can use this fixture to help provide a bit of joy to yourself and your fellow adventurers. A happy adventurer is a strong adventurer and I'm sure your combat capabilities will reflect that.

97968.name: Camping 101: Herbalism
97968.objective_text: Speak with Syriel Nightrain in Valanaar to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
97968.description:

97972.objective_text: Speak with Taleen Shimmerthread in Shen'dar Village to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.

97973.name: Camping 101: Tailoring
97973.objective_text: Speak with Taleen Shimmerthread in Shen'dar Village to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.

97977.name: Nature's Call
97977.objective_text: Collect 4  Gnarlpine Totems and bring them to Tarindrella.
97977.description:
The Gnarlpine furbolg would not turn on their ancient allies so readily. We must learn more of their plight.

Search their abandoned homes for totems. If any survived the chaos of their departure, their engravings may tell us more of what happened here.

You'll find their camps along the western edge of the glen, though the grell and grellkin may have scattered them beyond.

97979.name: The Goddess Provides
97979.description:
You are born kaldorei--the children of the stars--and have inherited a birthright unlike any other in this world. Elune's grace may illuminate our strengths, helping our strikes hit true, or it may help conceal us just as the moon may eclipse the sun.

Our Long Vigil after the defense of Mount Hyjal has ended, and we have joined an Alliance of others--which you will meet in due time. For now, you are nestled in the boughs of Teldrassil.

Demonstrate Mother Moon's gifts, and bask in her blessings.

98013.name: Swelling Forces
98013.objective_text: Eliminate 12 Stormscale Myrmidons, 8 Stormscale Sorceresses, and 6 Stormscale Warriors for Arbal at the Grove of the Ancients.
98013.description:
Steel yourself for your time in the ruins, young one... you will not be granted free passage there.

Scores of cursed Highborne, now known as naga, roam the once great city. Travel northeast and dispatch them from this land.

What they once were... is no more. If they aid the Twilight's Hammer, they can bring only further pain to the forests that once gave them shelter.

War is what they seek, <class>. War... is what we will bring.

98021.name: Journey to Sentinel Hill
98021.objective_text: Report To Gryan Stoutmantle at Sentinel Hill in Westfall.
98021.description:
If you'd like to get started doing some good in our world, I'd recommend reporting to a man named Gryan Stoutmantle in Westfall to the south, at the settlement known as Sentinel Hill. His people are in need of aid.

After journeying here from another plane of existence, the problems our lands face may seem small. I assure you, the aid you provide to those impacted by such problems means everything to them, and you will grow stronger for your labors.

Good luck out there, adventurer!

98025.name: WANTED: Jai'vhanel
98025.objective_text: Find and slay the owl known as Jai'vhanel and take one of her feathers. The black owl was last seen north of the Ameth'Aran ruins near the mountain base. Report the death of Jai'vhanel to Sentinel Glynda Nal'Shea in Auberdine.
98025.description:
Attention!

A reward is being offered for the death of the owl "Jai'vhanel" also know as "Swordfeather".

Unfortunately this owl has gone mad and has begun to attack travelers as they journey along the road near Auberdine.

Jai'vhanel was last seen north of the Ameth'Aran ruins near the mountain base. Bring back one of her jet black feathers as proof of her death.

Reward claims for this bounty should be claimed with Sentinel Glynda Nal'Shea in Auberdine.

The Auberdine Village Council

98028.name: Baron Marinous
98028.objective_text: Bring the Clouded Water Globe to Onu at the Grove of the Ancients in Darkshore.
98028.description:
All that remains of the powerful elemental is a globe of what seems to be pure water, clouded by some unknown substance. The edges of the sphere seem to be clear until you turn it--as if the cloud actively prevents you from peering within.

Whatever happened to it--and to the ruins it was guarding--is still active in some way.

Only Onu, the Ancient of Lore at the Grove of the Ancients to the far south, would have a chance at knowing more.

g.name: It's All Fun and Games Until...

98042.name: It's All Fun and Games Until...
98042.objective_text: Obtain a Peerless Eye from a Twilight Disciple or Thug at the Master's Glaive in Darkshore and find someone in Auberdine who is willing to take it.
98042.description:
<As you tear away the single page from the Twilight Tome, a foreboding voice floods your mind, uninvited.>

They have failed.

You will be forgotten.

They will lose the eye they gained.

list.name: It's All Fun and Games Until...

98046.name: Crown of the Earth
98046.objective_text: Bring the Drained Vessel to Lariia in the Temple of the Moon in Darnassus.
98046.description:
<Arch Druid Fandral Staghelm's gaze narrows.>

You're still here?

Take the phial and get out of my sight, <class>. It is clear my answers do not lie in the waters, just as they did not before. 

Perhaps one of the priestesses in the Temple of the Moon to the south will dispose of it.

<Fandral looks away, no longer speaking to you.>

I must look elsewhere if this is to work...

98065.name: Crown of the Earth
98065.objective_text: Bring the Moonwell Remnants to Tyrande Whisperwind in the Temple of the Moon in Darnassus.
98065.description:
You must bring this to Tyrande at once! I will transfer it to a more ceremonial container for you.

Do not be afraid. The High Priestess of Elune is firm, but kind. She protects all who enter Darnassus, and carries our goddess' light to all.

She will be glad to receive this sacred water. You will find her directly above us.

98067.name: Eyes of the Sentinels
98067.objective_text: Place Sentinel Owls at the entrance to the Cenarion Hold depths, the Darnassus Bank, the Craftsman's Terrace Inn, and the City Gate for Sentinel Dalia Sunblade in the Temple of the Moon in Darnassus.
98067.description:
General Feathermoon ensures all sentinels have time to pray to Elune. A proper huntress wields not blade alone, but gifts of the goddess to overcome our enemies.

You may help with my daily duties. Place sentinels around the city--start with the tunnels leading beneath Cenarion Hold to the north, the bank at the center of town, the inn in the Craftsman's Terrace to the northeast, and the city gates. The guards can assist you.

Something is amiss in Teldrassil--we must remain vigilant.

98072.name: Crocs of the Sky
98072.objective_text: Collect 10 Pristine Crimson Scales and bring them to James Halloran in Menethil Harbor.
98072.description:
You're quite the go-getter! I have just one more favor to ask, if you're up for something a bit more dangerous.

The crocolisk trade is steady money, but they're small fish compared to what whelp scales will bring. Folks will pay top dollar for a sack of those.

Crocs of the sky, I call 'em! There's no way my apprentice could get them--but it seems right up your alley!

You'll find whelps far to the east, along the Green Belt. But be careful, there's nasty orcs in those hills!

98189.name: Return the Statuette
98189.objective_text: Bring the Menethil Statuette to Captain Stoutfist in Menethil Keep.
98189.description:
My goodness, it's--it's beautiful!

The Blind Princess was to deliver this to Menethil Harbor before tragedy struck. We were so close!

I believe it was to be signed for by Captain Stoutfist in Menethil Keep just behind us. Why don't you do the honors of finishing the job?

98190.name: A Friend of the Family
98190.objective_text: Bring the Menethil Statuette to Highlord Bolvar Fordragon in Stormwind Keep.

98191.name: A Friend of the Family
98191.objective_text: Bring the Menethil Statuette to Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker in the Cathedral of Light.
98191.description:
King Terenas was a good man. A devout man. Beloved by his people, and truly the reason we have this Alliance at all.

The irony is he was humble--he hated these sorts of memorials, and so precious few exist. And of those, few survived Lordaeron's fall.

It seems the Light has coalesced in this statuette. It would be best kept in the Cathedral of the Light in Cathdral Square, in the center of the city. Bring it to Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker for safekeeping.

98197.name: Spoils of War
98197.objective_text: Recover 6 Khaz Modan Timber and 30 Khaz Modan Iron from Menethil Harbor for Valstag Ironjaw.
98197.description:
This harbor was first built by the Old Horde as a staging ground for their naval invasion of Hillsbrad. Completely circumvented Lordaeron's defenses!

So many lives lost...

What's worse is that fleet was built with the very resources they stole from Khaz Modan!

Plenty of it remains in the harbor after Admiral Proudmoore routed the brutes and built this place for the Alliance. We'll need it to bolster the town's defenses with the Dragonmaw on the move.

98208.name: Bloom of the Heavens
98208.objective_text: Recover Nord'el for Sylessa Duskwhisper in Menethil Harbor.
98208.description:
I came to Menethil Harbor from Auberdine, from the great tree Teldrassil, to recover a bloom of great import to my people.

My people's ship the Flying Osprey crashed here many moons ago, joined with the Kul Tiran Third Fleet. Among its cargo was the flower known as Nord'el--Bloom of the Heavens in your tongue--bloomed under a full moon at the peak of Mount Hyjal, our former home.

Please help me retrieve it! The wreckage is just south of the city, but it is inhabited by fierce murloc raiders!

98219.name: The Shamed Lieutenant
98219.objective_text: Speak to Lieutenant Farren Orinelle in Southshore in Hillsbrad Foothills.
98219.description:
Thank you again for delivering the statuette safely, <name>.

I could use your help with something else. There's a member of the city guard who was reassigned to duty in Southshore out in the Hillsbrad Foothills.

His father was a friend of mine, and while I don't disagree that he could use the lesson... I'd still like to see him succeed. He would really benefit from someone like you helping him out.

There is a boat that can take you that way from Menethil Harbor, if you are passing back through.

98240.name: Crimson Crate Delivery
98240.objective_text: Bring the Crimson Crate to Howin Kindfeather off the road to the east of Menethil Harbor.
98240.description:
Word is officially out on those whelps, <name>. We already have an order in!

I'll package 'em up all nice for you, then you take it out to the customer. I know, I know; it's just one last favor, I promise!

These will be for one "Howin Kindfeather". Sent his gryphon into town of all things with a letter for the order! Says he's just off the road to the east, a bit past Whelgar's Excavation Site, if you're familiar.

98245.name: Razormaw Needling
98245.objective_text: Collect 10 Razormaw Incisors for Howin Kindfeather.
98245.description:
I don't know who I hate more: the bloody Dark Irons, the Dragonmaw, or the drakes they rode.

<Howin spits.>

I aim tae make things right. But we're gonna need some supplies.

These whelp scales will protect against dragonfire a good bit, but they're a pain in the arse tae weave together.

The Razormaw raptors up in Raptor Ridge to the northeast and Saltspray Glen to the northwest are so named for their pointy chompers--they oughta break through the scales.

Bring me a handful of the incisors.

98246.name: Trying Times
98246.objective_text: Gather 12 Perfect Razormaw Eggs for Howin Kindfeather.
98246.description:
I'll need some eggs if my plan is going tae work. Bassbeak needs a nice an' full belly--I ain't in the business of hoppin' on the back of a surly gryphon.

They need to be perfect--no cracks or anything.

Take some from the Razormaw raptors--they're known for having yolks the size of a gnome's noggin. You can find 'em in Raptor Ridge to the northeast and Saltspray Glen to the northwest.

Let's make it a nice even dozen, just to be safe.

98247.name: Shipping Label
98247.objective_text: Deliver the Shipping Label to someone at the Azeroth Commerce Authority trade hub in Redridge Mountains.
98247.description:
<A torn shipping label can be found on the side of the now fully stocked crate. Though the intended recipient is torn off, details of its origin still remain.

"Property of the Azeroth Commerce Authority. Please return empty crates or unfulfilled shipments to our local trade hub at the Three Corners crossroads in Redridge Mountains. Couriers will be compensated for their time and travel."

Beside the text is a crudely drawn map of the area near the aforementioned destination.>

98248.name: Shipping Label
98248.objective_text: Deliver the Shipping Label to someone at the Durotar Supply and Logistics trade hub near the Crossroads in the Barrens.
98248.description:
<A torn shipping label can be found on the side of the now fully stocked crate. Though the intended recipient is torn off, details of its origin still remain.

"Return damaged shipments or empty crates to the Durotar Supply and Logistics trade outpost, now conveniently located due west of the Crossroads in the Barrens. Your time is valuable and we will compensate you for your efforts!"

Beside the text is a crudely drawn map of the area near the aforementioned destination.>

98282.name: Alchemical Hazards
98282.objective_text: Collect an Unruptured Stalker Gland from Thelgen Rock for Caitlin Grassman in Menethil Harbor.
98282.description:
Certain alchemical recipes require ingredients sourced from, well, very dangerous places. And those are often just the base herbs! The other ingredients are even worse!

I need to make more antivenom before I can leave again. I swear everything in this marsh is venomous. It's like it runs through the land itself!

Can you help me? I'll need a venom gland from the spiders in Thelgen Rock to the far southeast. But it has to be unruptured, or too much venom will spill out before you can get here. Sorry!

98284.name: Camping 101: Enchanting
98284.objective_text: Speak with Nasalanna Windsinger in Shen'dar Village to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
98284.description:
Enchanters make everything better and are always welcome at any camp out in the wilds.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft an Enchanted Lute for your camp. It's so important to find entertainment during your downtime, and this bit of magic can help ensure you are ready to weather all sorts of challenges when you hit the old dusty trail once again.

98285.name: Camping 101: Engineering
98285.objective_text: Speak with the Strange Hermit in Shadowgale Forest to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
98285.description:
An engineer is ever-resourceful, and if you are in the wilds alone, it's always good to be able to put your trade to use. No good camp is complete without a few helpful constructs!

Yes, come back and see me when you've gained a little bit of experience as an engineer and I can show you how to make something special!

98286.name: Camping 101: Enchanting
98286.objective_text: Speak with Nasalanna Windsinger in Shen'dar Village to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
98286.description:
Enchanters make everything better and are always welcome at any camp out in the wilds.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft an Enchanted Lute for your camp. It's so important to find entertainment during your downtime, and this bit of magic can help ensure you are ready to weather all sorts of challenges when you hit the old dusty trail once again.

98293.name: Forced Disarmament
98293.objective_text: Collect 30 Dragonmaw Armaments in Dragonmaw Retreat, then bring them to Captain Stoutfist in Menethil Keep.
98293.description:
The Dragonmaw are stockpiling all manner of weaponry. It would be wise to relieve them of these before more soldiers can be armed.

Captain Stoutfist in Menethil Keep would surely be interested in these.

98386.name: Alther's Mill
98386.objective_text: Slay 12 Greater Tarantulas and destroy 6 Tarantula Eggs in Alther's Mill for Foreman Oslow in Redridge.
98386.description:
Orcs, gnolls, murlocs. Everything seems to be out to stop me from getting this bridge done on time. Now we have word there's an infestation of tarantulas at our lumber mill!

If you're up to earn a bit more coin, would you head over to Alther's Mill to the east and clear out their spider problem? Place is as good as useless to me if I can't safely send workers to collect shipments.

Oh, and if you see ol' Alther, tell him he owes me for cleaning up his mess.

98387.name: Blackrock Blockade
98387.objective_text: Bring 10 Battleworn Axes to Marshal Marris in Lakeshire.
98387.description:
What the Blackrock orcs don't understand is that this is a war of attrition. Their brazen push into Alliance territory has left them vulnerable and without supplies, relying on the surrounding mountains to gather resources.

An army can't run on empty bellies, <name>. Go to their encampments south of Stonewatch Keep to the east and rob them of their food and weapons. Let's see the orcs' fighting spirit when they're starved and defenseless.

98391.name: The Sisterhood of Elune
98391.objective_text: Speak to Sister Aquinne in Darnassus.
98391.description:
Blessings to you, <class>. The Sisterhood of Elune has stood as a pillar of kaldorei society for thousands of years.

Before the Great Sundering, before the War of the Ancients, through the Long Vigil, we have guided and healed our people through the darkness. Such is our charge, and such is the demand of the peerless Mother Moon.

We now require your aid in a matter of great importance. Sister Aquinne awaits your arrival in Darnassus.

98392.name: Darkness in the Glade
98392.objective_text: Collect Hatescreech's Amulet, Windmistress Gaedress' Amulet, and Witchmother Arysa's Amulet for Sentinel Arynia Cloudsbreak in the Oracle Glade.
98392.description:
These belts... look closely at the leather, <name>. Do you see the taint running through the fibers?

I have a suspicion as to its origin, but we will need further proof to be sure.

Venture back out into the harpies' nests to the west and take out their leaders. If their necklaces carry the same darkness as these belts, we'll have our answer.

98393.name: The Great Cat Spirit
98393.objective_text: Speak with Dendrite Starblaze in the village of Nighthaven, Moonglade.
98393.description:
It would seem that you are ready for the next step in your journey, young druid. Dendrite Starblaze has sent for you, and wishes for you to seek him out in Moonglade once again.

You have already learned to call upon the magic to take you to Moonglade, so you should be able to embark immediately if you choose. I would suggest you leave soon, if you wish to continue your druidic training.

series.name: Blessings of the Great Cat Spirit

98397.name: To Darnassus
98397.objective_text: Return to Darnassus and speak with Mathrengyl Bearwalker in the Cenarion Enclave.
98397.description:
The time has come for us to part ways once again, young one, as the application of your lessons takes you back to whom that sent you to me. It would seem your instructor, Mathrengyl Bearwalker, has found a worthy pupil in you. I believe I see one as well. Heed his lessons and you shall soon be able to draw upon the Great Cat Spirit to take its shape.

Go back to whence you came. When the time is right, we will meet again.

series.name: Blessings of the Great Cat Spirit

end.name: Object #673378 (unnamed, e.g. a poster or crate)

98398.name: The Oracle Tree
98398.objective_text: Find the Oracle Tree Bark nearby to receive its message.
98398.description:
I am impressed by what you have accomplished here in so short a time, <name>. Would that I could ask you to remain here to assist me with my duties... but I know in my heart that greater tasks lie ahead for you.

I have noticed the Oracle Tree has just shed a piece of its bark. No doubt it has a task that it wishes completed. You should speak with it.

98403.name: Twisted Hatred
98403.objective_text: Kill 8 Befouled Webwoods and bring Xethorr the Wicked's Mature Fel Moss to Tallonkai Swiftroot in Dolanaar.
98403.description:
Lord Melenas did not act alone; he was at the behest of another. The one you seek is Xethorr the Wicked. It seems he has twisted the spiders that call Teldrassil home, intending their venom for some foul plan.

He has taken residence deep in the forest, in the area to the northwest of here known as the Cleft. Take caution, and bring allies, for Xethorr is not an opponent to be trifled with.

Dispatch his brood, and bring me anything that may tell us more of the satyr's work here.

98407.name: Show of Force
98407.objective_text: Collect 5 Spiked Collars from Gnoll Thrashers for Deputy Feldon near Lakeshire.
98407.description:
If the gnolls are growing so bold they are willing to camp this close to humans, there's no telling how much further they'll go. We need to deter them.

The beasts are hardly organized, but they seem to respect strength above all else. If we can slay the worst of them, maybe claim some of their trophies, we can remind these gnolls why they should stay in the hills where they belong.

Should you see any of their thrashers, bring me their collars. That should put the fear of the Alliance back into them.

98447.name: The Valor Family
98447.objective_text: Find the cause of the Valor family ghosts in Raven Hill for Sirra Von'Indi in Darkshire.
98447.description:
Despite you putting down the Valor family ghosts, the reports of attacks have not ceased. It was a good gamble, but perhaps we did not settle their unfinished business after all.

From my research, it sounds like this family all went missing at the same time. Whatever trauma caused their spirits to be chained to this realm must have happened all at once.

Our only clue is where you found the book. Return to Raven Hill and see what you can find. Maybe bringing their weapons will spark something.

98459.name: A Lack of Virtue
98459.objective_text: Deliver Tom's Gift to Bart Tidewater in Menethil Harbor in the Wetlands.
98459.description:
Bart Tidewater's a no-good cheapskate, I tell ya!

"Captain of the Maiden's Virtue" he calls himself. That ship's sailed as far as a rock in Tanaris! He's no captain, he's an actor who won enough hands of poker to buy the Virtue in the first place!

If you ever find yourself in Menethil Harbor over in the Wetlands, give this to him and let him know it's from ol' Half-fish.

There's a boat from here that can take you right to the harbor, by the way. It'll be the second stop!

And he cheats at poker!

98461.name: Unrequited Love
98461.objective_text: Deliver Hollee's Note to Tarrel Rockweaver near Menethil Harbor in the Wetlands.
98461.description:
If you're heading out of Auberdine, I could use your help!

My dear friend Tarrel and I were classmates in school. Oh, he was such a quickfire on all things excavation! We got split up after graduation--him to Wetlands, and me to here in Darkshore.

<Hollee sighs, then her brow furrows slightly.>

Sorry, and his wife... Merrin.

It doesn't matter. If you go to the Wetlands, could you make sure he's alright? And maybe give him this? He's probably near Menethil Harbor. There's a boat straight there.

98512.name: Al'Aketh Assassins
98512.objective_text: Kill 10 Al'Aketh Assassins in the Shen'dar Highlands.
98512.description:
You there, stranger. Get low and keep quiet. We are not alone here.

I was on patrol near the border and noticed that there are a number of Al'Aketh skulking around the house just up the hill there to the north. I don't know what they are doing here, but it can't be good.

If you want to make yourself useful, get in there and take them out. I'll wait here and watch your back.

99046.name: The Lost Runner
99046.objective_text: Search for Sentinel Eralya Leafshadow on the road leading to the Oracle Glade.
99046.description:
The Council of the Forest sent a small group of sentinels to the Oracle Tree some time ago. The tree sends messages to our elders, and it falls to us to deliver them to Darnassus safely.

I received word that our most recent runner has not yet arrived. The Oracle's messages vary in frequency, but it has been abnormally long.

Please head towards the Oracle Glade along the road to to the west and check on her. It would have been Eralya Leafshadow's turn, and she is still in training. Elune guide you.

99047.name: Not Dead Yet
99047.objective_text: Seek aid from Byancie in Dolaanar for Sentinel Eralya Leafshadow.
99047.description:
My sisters and I... were dispatched... Oracle Tree...

Tree... message. I... harpies... everywhere...

<Eralya coughs up blood, grimacing through the pain.>

I may not have long... no one coming. Please... Byancie... in Dolanaar...

99050.name: The Great Tree Provides
99050.objective_text: Collect 6 Dewy Lasher Fronds, an Empty Vial, and a Refreshing Spring Water for Byancie in Dolanaar.
99050.description:
I will need your help acquiring the ingredients I need to stop the affliction long enough for Eralya to make it back here for further treatment.

Thankfully, our living home is still bountiful and will provide in our time of need.

The core ingredient is dewy lasher fronds. You'll find them around Lake Al'Ameth directly south of here, or Wellspring Lake and its river to the northwest.

In addition, I'll need an empty vial and some spring water. Both can be bought here in town, or traded for.

99053.name: Escaping Ban'ethil
99053.objective_text: Help Sentinel Lynessa Duskblossom escape Ban'ethil Barrow Den, and report her is safety to Sentinel Kyra Starsong in Dolanaar.

objectives.text: Escort Lynessa Duskblossom out of Ban'ethil

99073.name: Easing Suffering
99073.objective_text: Take the Lashwater Salve to Sentinel Eralya Leafshadow on the road to the Oracle Tree.
99073.description:
The salve is ready. Take it to Eralya swiftly.

I do not know if it will truly cure her. The rot festers quickly, and grows in strength as it spreads.

It will, if nothing else, ease her suffering. And that is still worth your haste.

99127.name: A Net Disaster
99127.objective_text: Check the fishing nets in Crystal Lake.
99127.description:
The fish just ain't biting today, and there's something wrong going on with them. It's not just empty hooks. I haven't seen a single minnow up in the water at all.

Lee here set up some traps overnight, go check to see if we've at least got some stock there. If you find anything weird, make sure to show me.
comments: These nets are really hard to see, but they will spawn right in the shallow water along the shores of the lake.

99128.name: Slimy Menace
99128.objective_text: Kill the murlocs at Crystal Lake.
99128.description:
This can only be the work of those murlocs on the other side of the lake. They're disgusting little things, with a vicious temper and teeth to match. 

If we let this continue, there won't be any fish to speak of anywhere in this lake. If you could clear them out a bit, it would help me a ton.

99129.name: A Man About a Murloc
99129.objective_text: Speak with Remy "Two Times" about Jason's murloc problems.
99129.description:
Remy mentioned murlocs the other day... I'm pretty sure he hates the little buggers as much as I do. 

He might have some ideas on how to keep them away from my fish in the future. I'd like to ask you to go chat with him and see if there's anything he can think of.

99130.name: An Enticing Offer
99130.description:
I've got a few ideas on how to deal with murlocs. And one of those also helps some others in the process.

There's a weed often found on farms in the area called duskweed, and in large quantities the petals are toxic to most animals. If we make some murloc bait with the plant, hopefully that can train those creatures to stay away.

And some farmers get their fields cleared in the process. Truly a win-win... truly a win-win.

99131.name: Baited for Success
99131.description:
Tell Mathers he can come pick up the bait later today. I'll give him the rundown on the proper usage.

Hopefully he'll be able to sell his fish again soon. And we'll have less murlocs in this world.

99143.name: Bottles and Baubles
99143.objective_text: Collect 6 pieces of shiny junk from the nearby Murloc camp.
99143.description:
Those fish men must think like actual fish, right? Which means anything they like, fish will like!

If you rummage through some of their junk and return to me with anything that seems like it would make good bait, I'll reward you.
